column1: You talk to yourself and, as usual, learn nothing that you didn't already know.
column2: 你自言自語，結果跟往常一樣，學不到什麼新東西。

column1: Hey! One shouldn't attempt to manipulate one's self in a family game.
column2: 喂！這可是闔家歡樂的遊戲，別對自己毛手毛腳的。

column1: Better not. You're likely to get a fur ball.
column2: 還是別了吧，你搞不好會咳出一顆毛球。

column1: The odor you're producing causes you to regret skipping last month's shower.
column2: 你身上飄出的味道，讓你開始後悔上個月沒去洗澡。

column1: You're too busy right now.
column2: 你現在正忙，沒空幹這個。

column1: Better save it for when you're thirsty.
column2: 還是留著吧，等你口渴了再說。

column1: You don't want to do that here.
column2: 你不會想在這裡做這種事的。

column1: You wisely strap on the jetpack to allow your self motion control.
column2: 你很聰明地繫上噴射背包，這樣才能控制自己怎麼動。

column1: The jetpack is useful only in Zero-G situations.
column2: 噴射背包只有在無重力狀態下才派得上用場。

column1: Don't bother. This knife wouldn't cut hot lard.
column2: 別費事了，這把刀連熱豬油都切不動。

column1: Isn't this just the most amazing waste of time?
column2: 這也太浪費時間了吧？

column1: You have to wonder why you're performing such a useless action.
column2: 你不禁納悶，自己幹嘛做這種沒用的事。

column1: You wisely decide this is a serious waste of time and energy.
column2: 你很聰明，一眼就看出這根本是在浪費時間跟力氣。

column1: You ask yourself why you're doing this and are forced to reply that you just don't know.
column2: 你問自己幹嘛這麼做，結果只能老實回答：不知道。

column1: Even for you, this isn't bright.
column2: 就算是你，這樣做也不太聰明。

column1: Thank you for playing Space Quest I. You've been most entertaining.
column2: 感謝你玩《宇宙傳奇I》，你這一路真是笑料十足。

column1: Are you sure you want to restart?
column2: 「你確定要重新開始嗎？」

column1: Memory fragmented.
column2: 記憶體已經支離破碎。

column1: What did you expect them to do, reproduce?
column2: 你還期待「他們」會做什麼，自我複製喔？

column1: You're far too busy for that now.
column2: 你現在忙得很，沒空做這個。

column1: You switch the gadget off to conserve its energy.
column2: 你把小裝置關掉，省點電。

column1: You switch the gadget on.
column2: 你把小裝置打開。

column1: You're far to busy for that now.
column2: 你現在忙得很，沒空做這個。

column1: You scrape that sticky goo from the bottom of the rock.
column2: 你把石頭底部那坨黏糊糊的東西刮下來。

column1: There is nothing you can do to the rock.
column2: 石頭這東西你拿它沒轍。

column1: You've already opened the survival kit and removed its contents.
column2: 你早就打開求生包，把裡面的東西拿出來了。

column1: Upon opening the survival kit you discover a Xenon army knife and a canister of dehydrated water.
column2: 打開求生包，你發現一把氙星軍刀和一罐濃縮水。

column1: You have %d Buckazoid%s
column2: 你有 %d 枚太空幣

column1: Thank you for playing Space Quest I. Too bad you've failed miserably and doomed all of your people to a horrible death at the hands of the Sariens. You quickly glance about the room to see if anyone saw your silly mistake. Better luck next time.
column2: 謝謝你玩《宇宙傳奇I》。只可惜你搞砸了，把全體同胞都害死在沙利安人手上，死狀淒慘。你趕緊瞄一眼四周，看看有沒有人看到你這蠢招。祝你下次好運。

column1: Score: %d of %d
column2: 分數： %d / %d

column1: As we join our story, the crew of the Arcada is returning home to Xenon after a successful mission developing the Star Generator. Exhilarated by their accomplishments, they are oblivious to the fact that a sinister craft approaches rapidly from behind.
column2: 話說我們的故事，阿寇達號的組員們才剛成功研發出星辰產生器，正要返航氙星。他們沉浸在成就的喜悅中，渾然不知一艘來意不善的飛船正從後方急速逼近。

column1: ***Thank you for playing Space Quest I. You've been most entertaining.
column2: ***謝謝你玩《宇宙傳奇I》，你的表現真是逗趣。

column1: This is the Data Archive of the Arcada. An interesting array of devices (none of of which you know how to operate) are provided for data study by those with proper clearance.
column2: 這裡是阿寇達號的資料庫。裡頭擺著一整排稀奇古怪的裝置(你半個都不會操作)，是提供給持有適當權限的人做資料研究用的。

column1: This is an area of non-descript hallway beneath the Data Archive Storage Cabin.
column2: 這是一段毫無特色的走廊，就在資料庫儲藏艙下方。

column1: The door opens. A man you recognize as one of the head lab scientists stumbles into the room. He appears to be in serious need of some Abdo-Seal abdomen filler!
column2: 門開了。一個你認得是首席實驗室科學家的男人，踉踉蹌蹌地跌進房間裡。他看起來急需來一些「腹腔快補」填充劑！

column1: After only a few steps, he hits the floor with a disconcerting thud.
column2: 才走沒幾步，他就砰的一聲倒在地上，那聲音讓人渾身不對勁。

column1: His lips move.
column2: 他的嘴唇動了動。

column1: Just before his systems cease all functions short of decay, he looks over toward the shelves full of cartridges and utters "%s". With one last gasp, his lifeless form slumps to the floor.
column2: 就在他的身體機能即將完全停擺、只剩腐化一途之前，他望向那排擺滿資料匣的架子，吐出一句「%s」。隨著最後一口氣，他癱軟的身軀滑落在地。

column1: No amount of money will put this man's lungs back in his chest.
column2: 就算有再多錢，也沒辦法把這個人的肺放回他的胸腔裡。

column1: It's a grisly sight. You can't tell where the toasted synthetic fabrics end and the fused organic material begins. There is nothing you can do for him now.
column2: 這畫面實在慘不忍睹。你根本分不清烤焦的合成布料在哪裡結束，融化的血肉又從哪裡開始。你現在幫不了他了。

column1: You see a man dressed in a lab coat. He appears to be ailing in a major way.
column2: 你看到一個穿實驗袍的男人，他的狀況顯然糟透了。

column1: A large laser hole has been burned in his uniform, giving you a nice view of previously unexposed tissue. Struggling painfully, he props himself up on one elbow.
column2: 他的制服上被雷射燒出一個大洞，讓你把原本藏在裡面的組織看得一清二楚。他痛苦地掙扎著，靠一隻手肘撐起身子。

column1: You can do nothing more for the fused flesh-heap of a man.
column2: 這團燒融的血肉，你再也幫不上什麼忙了。

column1: In his present condition (dead) he can't make any use of the data cartridge.
column2: 以他現在的狀態(死人一個)，資料匣對他一點用也沒有。

column1: If you give the keycard to the dead scientist, you won't be able to use the special elevators.
column2: 把磁卡留給這個已經死掉的科學家，你就沒辦法用那些特殊電梯了。

column1: The widget apparently has no power to raise the dead.
column2: 這個強力磁鐵顯然沒有起死回生的能耐。

column1: The handy dandy translation gadget will not enable you to communicate with the dead.
column2: 這台方便好用的翻譯機，可沒辦法讓你跟死人溝通。

column1: His audible forms of communication will be limited to what he can convey through the venting of bodily gases.
column2: 他現在唯一能發出的聲音，大概就只剩排氣了。

column1: He didn't smell all that great when he was alive.
column2: 他活著的時候，味道也沒多好聞。

column1: The smell of freshly sheared copper fills the air around the damaged scientist.
column2: 這位科學家的殘骸周圍，瀰漫著一股剛削下來的銅腥味。

column1: You wouldn't want to do that. Trust me.
column2: 你不會想做那種事的，相信我。

column1: This is a Model DX Cartridge Retrieval Unit. Its function is to retrieve and return cartridges from and to the storage unit. It is currently %s.
column2: 這是一台 DX 型資料匣取存裝置，功能是從儲存單元存取資料匣。它目前的狀態是 %s。

column1: You can't reach it. Even if you did, the pinchers look quite nasty.
column2: 你搆不到它。就算搆得到，那對夾爪看起來也挺兇的。

column1: It doesn't respond to human voice commands. It only works through the data archive console.
column2: 它不理會人類的語音指令，只能透過資料庫控制台操作。

column1: I wouldn't be violating his airspace if I were you.
column2: 換作是我，可不會靠他那麼近。

column1: You figure the robot probably works for batteries.
column2: 你猜這台機器人大概是靠電池運作的。

column1: You decide that the cartridge is too important to give back to the robot.
column2: 你認定這個資料匣太重要了，不能還給機器人。

column1: You see no slot on the robot that would fit the keycard.
column2: 你在這台機器人身上找不到能插磁卡的插槽。

column1: The widget, being magnetic, sticks to the robot's outer casing. You remove it again with some difficulty.
column2: 這個強力磁鐵本身有磁性，一下就吸在機器人外殼上，你費了好一番功夫才把它拔下來。

column1: Since the robot does not speak, the translator has nothing to translate.
column2: 這台機器人根本不會說話，翻譯機也沒東西可翻。

column1: You can see a well-lit room above.
column2: 你能看到上面有個燈火通明的房間。

column1: You seem to be on the wrong level to do that.
column2: 你現在好像不在對的樓層，做不了這件事。

column1: You need to go to the top level.
column2: 你得先上到最頂層。

column1: You're currently loitering on one of the upper deck hallways aboard the Starship Arcada.
column2: 你目前在阿寇達號星艦的上層甲板走廊間閒晃。

column1: You frisk the scorched body. Other than carbonized materials, your search reveals nothing. Boy, I hope this isn't becoming a new hobby.
column2: 你搜了搜這具燒焦的屍體。除了碳化物之外什麼都沒搜到。老天，希望這不會變成你的新嗜好。

column1: You have just stumbled into a small, dark, and very cluttered utility closet. Many things fall and most of them land on you. It doesn't say much for your cleaning prowess.
column2: 你一頭撞進一間又小又暗、亂七八糟的雜物間。一堆東西掉了下來，大部分還砸到你身上。看來你打掃的功力也沒多好。

column1: You're startled by the sound of an alarm. Breaking through it, the intercom crackles with the frightened voice of a technician shouting that the Arcada has been boarded by unknown intruders. The transmission ends abruptly in a soundstorm of white noise, soon overtaken by the cold din of silence.
column2: 一陣警報聲把你嚇了一跳。廣播系統劈哩啪啦地響起，傳來一名技師驚慌的聲音，大喊阿寇達號已經被不明入侵者攻佔。通話突然被一陣雜訊風暴打斷，隨後只剩下一片冷冽的死寂。

column1: You hear the overly cheerful voice of the ship's computer say: "Destruct sequence is engaged! %d minutes till detonation."
column2: 你聽見艦上電腦用過分歡快的語氣說道：「自毀程序已啟動！還有 %d 分鐘就會引爆。」

column1: The light is off. Were it on, you'd notice something called illumination.
column2: 燈是關著的。要是開著，你就會注意到一種叫做「照明」的東西。

column1: The sign would yield no smell even if you did have the energy to find a step ladder (which you don't).
column2: 就算你有力氣去找個梯子(其實你沒有)，這塊牌子聞起來也不會有什麼味道。

column1: This is Stuart, one of your crewmates. He appears to be non-functional. You used to kid him about it when he was alive but now it's true.
column2: 這是史都華，你的組員之一。他現在看起來已經「當機」了。他活著的時候你老拿這個梗虧他，現在倒是真的成真了。

column1: You have to come out of the closet first.
column2: 你得先走出這間儲藏室才行。

column1: Though you look like a cartoon character, you're not Stretchman.
column2: 雖然你看起來像卡通人物，但你可不是什麼「橡皮人」。

column1: Funny, no response.
column2: 奇怪，沒反應。

column1: On second thought, maybe you shouldn't wipe your nose on Stuart's clothes.
column2: 想想還是算了，你大概不該拿史都華的衣服來擦鼻涕。

column1: Oh, that's really sick. You really should seek professional help.
column2: 喔，這也太噁心了。你真的該去看醫生了。

column1: It's unlikely Stuart will be spending any money in the forseeable future.
column2: 短期內史都華大概不會花什麼錢了。

column1: Stuart was never much help to you, but now he's ignoring you entirely.
column2: 史都華以前就幫不了你什麼忙，現在更是完全不理你了。

column1: Stuart doesn't plan to use one of the special elevators anytime soon.
column2: 史都華短期內應該不會用到那些特殊電梯了。

column1: You wave the widget over Stuart's body. He's still dead.
column2: 你拿強力磁鐵在史都華的屍體上晃了晃。他還是死的。

column1: Even using the translator gadget, you can't communicate with Stuart. He's still dead.
column2: 就算用了翻譯機，你也沒辦法跟史都華溝通。他還是死的。

column1: This is an elevator to one of the lower levels.
column2: 這是一部通往下層樓的電梯。

column1: Pressing your nose to the elevator door merely serves to cool off your nostril hairs. The door has no fragrance.
column2: 把鼻子貼在電梯門上，頂多只能讓你的鼻毛涼快一下。這扇門沒什麼味道。

column1: People are going to start wondering about you if you keep applying your tongue to unusual places.
column2: 你再這樣到處舔奇怪的地方，大家真的會開始懷疑你有問題。

column1: Nothing is visible because of the darkness in here. It's one of the reasons that this is your favorite room aboard the Arcada.
column2: 這裡黑得什麼都看不見，這也是你最愛阿寇達號這個房間的原因之一。

column1: This is the access device to your favorite area of the ship - the closet.
column2: 這是通往你在艦上最愛地點——儲藏室——的出入裝置。

column1: The light's flashing. Hmm, let's see...That seems to ring a distant bell. Oh yeah, now you remember! It means that all living things now aboard the ship could die due to some disastrous situation that currently exists. Whatever the case, some personal hide preservation is in order.
column2: 燈在閃。嗯，讓我想想……好像有點印象。對了，你想起來了！這代表艦上目前發生了某種災難，所有活著的東西都可能因此喪命。不管怎樣，現在該做的是先保住自己這條命。

column1: Since the sign is recessed into the wall you can do nothing with it. A nice, distinct hand print now remains on the alert sign.
column2: 這塊牌子是嵌進牆裡的，你拿它沒轍。倒是警示牌上，現在留下了一個清清楚楚的手印。

column1: You take a whiff and notice a smell common to electronics which haven't had power applied to them in a quite a while.
column2: 你聞了一下，聞到一股很久沒通電的電子產品常有的味道。

column1: Boy, was that a bad idea. Your tongue now bears the residue left behind by adventurers who, like yourself, have shown a need to press various and sundry organs against the sign.
column2: 老天，這下慘了。你的舌頭上現在沾滿了殘留物——那些跟你一樣，忍不住要拿各種器官去貼這塊牌子的冒險者留下的痕跡。

column1: You search Jerry's body and find %s
column2: 你搜了傑瑞的屍體，找到 %s

column1: He smells like Jerry.
column2: 他聞起來就像傑瑞。

column1: I don't think you really want to taste Jerry. But then, who knows?
column2: 我看你應該不會真想嚐嚐傑瑞的味道吧。不過，誰知道呢？

column1: Jerry won't be needing any cash soon
column2: 傑瑞短時間內應該用不到什麼現金

column1: If Jerry ever knew how to read this cartridge, he's not telling now.
column2: 就算傑瑞以前知道怎麼讀這個資料匣，他現在也不會說了。

column1: You really shouldn't put the keycard back -- you're going to need it later.
column2: 你真的不該把磁卡放回去——你晚點還用得到。

column1: Jerry is beyond the need for a widget.
column2: 傑瑞已經用不著什麼強力磁鐵了。

column1: Jerry doesn't appear to be saying anything for the translator gadget to translate.
column2: 傑瑞看起來沒說什麼話，翻譯機沒東西可翻。

column1: You can't do that from your current position.
column2: 你現在這個位置做不了這件事。

column1: You can't do that from this level.
column2: 在這層樓，你做不了這件事。

column1: This is an elevator to one of the upper levels.
column2: 這是一部通往上層樓的電梯。

column1: Your search of %s reveals nothing even you'd carry.
column2: 你搜遍了 %s，連你這種什麼都撿的人都找不到半樣東西。

column1: You can't mess with anything that's not on your floor.
column2: 不是你這層樓的東西，你就別亂碰。

column1: Dead people sure are boring!
column2: 死人還真是無聊透頂！

column1: Gee, He doesn't smell bitter, taste him.
column2: 咦，他聞起來不苦耶，嚐嚐看。

column1: Hmmmm, still not bitter, just like you thought.
column2: 嗯……還是不苦，跟你想的一樣。

column1: You owed Dave a couple of Buckazoids, but there's not much point in repaying them now.
column2: 你欠戴夫幾個太空幣，不過現在還他也沒什麼意義了。

column1: Dave seems somehow disinterested in the cartridge.
column2: 戴夫對這個資料匣，似乎完全提不起興趣。

column1: Dave never had a keycard, and he sure doesn't need one now.
column2: 戴夫從來沒有磁卡，現在更是用不著了。

column1: Dave is remarkably unresponsive to your offer of a widget.
column2: 戴夫對你遞出的這個強力磁鐵，完全沒有反應。

column1: Dave has given up speaking for the rest of his life. Even the translator gadget won't help here.
column2: 戴夫這輩子是不會再開口說話了，就算翻譯機也幫不上忙。

column1: You can't manipulate anything not on your level.
column2: 不在你這層樓的東西，你動不了。

column1: Hey keep your tongue to yourself, slimeball.
column2: 喂，把你的舌頭收好，噁心鬼。

column1: Hey, she's wearing that really great perfume again, Eau DePain.
column2: 嘿，她又噴上那款超讚的「苦水香水」了。

column1: It's unlikely Blanche would appreciate the gesture.
column2: 布蘭琪大概沒辦法欣賞你這番心意。

column1: Blanche pays as much attention to you as she ever has.
column2: 布蘭琪一如既往地不理你。

column1: Blanche shows as much interet in the keycard as you might expect her to, being dead and all.
column2: 畢竟人都死了，布蘭琪對這張磁卡的興趣，正如你所預期的——一點都沒有。

column1: Your shiny new widget is not making much of an impression of Blanche, that's for sure.
column2: 你那個閃亮亮的新強力磁鐵，顯然沒有讓布蘭琪留下什麼印象，這是肯定的。

column1: The translation gadget does not appear to work if there's no speech to translate, and Blanche is remarkably quite lately.
column2: 如果沒有話可翻，翻譯機似乎也派不上用場——而布蘭琪最近可安靜得很。

column1: This elevator goes down.
column2: 這台電梯往下開。

column1: This elevator goes up.
column2: 這台電梯往上開。

column1: Your search of the body reveals nothing.
column2: 你搜遍屍體，什麼都沒找到。

column1: Gosh, Randy's even quieter in this state.
column2: 天哪，蘭迪這種狀態下更安靜了。

column1: Randy's recently re-exposed and re-heated lunch smells pretty good. You start to regret having slept through lunch.
column2: 蘭迪剛翻出來、重新加熱過的午餐聞起來還挺香的，你開始後悔自己把午餐時間睡掉了。

column1: Although it's darn tempting, all this tension has your stomach churning. The last thing it needs is more stomach acid, especially from someone else's stomach.
column2: 雖然真的很誘人，但這股緊張感已經讓你胃翻攪個不停。你的胃現在最不需要的，就是再多一點胃酸——尤其是別人胃裡的胃酸。

column1: Randy, usually a sucker for a Buckazoid, is showing a remarkable lack of interest.
column2: 蘭迪平常看到太空幣就走不動路，這次卻異常地沒興趣。

column1: Randy ignores your efforts to ask him about the cartridge, maybe because he's dead.
column2: 蘭迪完全不理你問資料匣的事，也許是因為他已經死了。

column1: Randy doesn't seem to want the keycard. His present condition may have something to do with this.
column2: 蘭迪好像不想要這張磁卡，可能跟他目前的狀態脫不了關係。

column1: Whatever this thing does, reanimating the dead does not appear to be one of them.
column2: 不管這東西是做什麼用的，讓死人復活顯然不在它的功能清單裡。

column1: Even you don't need a translator to get the message that Randy is D-E-A-D.
column2: 連你都不必靠翻譯機，也看得懂蘭迪已經死—透—了。

column1: Normally a pleasant guy to talk with, Hugh is pretty darn boring now.
column2: 休平常是個很健談的人，現在卻無聊到不行。

column1: Either you have a taste for sweat or you didn't smell him before you tried to taste him.
column2: 不是你口味特殊愛汗味，就是你舔他之前根本沒先聞一下。

column1: Hmmm. I think Hugh might have missed a shower or two. Or perhaps his body got sweaty from the heat of that laser blast.
column2: 嗯……我猜休可能好幾天沒洗澡了。或者，是被那發雷射轟出來的熱氣給薰出一身汗。

column1: Your money doesn't hold much interest for Hugh at this point
column2: 你的錢，對休來說，此刻已經沒有意義了

column1: Hugh offers you no help with the cartridge.
column2: 休沒辦法幫你查資料匣的事。

column1: If Hugh could speak, he'd tell you he doesn't want the keycard. He might also have something to say about your intelligence.
column2: 要是休還能開口，他大概會說他不想要這張磁卡，順便也會酸你的智商兩句。

column1: It's possible Hugh's only pretending disinterest in the widget. It's also possible he's still dead.
column2: 休也許只是裝作對這個強力磁鐵沒興趣。也可能，他還是老樣子——死的。

column1: Blatant, messy death requires no translation.
column2: 死得這麼慘烈又明顯，用不著翻譯。

column1: Widgets don't talk.
column2: 小裝置不會講話。

column1: It smells magnetic.
column2: 聞起來有磁性。

column1: It tastes quite metallic.
column2: 嚐起來滿有金屬味的。

column1: Hey, flow through ventilation! You'd best avoid those guys in the future.
column2: 嘿，那股氣是從通風口灌進來的！你以後最好離那些傢伙遠一點。

column1: It's a star. You don't do anything with it. If you get close enough though, it will do anything it wants to you.
column2: 那是一顆恆星。你對它做不了什麼。不過只要你靠得夠近，它要拿你怎麼樣都行。

column1: If you want to talk to a star, call the Elvis hotline.
column2: 想跟明星聊天喔？打去「貓王專線」試試看啊。

column1: It's a TV picture, remember?
column2: 這只是電視畫面而已，別忘了。

column1: It's tuned as well as it will come in. Let's face it, that guy's gonna be ugly no matter how you adjust it.
column2: 它已經調到能收到的最佳畫質了。老實說，不管你怎麼調，那傢伙看起來都醜。

column1: Alas, it is speechless.
column2: 唉，它沒法說話。

column1: Sure. Just go up and do any old thing you want. They look friendly.
column2: 喔對啊，你儘管走過去，想幹嘛就幹嘛，他們看起來人超好的。

column1: These guys carry weapons. How wise do you think that is?
column2: 這些傢伙可是帶著武器的，你覺得這樣做聰明嗎？

column1: You'd need to be closer for that.
column2: 你得再靠近一點才行。

column1: Sorry. It's just an incredible facsimile and not capable of functioning!
column2: 抱歉，這只是個做得惟妙惟肖的複製品，根本沒辦法運作！

column1: Boy, you're lonely!
column2: 老兄，你也太寂寞了吧！

column1: I don't think it's a good idea to be doing that kind of thing to someone else's joystick.
column2: 我看你還是別亂碰別人的搖桿比較好。

column1: Hey, you don't know were this thing has been!
column2: 嘿，你根本不知道這東西去過哪些地方！

column1: Though you've been known to have a fondness for manipulating small rodents, this one is obviously decorative (at least in someone's mind).
column2: 雖然大家都知道你喜歡摸小老鼠，但這隻顯然只是裝飾用的（至少某人是這麼想的）。

column1: I'm glad, for your sake, that no can see what you're trying to do.
column2: 看在你的份上，還好沒人看到你在幹嘛。

column1: Funny, it doesn't smell like a rodent.
column2: 奇怪，聞起來不像老鼠耶。

column1: Good thing that isn't a real mouse or you'd be hacking up furballs.
column2: 還好這不是真老鼠，不然你早就吐出一堆毛球了。

column1: Do you know how many hours you've spent cleaning view screens because of acts like that!
column2: 你知道自己花了多少小時，就是在擦掉你這種行為弄髒的螢幕嗎！

column1: BOING! Right back in your face those words did come.
column2: 咚！那些話就這樣彈回來，正中你的臉。

column1: Smells like viewdex with pneumonia-f.
column2: 聞起來就像得了F型肺炎的Viewdex機。

column1: Unfortunately, it tastes like viewdex with pneumonia-f!
column2: 很不幸，嚐起來也像得了F型肺炎的Viewdex機！

column1: These wires are way out of reach. Besides, you don't need them.
column2: 這些電線根本搆不到，而且你也用不著。

column1: Still looking for someone to understand you and see you for what you really are?
column2: 還在找一個真正懂你、看見真實自己的人喔？

column1: You can't smell them way up there.
column2: 它們掛得那麼高，你聞不到。

column1: They're too far away to taste.
column2: 離太遠了，嚐不到。

column1: As much as you feel like pounding out a colonically stimulating version of 'chopsticks', you realize that it's time to get serious about surviving. (At least, we think you do.)
column2: 你很想敲一段讓人腸胃翻攪的「筷子曲」，但你也明白，該是正經求生的時候了。（至少，我們是這麼希望的。）

column1: The keyboard has no sampler. That is what you meant to try, wasn't it?
column2: 這鍵盤沒有取樣功能。你該不會是想試試這個吧？

column1: It smells like lots of fingers pressed around this thing.
column2: 聞起來像是一堆手指在這上面摸來摸去。

column1: It tastes like lots of unclean fingers pressed around this thing.
column2: 嚐起來像是一堆不乾淨的手指在這上面摸來摸去。

column1: The incredibly huge cords are affixed to the deck and can't be moved.
column2: 這些粗到誇張的電纜線固定在地板上，動不了。

column1: Come to your senses.
column2: 清醒一點吧。

column1: It smells like vinyl-encased wiring.
column2: 聞起來像是包了塑膠外皮的電線。

column1: You must have something more important to do than going around sucking on vinyl insulation.
column2: 你應該有更重要的事情要做，而不是到處吸塑膠絕緣皮。

column1: You slide the keycard into the slot. The lock releases with a satisfying click, and the elevator doors slide open.
column2: 你把磁卡插進插槽，鎖「喀」一聲應聲彈開，電梯門緩緩滑開。

column1: The bay doors are currently open.
column2: 艙門目前是開著的。

column1: The bay doors are currently closed.
column2: 艙門目前是關著的。

column1: You overhear a couple of strange guys conversing nearby.
column2: 你偷聽到附近有幾個怪傢伙在交談。

column1: Through this window you can see down into the pod bay. A pod sits waiting on the launch track. The large bay doors are currently %s.
column2: 透過這扇窗，你可以看到下方的逃生艙艙房。一艘逃生艙正停在發射軌道上待命。那扇大艙門目前是%s。

column1: There are only a couple of buttons that look like they do anything.
column2: 看起來能用的按鈕就只有那幾個。

column1: You already have two other buttons to choose from.
column2: 你已經有另外兩個按鈕可以選了。

column1: These are locked down. They won't help you anyway.
column2: 這些都鎖死了，反正也幫不上忙。

column1: None of these buttons are operational at this time.
column2: 這些按鈕目前都沒有作用。

column1: A spacesuit hangs in the closet. A helmet sits on the top shelf.
column2: 櫃子裡掛著一套太空裝，最上層的架子上放著一頂頭盔。

column1: You notice some sort of gadget in the drawer.
column2: 你注意到抽屜裡有個像是小裝置的東西。

column1: There is nothing inside the drawer. You push the button and the drawer slides neatly back into place.
column2: 抽屜裡什麼都沒有。你按下按鈕，抽屜俐落地滑回原位。

column1: There are no controls on this panel. It is populated only by gauges and read-outs.
column2: 這面板上沒有任何控制裝置，只有一堆儀表和讀數顯示。

column1: Does that artificial gravity do the job, or what.
column2: 這個人工重力還真夠力，是吧。

column1: That concludes your experiment on the effects of vacuum on the unprotected human body. Wasn't that fun!
column2: 你這場「沒穿裝備直接暴露在真空中會怎樣」的實驗到此結束。好玩吧！

column1: The massive bay doors are %s.
column2: 那扇巨大的艙門目前是%s。

column1: You can't open the Bay doors from this room.
column2: 你沒辦法從這個房間打開艙門。

column1: Some alien anchorbeing is broadcasting a message about the stolen Star Generator.
column2: 某個外星「主播生物」正在播報星辰產生器遭竊的消息。

column1: A blank monitor hangs from the ceiling.
column2: 天花板上掛著一台沒畫面的螢幕。

column1: You exit the escape pod.
column2: 你走出逃生艙。

column1: Remove your seatbelt first. It works better.
column2: 先解開安全帶，這樣比較好用。

column1: Please press the desired button on the inset.
column2: 請按下面板上你想要的按鈕。

column1: This option works better with the power on.
column2: 開電源後這個選項才比較管用。

column1: You will need to leave the Launch Bay first.
column2: 你得先離開發射艙房才行。

column1: This option works only when clear of the Arcada.
column2: 只有在遠離阿寇達號之後，這個選項才有用。

column1: Nothing much will happen without power.
column2: 沒開電源的話，不會有什麼反應。

column1: Buckle up for safety, buckle up.
column2: 為了安全繫上安全帶，繫上安全帶。

column1: As you slide the throttle forward, you can feel the Arcada start to shake.
column2: 你把節流閥往前推，感覺到阿寇達號開始震動起來。

column1: Guess those doors are as strong as they look.
column2: 看來那些門真的跟外表一樣堅固。

column1: Through the open bay doors you can see a plethora of stars.
column2: 透過打開的艙門，你可以看到滿天星斗。

column1: Your view is limited by the closed bay doors.
column2: 艙門關著，擋住了你的視線。

column1: You don't need that right now.
column2: 你現在用不到這個。

column1: THIS BUTTON IS NOT TO BE PUSHED AT ANYTIME.
column2: 這個按鈕任何時候都絕對不准按！

column1: This is the power button for the escape pod.
column2: 這是逃生艙的電源按鈕。

column1: Gee, all of a sudden the engines have grown quiet. Boy, you sure were zooming along for quite some time.
column2: 天啊，引擎突然安靜下來了。老兄，你可真是飆了好長一段時間。

column1: Of course, the zooming part is over now since you've run out of fuel. You'll just float along on inertia with no control of your attitude or destination.
column2: 當然啦，飆速的部分已經結束了，因為你的燃料用光了。接下來你只能靠慣性漂流，沒辦法控制姿態或目的地。

column1: Yep, you're still drifting hopelessly through space. Bummer, eh?
column2: 沒錯，你還在太空裡漫無目的地漂流。有夠衰的，對吧？

column1: Hunger grows to a level where your body decides to start feasting on itself. In your last conscious thoughts it dawns on you that navigation of some sort might have been a big helper here.
column2: 飢餓感終於強到讓你的身體開始「自己吃自己」。在意識消失前的最後一刻，你才驚覺，早知道學點導航技術就好了。

column1: Please stay seated until the space pod has come to a complete stop. Thank you for your cooperation.
column2: 請在太空艙完全停妥前留在座位上，謝謝合作。

column1: The pod has gone through some changes. All systems seem to have died and the windshield is now embossed with a lovely mosaic pattern.
column2: 這艘逃生艙經歷了一番「大改造」：所有系統似乎都掛了，擋風玻璃現在還多了一層漂亮的馬賽克裂紋。

column1: The inside of the Arcada's escape pods is not exactly packed with luxurious appointments. However, when it comes to saving one's posterior, it's as good as a Rolls.
column2: 阿寇達號逃生艙的內裝說不上豪華舒適，不過講到保住你的屁股，它可比勞斯萊斯還管用。

column1: The pain fades away along with any sense of belonging to the community of the living. Your powerless pod drifts through space for eons, eventually being plowed by some primitive deep space probe. Knowing that your insurance deductible was much too high anyway, you gain a new appreciation for death.
column2: 痛楚漸漸消退，連同你屬於「活人世界」的那份歸屬感一起。失去動力的逃生艙就這樣在太空裡漂流了千秋萬世，最後被某艘原始的深空探測器一頭撞上。想到自己的保險自付額本來就貴得離譜，你反而對死亡有了全新的體悟。

column1: Please press the desired button.
column2: 請按下你想要的按鈕。

column1: Thank you for flying Arcada Getaway Podlines! It's nearly been a pleasure serving you. Tell a friend (if you've got one).
column2: 感謝您搭乘「阿寇達脫逃艙運」！為您服務差不多算是一種榮幸。要記得告訴朋友喔（如果你還有朋友的話）。

column1: This has been rendered inoperable due to the shock of that less-than-graceful landing.
column2: 在那次「毫不優雅」的降落衝擊下，這東西已經徹底報廢了。

column1: The fuel supply has expired.
column2: 燃料已經耗盡了。

column1: This button just doesn't work the same since the accident.
column2: 這顆按鈕自從那次意外後，就一直不太對勁。

column1: You have a feeling you shouldn't have pressed that button.
column2: 你有種預感，剛才不該按那顆按鈕的。

column1: Ouch! I think we've got some serious organ damage here! All of them, of course, could be easily replaced in the time period from which you've just arrived. However, a quick scenery check reveals that you are now in the Dark Ages. The only transplant you'll get here is from carcass to spit over flame.
column2: 哎唷！看來你的內臟嚴重受損了！這些器官在你原本那個時代其實都能輕鬆換新，可惜你現在人在黑暗時代。這裡唯一的「器官移植」，就是把你的屍體串起來架在火上烤。

column1: As you draw a few final lungfuls of oxygen through your newly-acquired sucking chest wound, you gleefully notice your final resting place is near beautiful Nottingham Castle - universally renowned for its inclusion in Sierra's 'Conquests of the Longbow'.
column2: 你透過新添的胸口破洞吸進最後幾口氧氣，卻開心地發現自己命喪的地方，離美麗的諾丁漢城堡不遠——那正是因為在 Sierra 出品的《Conquests of the Longbow》裡出現過而聲名遠播。

column1: Oh, my goodness! You're shocked to hear some highly inflammatory language making its way into your auditory canals. Must be some uncivilized ruffians in the nearby pub.
column2: 天哪！你驚訝地聽見一連串火爆的粗話鑽進耳朵裡，一定是附近酒吧那些沒教養的傢伙在鬧事。

column1: Well, you're dead again. We even warned you not to push that button. You have no one to blame but yourself for having to sit through a plug for another fine Sierra product. Maybe you'll follow directions next time. Thanks for playing (and all that stuff).
column2: 好啦，你又死了。我們都警告過你別按那顆按鈕了。現在得乖乖看一段其他 Sierra 好產品的廣告，也只能怪你自己。下次記得乖乖照指示做。謝謝遊玩（諸如此類的話）。

column1: The lack of fuel allows you to float aimlessly through space.
column2: 燃料耗盡讓你只能在太空裡漫無目的地飄。

column1: You are already thrusting through space.
column2: 你已經在太空中全速推進了。

column1: You have no need to remove your seatbelt.
column2: 你沒必要解開安全帶。

column1: Hey, this baby saved your life. The view out the window, however, might make you regret it.
column2: 嘿，這寶貝救了你一命。不過窗外的景色，可能會讓你後悔活下來。

column1: Dials galore populate the instrument console of the pod cabin.%s
column2: 逃生艙艙房的儀表板上，滿滿都是各種轉盤。%s

column1: This is the pod's instrument console. Dials, gauges, and a couple of controls fill out the board.%s
column2: 這是逃生艙的儀表板，上面滿是轉盤、儀表和幾個控制鈕。%s

column1: This is the lucky escapee's seat.%s
column2: 這是幸運逃生者的座位。%s

column1: Through the fractured pod window, you see utter desolation spread out before you. You suddenly feel very lonely.
column2: 透過逃生艙破裂的窗戶，你看見眼前是一片荒蕪，突然覺得好孤單。

column1: The window allows you an unrestricted view of the vast nothingness of space.
column2: 這扇窗讓你把浩瀚太空的一片虛無看得清清楚楚。

column1: The rugged landing liberated the survival kit from its mounting fixture.
column2: 這次硬著陸把求生包從固定架上震了下來。

column1: Within the survival kit are the necessities for surviving a brief stay in a less-than-hospitable environment.
column2: 求生包裡裝的是，在惡劣環境下撐一陣子的必需品。

column1: You can't get that now.
column2: 你現在拿不到那個。

column1: Nice lights, huh?
column2: 燈光不錯吧？

column1: This is a radar used by the Autonav system.
column2: 這是自動導航系統用的雷達。

column1: This button WASN'T to be pushed at anytime. Now that it's dead go crazy and push away.
column2: 這顆按鈕本來說什麼都不准按。不過反正它現在壞了，你要按幾下都隨便你。

column1: This is the power button for the escape pod.%s
column2: 這是逃生艙的電源開關。%s

column1: Erosion has drilled a small hole into the side of this section of vertebrae. What could be in there?
column2: 風化侵蝕在這節脊椎骨的側面鑽出一個小洞，裡面會有什麼呢？

column1: You don't have time for that. You're much too busy running for your life currently.
column2: 你沒空做這個，現在你正忙著逃命呢。

column1: This hole isn't of the edible variety.
column2: 這個洞不是可以吃的那種。

column1: The dark hole merely echoes your wondrous words.
column2: 這個漆黑的洞只是把你的金玉良言原封不動地回音給你聽。

column1: You pick up a faint scent of something organic. Maybe there's someone else on this Ken-forsaken planet.
column2: 你聞到一絲若有似無的有機物氣味，說不定這顆被肯拋棄的鬼行星上還有別人。

column1: Being in closer proximity would be helpful.
column2: 再靠近一點會比較有幫助。

column1: Cautiously, you decide to investigate further.
column2: 你小心翼翼地決定再深入調查看看。

column1: That should teach you not to be messing around in strange holes.
column2: 這下你該學乖了，別亂摸奇怪的洞。

column1: It's the hole you were jettisoned from when you were expelled from the cavern area.
column2: 這就是你被逐出洞穴區時，被彈射出來的那個洞。

column1: The cave is very small and empty, not unlike your grey matter.
column2: 這個洞穴又小又空，跟你的腦袋倒是挺像的。

column1: There's nothing you can do as there is no visible means of entry.
column2: 這裡看不到任何入口，你什麼都做不了。

column1: Your shout produces no response.
column2: 你大喊了一聲，什麼回應都沒有。

column1: It smells empty.
column2: 聞起來空空的。

column1: It tastes calcium-rich.
column2: 嚐起來鈣質豐富。

column1: I'd say that the widening of those cracks is an excellent indication that this thing is not a truly stable unit. And don't you hate the way it makes your brain bounce around like a handball in all that spare cranial space?
column2: 我看這些裂縫越裂越大，正好說明這東西一點也不穩固。而且你不覺得討厭嗎，你的腦袋在那一大片空蕩蕩的顱腔裡晃來晃去，活像顆手球。

column1: No doubt about it! There's going to be an accident (of one kind or another) on this shaky piece of calcium-rich matter.
column2: 肯定沒錯！這塊搖搖欲墜的鈣化骨頭，遲早會出點什麼意外。

column1: You've always got to push things to the limit, don't you? We warned you, but NO! YOU had to do it just one more time. Well, just wait 'til your father gets home!
column2: 你就是什麼事都要玩過頭，對吧？我們警告過你了，但是不行！你偏偏要再來一次。好啊，等你老爸回家有你好看的！

column1: If nothing else, it makes a pleasant thud.
column2: 至少，它摔下去的聲音還挺悅耳的。

column1: It was not known that you are a master of the protrusion toss! That was a fine effort.
column2: 沒想到你是丟骨頭高手！這一手真漂亮。

column1: It's the snapped spinal protrusion you dislodged - resulting in its present position on the sand.
column2: 這是你弄斷、震落的脊椎骨凸起物，就這樣掉在沙地上了。

column1: It must be a snapped spinal protrusion just sitting here, without, as yet, having succumbed to the nearly unresistable attraction of gravity.
column2: 這根斷裂的脊椎骨凸起物就這麼卡在這，還沒被幾乎無法抗拒的重力給拉下去。

column1: You've done all the relocation of this thing that your limited physique is capable of.
column2: 憑你這身有限的力氣，這東西能移動的部分，你都搬完了。

column1: I'll bet that if you COULD reach it from here, you WOULD pull that sucker down on your very own head.
column2: 我敢說如果你搆得到，你一定會把這東西拉下來砸在自己頭上。

column1: Hmm. It smells like a smashed vertebral protrusion. Of course, you're not a leading expert on the subject, so you might want a second opinion.
column2: 嗯……聞起來像是斷裂的脊椎骨凸起物。當然啦，你又不是這方面的權威專家，最好找個人再確認一下。

column1: Hmm. It smells like a vertebral protrusion you once knew.
column2: 嗯……聞起來像是你曾經認識的那根脊椎骨凸起物。

column1: Not much to report aurally.
column2: 聽覺上沒什麼好報告的。

column1: Gee! I thought everybody knew what sun-dried gigundasaurus bone smelled like.
column2: 哎呀！我還以為大家都知道曬乾的超巨龍骨頭聞起來是什麼味道呢。

column1: It would be like licking a dehydrated peach pit.
column2: 感覺就像在舔一顆脫水的桃核。

column1: The only talking ribs you'll ever see are in fast-food commercials.
column2: 你這輩子唯一會看到會講話的排骨，大概只有速食廣告裡那種。

column1: These teeth are in to stay.
column2: 這些牙齒是拔不下來的。

column1: Many years of sandblasting by the Keronian elements have given the skull a smooth finish.
column2: 柯羅娜星多年來的風沙洗禮，把這顆頭骨磨得光滑無比。

column1: Check out the claws on this sucker. We're talking major manicure action. Can't you imagine what it must have been like to serve as one of many hundreds of live meals the gigundasaurus must have shredded and refined internally in it's lifetime.
column2: 看看這傢伙的爪子，修剪起來可是一大工程。你能想像當年身為超巨龍一生中撕碎、消化的成百上千頓活體大餐之一，會是什麼滋味嗎？

column1: Can't you just feel the points of those talon-like claws slowly pressing through the thin outer-armour we call skin, popping through and separating ribs, and pushing aside anything it didn't pierce on the way, only to meet mid-torso.
column2: 你能感覺到那尖銳的爪尖，慢慢刺穿我們稱之為皮膚的那層薄薄外殼，一路戳破、撐開肋骨，把沿途沒刺穿的東西都推開，最後在軀幹中央會合嗎。

column1: The claws are much too large - not to mention much too deep in the sand - for you to do anything with.
column2: 這爪子太大了，而且埋在沙裡太深，你拿它一點辦法也沒有。

column1: Even without the fleshy matter which once enveloped parts of this claw, it won't be moving as a result of anything you could do.
column2: 就算包覆這爪子的血肉早已不在，它也不會因為你做什麼而移動半分。

column1: You notice a fine spray of glistening, metallic jelly decorating the walls. Otherwise, it's still the same old homey cave-in-a-skull.
column2: 你注意到牆上濺了一層亮晶晶的金屬色黏液，除此之外，這還是那個熟悉又溫馨的頭骨山洞。

column1: This skull makes a darn comfortable little cave if you ignore the disturbing human-size remains in the back.
column2: 只要別看後面那些令人不安、跟人差不多大的殘骸，這顆頭骨其實是個挺舒服的小山洞。

column1: You shiver at the sight of the spider droid entering the cave on its spindly legs. The cold metallic body searches for something to get up close and personal with. This could be interesting.
column2: 看到蜘蛛機器人踩著細長的腳走進洞裡，你不禁打了個寒顫。那冰冷的金屬軀體正在找東西親密接觸，這下有意思了。

column1: Now THAT was cool! That killed two problems with no stones.
column2: 這下真是帥呆了！一顆石頭都沒用，就順便解決了兩個麻煩。

column1: Orat, always in the mood for a snack, snatches the can out of the air with his spacious oral cavity, chews and swallows it. He notices a rumbling deep within his abdomen.
column2: 永遠都有心情吃點心的歐拉特，張開他那寬敞的大嘴把罐子從空中接住，嚼一嚼就吞下肚，接著他注意到肚子深處傳來一陣咕嚕聲。

column1: It's too late for that! You'd best jam!!
column2: 現在做什麼都太遲了！你最好拔腿就跑！！

column1: OH, NOOOOO!!!
Orat has transformed you into a new piece of recreational equipment. Along with finding this treatment extremely rude, you don't survive it.
column2: 歐拉特把你變成了一件全新的休閒器材。這種待遇不但沒禮貌到極點，你也沒能活著撐過去。

column1: It's tough to make friends around here. Relax, stretch out, restore, and let's get back to it. There's adventuring to be done!
column2: 在這裡交朋友還真不容易。放輕鬆，伸展一下筋骨，讀取存檔，我們重新來過。還有冒險等著你呢！

column1: It's too late for that now. Orat has already tuned his taste buds to your flavor frequency!
column2: 現在做什麼都太遲了，歐拉特的味蕾已經鎖定你的頻率了！

column1: That thing? The knife can barely cut through rancid grell lard, much less the thick hide of Orat.
column2: 那把刀？它連臭酸的格瑞爾油脂都快切不動了，更別說歐拉特那身厚皮。

column1: You think you can buy this guy off? HA!
column2: 你以為能用錢打發這傢伙？哈！

column1: The data cartridge seems to strike the orat as a big so what.
column2: 這個資料匣，歐拉特看了完全是一副「所以呢」的表情。

column1: The widget does not appear edible to the big smelly monster. On the other hand, you do.
column2: 這個強力磁鐵看起來不像能讓這隻臭烘烘的大怪物下嚥，不過你看起來倒是可以。

column1: Growwwwrrrr! Hmmm. Sounds the same in any language, doesn't it.
column2: 嗚嗚嗚嗚嗷嗚——！嗯，看來不管什麼語言，聽起來都一樣呢。

column1: Throwing him your survival kit does not seem the best strategy for your survival.
column2: 把求生包丟給牠，好像不是什麼保命的好招。

column1: Does he look like a vegatarian to you?
column2: 你看牠像素食主義者嗎？

column1: Though normally known for his intellectually stimulating conversation in the monster and beast community, Orat seems limited to grunts in the way of response to your probing questions.
column2: 雖然歐拉特在怪物與野獸界向來以談吐風趣、發人深省聞名，但面對你追根究柢的提問，他似乎只會發出哼哼聲回應。

column1: The stench? Phew! Not even a text adventure would attempt that description.
column2: 那股臭味？呼！就連文字冒險遊戲都不敢形容那是什麼味道。

column1: You wouldn't want to do that. From the stench, you can make an educated guess, and it isn't a pleasant one.
column2: 你不會想這麼做的。光聞那股臭味，你大概猜得到答案，而且絕對不是什麼好答案。

column1: You reach down and take the Orat part in your hand. Some of it oozes to fill the space between your fingers.
column2: 你伸手拿起那塊歐拉特的殘骸，有些黏液滲出來，填滿了你指縫間的空隙。

column1: You notice a fine spray of glistening, metallic jelly decorating the walls.
column2: 你注意到牆上濺了一層亮晶晶的金屬色黏液。

column1: The walls are blank. This place could use some sprucing-up. Perhaps a nice little wall hanging or a velvet Elvis painting could warm the look of the place a bit.
column2: 牆上光禿禿的，這地方需要好好裝飾一下。掛幅小壁飾，或是那種俗豔的貓王絨布畫，說不定能讓這裡看起來溫馨一點。

column1: There's nothing on the walls that you want or need.
column2: 牆上沒有你想要或需要的東西。

column1: Just leave those depressing remnants of unfortunate explorers alone, will you?
column2: 那些倒楣探險者留下的悲哀殘骸，你就別去碰了吧？

column1: They have surprisingly little to say. And if they did, would you really want to stay around to listen.
column2: 牠們其實沒什麼好說的。就算有，你真的會想留下來聽嗎。

column1: While you might be in the mood for a little skull, you've got more important business to tend to.
column2: 就算你現在很想把玩一下這顆頭骨，也還有更重要的事等著你去辦。

column1: Any scent these skulls may once have had is long gone, compliments of the the incredibly hot, dry climate.
column2: 這些頭骨原本可能有的氣味，早就被這裡酷熱乾燥的氣候徹底消滅了。

column1: You have trouble moving your own carcass around. You sure can't move something that weighs several times more than you. Besides, you left your truss back on the Arcada.
column2: 你連自己這副身子都搬得吃力，更別說搬動比你重上好幾倍的東西了。而且你的護腰工具還留在阿寇達號上呢。

column1: No odor is detectable.
column2: 偵測不到任何氣味。

column1: You've tasted better.
column2: 你嚐過更好吃的東西。

column1: While potentially an even conversational match for you, the rock has no speech mechanism.
column2: 雖然論聊天程度，這塊石頭搞不好跟你不相上下，但它畢竟沒有發聲構造。

column1: Other than the cave's special aroma, you smell nothing.
column2: 除了洞穴特有的那股味道，你什麼都聞不到。

column1: Give it a rest. It's going to be raw soon.
column2: 夠了啦，再這樣下去要磨到又紅又痛了。

column1: Nothing to do there.
column2: 那裡沒什麼好做的。

column1: Your words echo about the cavern, apparently not destined to fall on the ears of others.
column2: 你的話在洞穴裡迴盪，看來注定沒有別人聽得見。

column1: It smells like a musty old cave. They need Cave-B-Nu(tm).
column2: 聞起來像個發霉的舊山洞，這裡真該噴點「山洞芳新(tm)」。

column1: Nothing worth tasting there.
column2: 那裡沒什麼值得嚐的。

column1: Having an adequate personal collection of natural Keronian adhesive, you choose to leave this sticky gunk where it is.
column2: 你自認已經收藏了足夠的天然柯羅娜黏膠，於是決定讓這坨黏稠物待在原地。

column1: This stalagmite has obviously been broken loose previously and set back in place.
column2: 這根石筍顯然先前已經被折斷過，後來又被放回原位。

column1: The being responsible - most likely your Keronian counterpart - tried to fool everyone else by using some sticky gunk to hold it together. (Like that would actually fool anyone!.)
column2: 始作俑者——很可能是你在柯羅娜星的同類——想用黏稠物把它黏回去，藉此矇騙大家。（好像真的有人會被騙一樣！）

column1: You've already taken the stalagmite.
column2: 你已經拿走這根石筍了。

column1: You almost wish you had a table or breadboard to sand.
column2: 你幾乎希望手邊有張桌子或砧板可以拿來磨一磨。

column1: You flex those incredible muscles you wish you had, but you're barely able to snap loose the previously fractured stalagmite tip.
column2: 你使出想像中那身驚人的肌肉，好不容易才把早已裂開的石筍尖端折斷。

column1: I'll bet you're getting to truly hate this elevator.
column2: 我敢說你現在對這台電梯已經恨之入骨了吧。

column1: Hey! What's the deal here?! That elevator doesn't lower - it sucks!
column2: 嘿！這是怎麼回事？！這台電梯才不是慢慢降下去——它是用吸的把你吸下去！

column1: Although you imagine yourself a buff individual, you could effect no change in the tube door.
column2: 雖然你自認一身肌肉，但你對這扇管道門完全起不了作用。

column1: With professional pride, you observe that the door polish these guys use tastes different than your favorite brand.
column2: 你帶著職業般的自豪發現，這些傢伙拿來擦門的亮光劑，嚐起來跟你愛用的牌子不一樣。

column1: The scent of Berzzleweeze Berry rises to be sampled olifactorally. Must be their polish.
column2: 一股「博茲莓」的香氣飄了上來，供你的鼻子品鑑一番，想必是他們用的亮光劑味道。

column1: These are stalagmites. They stand silently, just as they have done for so many centuries.
column2: 這些是石筍，它們幾世紀以來都是這樣靜靜地佇立著。

column1: They are as solid as rocks and resistant to any manipulation.
column2: 它們跟石頭一樣堅固，任你怎麼弄都不為所動。

column1: It said to tell you that it's in a meeting and won't be out all day. Please check again in another version or two.
column2: 它要我轉告你，它現在在開會，一整天都不會出來。麻煩你等下一兩個版本後再來看看。

column1: The stalagmite has no smell.
column2: 這根石筍聞起來沒什麼味道。

column1: It didn't have a taste but its texture gave your tongue that nice rough-out leather look.
column2: 嚐起來沒什麼味道，不過那粗糙的質地，讓你的舌頭多了一層「絨面皮革」的手感。

column1: These are stalactites. They just hang there politely minding their own business.
column2: 這些是鐘乳石，就這麼乖乖掛在那邊，管好自己的事，不干涉別人。

column1: You can't. Not without the ladder. (See nose message.)
column2: 辦不到，沒有梯子不行。（參見「鼻子」的訊息。）

column1: You can't. Not without the ladder. (See tongue message.)
column2: 辦不到，沒有梯子不行。（參見「舌頭」的訊息。）

column1: You can't reach any of them without the ladder.
column2: 沒有梯子，你一個都碰不到。

column1: What do you mean, you don't have the ladder?
column2: 什麼叫你沒有梯子？

column1: Oh, sorry! We don't let you have one of those until Space Quest III.
column2: 喔，抱歉！這個要等到《宇宙傳奇III》才會給你喔。

column1: Did I mention that Space Quest III was the Software Publisher's Association Award-winning Best Adventure Game for 1989?
column2: 我剛剛有提到《宇宙傳奇III》拿下了1989年軟體出版商協會的最佳冒險遊戲獎嗎？

column1: You don't care? Sorry. Never mind.
column2: 你不在乎喔？好啦，當我沒說。

column1: It's an unconsolidated mixture of rock fragments and pebbles.
column2: 這是一堆鬆散的碎石和小石子，沒什麼結構可言。

column1: Unless you get into the masonry field or concrete business they will be of no use.
column2: 除非你以後想做泥水或水泥生意，不然這些東西一點用都沒有。

column1: YAaachooo!!! Quit sniffing gravel! It makes me sneeze.
column2: 哈啾！！！別再聞碎石了啦！害我一直打噴嚏。

column1: Oh, that's disgusting. Keep running your tongue along the floor like that and you're bound to catch something you don't want.
column2: 噁，這也太噁心了吧。你這樣一直用舌頭舔地板，遲早會惹上什麼髒東西。

column1: No one here cares what you have to say.
column2: 這裡沒有人想聽你講話。

column1: You get a hint of sulfur in the musty air.
column2: 你在這股霉味中聞到一絲硫磺味。

column1: It's a grate monster. At the moment ,he's stuck on something - fortunately not you.
column2: 這是隻章魚怪，牠現在被什麼東西纏住了——還好不是你。

column1: It's a grate monster. I'll bet he's lonely and just wants to be your friend.
column2: 這是隻章魚怪，我猜牠只是太寂寞了，想跟你交朋友而已。

column1: It smells grate.
column2: 聞起來還「鐵」讚的。

column1: I don't think you want to get that close. Then again, maybe you do.
column2: 我猜你應該不會想靠那麼近吧。不過……也許你就是想找死。

column1: You now have a chance get your buns out of here. You'd better take advantage of the opportunity.
column2: 你現在有機會可以開溜了，最好把握這次機會。

column1: Get closer.
column2: 靠近一點。

column1: This is the upper pathway.
column2: 這是上層通道。

column1: A path is visible there, but you can't seem to access it from here.
column2: 那邊看得到一條路，但你從這裡好像過不去。

column1: This is the lower pathway.
column2: 這是下層通道。

column1: There is a path there which you don't seem to have access to from here.
column2: 那邊有條路，不過你從這裡好像走不過去。

column1: It's more cave floor.
column2: 就是一片洞穴地板而已。

column1: The grate is made of metal and seems to be fastened securely to the floor. A strange tentacled beast lurks at the bottom of the pit.
column2: 這片柵欄是金屬做的，看起來牢牢固定在地上。坑底潛伏著一隻詭異的章魚怪。

column1: The grate is made of metal and seems to be fastened securely to the floor. It is too dark to see down through the grate. However, an odd smell emanates from the depths of the pit.
column2: 這片柵欄是金屬做的，看起來牢牢固定在地上。裡面太暗了，看不清楚柵欄下方，不過坑底深處飄來一股怪味。

column1: This critter isn't interested in your money - he perfers raw, bleeding flesh.
column2: 這隻怪物對你的錢一點興趣都沒有——牠比較想吃鮮血淋漓的生肉。

column1: You doubt this hideous creature could help you read the cartridge.
column2: 你很懷疑這隻醜陋的怪物能幫你讀取資料匣。

column1: The monster is much less interested in the widget than in stripping the flesh from your bones.
column2: 比起那個強力磁鐵，這隻怪物更想把你啃到只剩骨頭。

column1: The disgusting slimy, slimy, slurping, slithering sounds from the grate would not be improved by running them through the translator gadget.
column2: 柵欄裡傳出那些噁心黏糊、滑溜溜、啪滋啪滋的聲音，就算拿去翻譯機轉一轉，也不會變好聽。

column1: You might be able to cut off one head, but, meanwhile, the others would be turning you into fresh-ground turkey.
column2: 你或許能砍掉一顆頭，但同一時間，其他幾顆頭早就把你絞成新鮮火雞肉泥了。

column1: You really don't feel like sharing your precious dehydrated water with snake-face here.
column2: 你實在不想把你那瓶珍貴的濃縮水，分給這位蛇臉怪。

column1: He's hungry, but not THAT hungry.
column2: 牠是餓，但還沒餓成那樣。

column1: Don't waste your time. It's already stuck and you've got better things to do.
column2: 別浪費時間了，那東西已經黏住了，你還有更重要的事要做。

column1: You don't need to do that again.
column2: 你不需要再做一次。

column1: Don't waste your time. You've got better things to do than throw your items in an empty pit.
column2: 別浪費時間了，把東西丟進空蕩蕩的坑裡，你還有更重要的事情可以做。

column1: CRUNCH! CRUNCH! CRUNCH!
column2: 喀嚓！喀嚓！喀嚓！

column1: You've been snatched out of existence by the tentacled beast lurking beneath the grate. You feel the painful sting of digestive fluids.

column2: 沒錯，看你最近拖著它到處跑，現在來個蒸氣洗禮好像也不錯，只是要小心臉皮會被燙脫一層。

column2: 這扇門很奇怪，緊閉著，看不出有什麼開門的機關。

column2: 你沒辦法用手把門打開。

column2: 你盯著那灘泛綠的液體看，這是這顆星球上第一個像樣的水源跡象。這灘水池似乎深不見底，輕輕滴落的水聲讓你緊繃的神經稍微放鬆下來。每一滴水落在水面上，都會揚起一小陣霧氣。

column1: You can't see anything from up here.
column2: 你在這上面什麼都看不到。

column1: Drip, drip, drip. It must be talking to you.
column2: 滴、滴、滴。這一定是在跟你說話。

column1: Nah, not here. Try using it somewhere else.
column2: 不行啦，這裡用不了，去別的地方試試看。

column2: 天花板的細小裂縫中，幾滴液體受不了地心引力，滴落了下來。

column1: A light-green mist floats gently upward after each drop of liquid hits the surface of the pool.
column2: 每滴液體落到水面上，就會揚起一陣淡綠色的薄霧，緩緩往上飄。

column1: From tiny cracks in the ceiling several small green drops fall in a gently rhythmic pattern that stimulates your alpha levels. They make a heckuva great rust remover, too.
column2: 天花板的細縫裡，幾滴綠色液滴以輕柔的節奏落下，讓你的腦波都跟著放鬆。順帶一提，這玩意兒拿來除鏽效果也是一流。

column1: There's nothing you can do to these from here.
column2: 從這裡你對這些東西沒轍。

column1: They're hard to catch, but you do get a slight burning sensation.
column2: 這些不好接，不過你確實感覺到一陣輕微的灼熱感。

column2: 這些不好接，你可能得直接站到它們正下方才行。

column1: They're too busy falling right now.
column2: 它們現在正忙著往下掉呢。

column1: You are unpleasantly surprised by a drop of searing acid which bores its way to your feet.
column2: 一滴滾燙的酸液毫無預警地燒穿到你的腳，讓你嚇了一大跳。

column1: Now, that's some seriously deep pain.
column2: 這下可是痛到骨子裡了。

column1: You lean over to drink from the tempting pool of liquid. As your lips touch the fluid, you feel a pain which could be likened to kissing a lit rocket nozzle. Now you know what they mean when they say 'Don't drink the water.'
column2: 你彎下腰，想喝一口這誘人的池水。嘴唇一碰到液體，你感覺到的痛楚，簡直像親吻一具正在點火的火箭噴嘴。現在你終於懂了，人家說「別喝那裡的水」是什麼意思。

column1: You lean over the pool to get a good solid whiff, and WHOOA! Talk about clean sinuses!
column2: 你彎下腰，狠狠吸了一大口水池的味道，哇喔！這下鼻竇是徹底通了！

column1: That's right. You have no head. That darn pool must be filled with acid. You obviously can't go on living that way.
column2: 沒錯，你已經沒有頭了。這灘該死的水池裡裝的一定是酸液，你這樣顯然是活不下去了。

column1: Having seen no other intelligent(?) being for so long, you decide to save your voice.
column2: 這麼久都沒見到其他（算得上）有智慧的生物，你決定還是省點口水吧。

column1: You detect a bit of sulfur in the air from the adjoining chamber. Each inhalation packs a bit of an afterburn as an extra, added bonus.
column2: 你在隔壁密室飄來的空氣中聞到一絲硫磺味，每吸一口都附贈一點灼燒感當作額外獎勵。

column1: You've found quite a number of forms to transform yourself into. This is the first time you've been wafer-style.
column2: 你已經變過不少種死法了，不過變成薄片狀，這還是頭一遭。

column1: Well, Scott, it looks like Roger has done it yet another time.
column2: 嗯，史考特，看來羅傑這次又搞砸了。

column1: It sure seems that way. For those who might have missed that last move by Roger, or if, like me, you just want another look at it, let's roll it again.
column2: 看起來是這樣沒錯。如果有觀眾剛剛錯過羅傑那招，或者像我一樣還想再看一次，那就讓我們重播一遍吧。

column1: You've got to give some high marks for truly fine execution. We'll have to give it a strong 9.8.

column2: 你才踏進房間，四周立刻陷入一片漆黑。你突然發現自己動彈不得，連話都說不出來——一股陌生的詭異力量，已經整個接管了你。

column1: It begins to speak ....

column1: So, you have found your way to my hallowed chamber. Fortunately there is much more to you than meets the eye.
column2: 「哈，你找到了通往我這神聖密室的路。算你走運，你這傢伙深藏不露。」

column2: 「我一直在監看你在我們星球上的行蹤。看樣子你是叫天不應叫地不靈，沒有代步工具可用啊。」

column1: In other words, you're on the leather express, slapping the dogs, pounding the sand, you'd kill for a fine ride.
column2: 換句話說，你就是正港的十一路公車——兩腳走天下，一路踩沙，你現在願意拿命去換一台像樣的車。

column1: You hear a voice, different this time, beckoning you to step forward.

column1: This computer is so ancient, it probably doesn't even respond to voice input.
column2: 這台電腦老到不行，搞不好連語音輸入都不認得。

column1: From the smell of it, you'd guess that at least one Keronian uses it quite regularly to play one of your favorite computer games: "Name that Body Odor!"
column2: 從味道判斷，你猜至少有一個柯羅娜人常常用它來玩你最愛的電腦遊戲之一：『猜猜這是什麼體味！』

column1: Licking the chair suddenly seems like a big waste of energy.
column2: 舔這張椅子，突然覺得超浪費力氣的。

column1: The chair does not respond. What did you expect?
column2: 這張椅子沒有反應。你還期待什麼？

column1: There's no way to force the portal open.
column2: 沒辦法硬把這扇門撬開。

column1: You don't want to touch the pipes - they're probably hot.
column2: 你不會想碰這些管子的——搞不好燙得很。

column1: Talking to pipes is considered a sign of insanity on the planet Kerona.
column2: 在柯羅娜星上，跟水管講話會被當成發瘋的表現。

column1: Smells like some kind of duct tape.
column2: 聞起來像某種膠帶。

column1: You'll get a nasty burn on your tongue if you try that.
column2: 你要是這樣試，舌頭肯定燙出水泡。

column1: You can't reach them. The skylights are much to high.
column2: 你搆不到，那些天窗太高了。

column1: You're truly starved for conversation on your intellectual.
column2: 你顯然是悶壞了，才會想找個跟自己程度差不多的東西聊天。

column1: Try as you might, you can't smell the skylights from down there. Just as you are about to pass out from hyper- ventilation, you sensably decide to abandon this particular project.
column2: 你再怎麼努力，也聞不到站在下面的那些天窗。就在你快要因為過度換氣昏過去之前，你總算理智地決定放棄這個念頭。

column1: Although the skylights look like gigantic oysters, I doubt very much if they would taste anything like them.
column2: 雖然這些天窗看起來像巨大的牡蠣，但你很懷疑它們吃起來會有牡蠣的味道。

column1: It doesn't look as though it will budge.
column2: 看起來這東西動都不會動。

column1: The skimmer platform has nothing to say to you.
column2: 沙漠飛車的平台懶得理你。

column1: It smells a lot like everything else around here. Except more so.
column2: 它聞起來跟這附近其他東西差不多，只是味道更重一點。

column1: That doesn't seem at all appetizing.
column2: 這看起來一點都不開胃。

column1: It doesn't seem intelligent to mess with it.
column2: 亂動這個感覺不太聰明。

column1: The generator doesn't respond. Perhaps it's based on some form of A.S. (Artificial Stupidity).
column2: 這台產生器沒反應。搞不好它裝的是某種『人工智障』(A.S., Artificial Stupidity)。

column1: You catch scents of iron oxide, burning rubber and fusel oil. It makes you momentarily homesick for Mom's cooking.
column2: 你聞到一股氧化鐵、燒焦橡膠混雜工業酒精的味道。這味道讓你一時想起了老媽的廚藝，鄉愁都上來了。

column1: This thing looks hot enough to fry your tongue like an egg.
column2: 這東西看起來燙到可以把你的舌頭煎成荷包蛋。

column1: Even if you could reach it, there's no way you'd stick your hands near those things.
column2: 就算你搆得到，你也不會想把手伸近那些東西。

column1: The Keronians have a place they put people who are in the habit of talking to steam vents.
column2: 柯羅娜人專門有個地方，關那些習慣跟蒸氣孔講話的人。

column1: You detect no particular odor coming from the steam.
column2: 你聞不到這股蒸氣有什麼特別的味道。

column1: You were never fond of broiled tongue.
column2: 你向來不喜歡烤舌頭這道菜。

column1: You decide not to. They're so rusty, they might crumble and bring the whole place down.
column2: 你決定不要。這些東西鏽成這樣，搞不好一碰就垮，把整個地方都弄塌。

column1: The cylinders don't answer, of course.
column2: 這些汽缸當然不會回答你。

column1: You suspect that they smell like rusty metal, since that's what they are made of.
column2: 你猜它們聞起來像生鏽的金屬，畢竟它們本來就是金屬做的。

column1: Licking the cylinder seems like a waste of time and tongue- power.
column2: 舔這個汽缸感覺是在浪費時間跟舌頭的力氣。

column1: You get the feeling they might be hot.
column2: 你有種預感，這些東西可能很燙。

column1: The Keronians are going to think you're loony if you keep talking to inanimate objects.
column2: 你再這樣跟沒生命的東西講話，柯羅娜人會覺得你瘋了。

column1: All pipes wrapped in duct tape smell alike to you.
column2: 所有纏著膠帶的管子，聞起來對你來說都一個樣。

column1: The thought of your tongue stuck, sizzling, to the hot steam pipe is not a pleasant one.
column2: 想到舌頭黏在滾燙的蒸氣管上滋滋作響，實在讓人開心不起來。

column1: You tap on a gauge. The needle quivers, then returns to its original position.
column2: 你敲了敲儀表。指針抖了一下，又回到原本的位置。

column1: Talking to pipes (or dials) is considered a sign of insanity on the planet Kerona.
column2: 在柯羅娜星上，跟水管(或儀表)講話會被當成發瘋的表現。

column1: The gauge doesn't smell like anything in particular.
column2: 這個儀表聞起來沒什麼特別的味道。

column1: Don't put your mouth on that - you don't know where it's been!
column2: 別把嘴巴湊上去——你根本不知道那東西碰過什麼髒東西！

column1: The floor is made of polished slate. It is very smooth to the touch, slightly damp, and quite warm.
column2: 地板是拋光石板做的。摸起來很滑，有點濕氣，而且相當溫暖。

column1: The floor doesn't respond to your witty reparte'.
column2: 地板才不會理你這套機智反駁。

column1: A smell of damp, hot stone rises from the floor.
column2: 地板散發出一股潮濕、溫熱石頭的氣味。

column1: Although the floor seems pretty clean, you'd rather not put it to the taste... er... test.
column2: 雖然地板看起來還算乾淨，你還是不想拿舌頭去『嚐』……呃，是說『試』一下。

column1: A data cartridge.
column2: 一個資料匣。

column1: It smells like it's loaded with data.
column2: 聞起來裡面塞滿了資料。

column1: YUCKK! It tastes like... well, not data. That's for sure.
column2: 噁！嚐起來像……嗯，反正不是資料的味道，這點倒是肯定的。

column1: The cartridge snaps neatly into the slot and the screen comes alive.
column2: 資料匣喀地一聲穩穩卡進插槽，螢幕跟著亮了起來。

column1: LOADING
column2: 讀取中

column1: Whoever shall read this: My name is Dr. Slash Vohaul, I am a scientist with The Star Generator Project aboard the Starlab Arcada.
column2: 「見信如晤：我叫史萊許·沃霍爾博士，是阿寇達號『星辰產生器計畫』的科學家。」

column1: We have just successfully completed development and testing of The Star Generator. During this time I have come to believe that our progress has been monitored by others. I fear that the Sariens may have learned of our mission.
column2: 「我們剛順利完成了星辰產生器的研發與測試。這段期間，我漸漸相信我們的進度一直被人監視。我擔心沙利安人可能已經得知我們的任務。」

column1: If my fears prove true, The Star Generator and the people of our universe are in serious jeopardy.
column2: 「如果我的擔憂成真，星辰產生器，還有我們宇宙裡所有人的性命，都將陷入嚴重的危機。」

column1: The Star Generator is a miraculous device. Used as intended, it will help preserve life for eons to come.
column2: 「星辰產生器是一台奇蹟般的裝置。只要照原本的用途使用，它能幫助生命延續千秋萬世。」

column1: Used as a device for evil, it would cause the destruction of millions of lives and enslave all who oppose the Sariens.
column2: 「但若被用來做壞事，它會摧毀數百萬條性命，並奴役所有反抗沙利安人的人。」

column1: Encoded within this cartridge are all the plans and specifications for the construction of the Star Generator.
column2: 「這個資料匣裡，存有建造星辰產生器所需的全部藍圖與規格。」

column1: Should any disaster befall the Star Generator project, scientists would be able to create a duplicate of the Star Generator with this information.
column2: 「萬一星辰產生器計畫遭逢什麼不測，科學家還能靠這份資料重建出一台一模一樣的星辰產生器。」

column1: Please guard it with your life and return it to the Xenon ruling body as quickly as possible.
column2: 「請你拚了命也要保護好它，並儘快把它送回氙星的統治機構。」

column1: Important note: The Star Generator is capable of self-destruction. This was introduced to the system as a precaution. To activate it one must enter the code: %4d
column2: 「重要提醒：星辰產生器具備自毀功能，這是系統為了預防萬一而設計的。要啟動自毀，必須輸入密碼：%4d」

column1: A five minute time will begin to count down. Beware - anyone within five kilometers of the Star Generator will be in danger once the timer has been initiated. Please be careful and GOOD LUCK !
column2: 「屆時將會開始五分鐘的倒數計時。當心——計時器一旦啟動，任何在星辰產生器方圓五公里內的人都會身陷險境。請務必小心，祝你好運！」

column1: You note with satisfaction that the skimmer smells exactly like you expected it to.
column2: 你滿意地發現，沙漠飛車聞起來正如你所預期的味道。

column1: Raw skimmer is not one of your favorite dishes.
column2: 生的沙漠飛車不是你喜歡的菜色。

column1: The skimmer doesn't appear to activate by voice. See if there's a key.
column2: 沙漠飛車看起來沒辦法用聲控啟動。找找看有沒有鑰匙。

column1: Smells like fresh spray paint.
column2: 聞起來像剛噴的油漆味。

column1: You're not that hungry.
column2: 你沒那麼餓。

column1: The ladder has nothing to say to you.
column2: 梯子沒什麼好跟你說的。

column1: You can't reach them.
column2: 你搆不到。

column1: The faint scent of burning dust surrounds the tubes.
column2: 那些管子周圍瀰漫著一股淡淡的燒焦灰塵味。

column1: Your tongue would probably stick to those like chops on a griddle.
column2: 你的舌頭舔上去，大概會像煎盤上的排骨一樣黏住。

column1: Although bright, the glass tubes have little light to shed upon your current situation. In short, they are not sparkling conversationalists.
column2: 雖然這些玻璃管很亮，但對你目前的處境沒什麼幫助。簡單說，它們算不上什麼妙語如珠的對話對象。

column1: Don't bother the guy - he's busy.
column2: 別煩這傢伙了，他很忙。

column1: The underarm odor potential of this Keronian is truly staggering. Too bad this place has never heard of deodorant.
column2: 這個柯羅娜人腋下的味道潛力驚人，可惜這地方從沒聽過什麼叫除臭劑。

column1: He's got a wrench, and he knows how to use it.
column2: 他手上有把扳手，而且很會用。

column1: He doesn't seem interested in your money. This company must pay pretty well.
column2: 他對你的錢好像沒興趣，這家公司薪水想必開得不錯。

column1: He's seen a million of these. So what?
column2: 這種東西他看過幾百萬次了，那又怎樣。

column1: He's really too absorbed in his work to pay any attention to the widget.
column2: 他太專注在工作上了，根本沒空理會那個強力磁鐵。

column1: Since this guy has nothing to say to you anyway, translating it will probably amount to about the same thing.
column2: 反正這傢伙也沒什麼話想跟你說，翻不翻譯結果都差不多。

column1: He's just too busy to care that you're making such a generous gesture.
column2: 他忙到沒空在意你這麼大方的舉動。

column1: The young Keronian is not interested in seeing your toys.
column2: 這個年輕的柯羅娜人沒興趣看你的玩具。

column1: He probably doesn't want you to fool with it.
column2: 他大概不希望你亂碰那個東西。

column1: When ARE you going to learn not to put strange things in your mouth?
column2: 你到底什麼時候才學得會，不要什麼奇怪的東西都往嘴裡塞？

column1: There's no fuel odor - this puppy runs on fourteen D cells and a nine volt.
column2: 沒有燃料的味道──這小傢伙是靠十四顆一號電池加一顆九伏特電池跑的。

column1: What's the point of talking to this thing?
column2: 跟這東西講話有什麼意義？

column1: It's too far away, but don't worry; in this game you will undoubtedly get the shaft at least once.
column2: 太遠了搆不到，不過別擔心──這款遊戲保證會讓你至少栽在這根「軸」上一次。

column1: Oh, let's not and just say we did, OK?
column2: 唉，不然這樣，我們就當作做過了，好嗎？

column1: The smell of grease in this place seems to come from the shaft's general vicinity.
column2: 這地方的油漬味，聞起來是從那根軸附近傳來的。

column1: There's nothing visible on the computer screen.
column2: 電腦螢幕上什麼都沒顯示。

column1: The data is being replayed, but you never have much cared for re-runs, have you?
column2: 資料正在重播，不過你向來對重播沒什麼興趣，對吧？

column1: You might need to insert a data cartridge for this thing to work.
column2: 這東西大概要插入資料匣才能運作。

column1: He doesn't seem interested in shaking hands, though he certainly has enough of them.
column2: 他好像沒興趣跟你握手，雖然他的手還真不少。

column1: He seems to have said everything he wants to say to you.
column2: 他該講的話好像都講完了。

column1: That wouldn't be at all polite.
column2: 那樣做一點也不禮貌。

column1: You're not really that rude.
column2: 你其實沒那麼沒禮貌。

column1: All my needs are provided by the Company. I have no need of money.
column2: 公司什麼都幫我打點好了，我用不著錢。

column1: Your data cartridge resembles the ones we use to store information.
column2: 你的資料匣看起來跟我們用來存資料的那種很像。

column1: Be careful not to get that magnetic device too close to my hover platform. It could have a negative effect on the circuitry.
column2: 小心別把那個磁性裝置拿太靠近我的懸浮平台，不然電路搞不好會壞掉。

column1: Since you understand him fine, you figure either the gadget is already working or he's speaking perfect Xenonian.
column2: 你聽得懂他在說什麼，看來不是這小裝置已經在運作，就是他氙星語講得超標準。

column1: Thank you, strange one, but we have all the water we need here underground. you should save what little you have for the desert.
column2: 謝了，怪傢伙，不過我們在地底下水多得很，你手上那一點點還是留著在沙漠裡用吧。

column1: Ah, a genuine Xenon Army Knife. My youngest son got one of those in his last package of Hackersnaxs.
column2: 啊，這是正牌的氙星軍刀。我小兒子上次買的一包駭客脆餅裡就附贈了一支。

column1: If you could taste the steam, you might detect a bit of sulfur. But, since you can't, you don't.
column2: 要是你嚐得出蒸汽的味道，或許能嚐到一點硫磺味。可惜你嚐不出來，所以就沒嚐到。

column1: The steam is too far away for you to smell directly. However, there is a trace of sulfur in the air.
column2: 蒸汽離得太遠，你聞不到。不過空氣中確實帶著一絲硫磺味。

column1: This section is an Arcade sequence. Would you like to Play or Skip this sequence.
column2: 這一段是穿插的小遊戲。你要選擇「開始」還是「跳過」？

column1: Maybe you could try playing the arcade sequence next time.
column2: 也許你下次可以試著玩玩看這段小遊戲。

column1: Congratulations, you made it through without a scratch.
column2: 恭喜你，毫髮無傷地通過了。

column1: That was pretty intense.
column2: 剛剛還真是驚心動魄。

column1: Late Warning: The big rock cuts you no slack.
column2: 遲來的警告：那顆大石頭可不會放過你。

column1: Had you eaten a few less doughnuts during the mission, you might have cleared that rock.
column2: 要是你這次任務少吃幾個甜甜圈，或許就閃得過那顆石頭了。

column1: That would be unwise. The pod is still hot from the high-speed entry of the Keronian atmosphere.
column2: 這樣做不太明智，逃生艙才剛高速衝進柯羅娜星的大氣層，現在還燙得很。

column1: The fractured windshield is of no value to you.
column2: 那片裂開的擋風玻璃對你沒什麼用。

column1: The pod's windshield is cracked beyond repair. The built-in plasti-seal film between the glass layers managed to keep the shield in place with one minor exception, despite the shocks from the landing (if that's what you want to call it).
column2: 逃生艙的擋風玻璃已經裂到沒救了。玻璃夾層之間內建的塑膠密封膜，撐過了降落時的猛烈衝擊（如果那也算「降落」的話），讓整片玻璃大致還算完整──只有一個小地方例外。

column1: That would be unwise. The pod drives are still hot and not suitable for handling by humans.
column2: 這樣做不太明智，逃生艙的推進器還燙著，不適合人類徒手碰觸。

column1: The rocks are useless. At the slightest touch, they crumble to dust.
column2: 這些石頭沒什麼用，輕輕一碰就碎成粉末。

column1: Your sense of the ridiculous keeps you from walking off the edge and falling to a certain death on the treacherous rocks below.
column2: 你多少還有點自知之明，才沒有直接走出邊緣，摔到下面那堆危險亂石上必死無疑。

column1: Whew! That was close.
column2: 呼，好險。

column1: Whoa! Those big guys pack a powerful appetite. Did you feel the way that thing just chomped right through your skeletal system? That had to hurt! The grell burps in solitary satisfaction. He doesn't often get nice, warm meals like you.
column2: 哇喔！這些大傢伙食量真不是蓋的。你有感覺到剛剛那東西是怎麼一口咬穿你整副骨骼的嗎？那一定超痛的！格瑞爾滿足地打了個嗝，畢竟像你這種熱騰騰的美味大餐，牠可不常吃得到。

column1: That's funny. Tiny is nowhere to be seen.
column2: 奇怪了，小不點怎麼不見蹤影。

column1: No response from that.
column2: 那東西沒有反應。

column1: You detect a bit of sulfur in the air here as well. You're getting quite tired of that smell, aren't you? I'm a friend. We can talk.
column2: 這裡的空氣中也帶著一絲硫磺味，你大概已經聞到有點膩了吧？我是朋友，我們可以聊聊。

column1: Don't lick the air. You're libel to get more more than you bargained for.
column2: 別舔空氣，你可能會嘗到超乎預期的東西。

column1: You proudly climb into your new used spacecraft. There is definitely something unique about it.
column2: 你得意洋洋地爬進你那艘全新的二手太空船，這艘船還真有種說不出的特別。

column1: You turn the key excitedly.
column2: 你興奮地轉動鑰匙。

column1: Drat! Where did mom and dad go wrong? You be the judge.
column2: 見鬼了！爸媽當初到底是哪裡教壞了？你自己評評理吧。

column1: You can't do anything to this stucco-style ship house.
column2: 這棟灰泥風格的太空船屋，你拿它沒轍。

column1: It responds not.
column2: 它毫無反應。

column1: It's just like all the other buildings in this place, rank!
column2: 這裡的建築物全都長一個樣，又臭又爛！

column1: You can't do anything to them. You're not in the proper union.
column2: 你對它們無能為力，你又不是那個工會的人。

column1: In response, they hang limp.
column2: 它們只是軟趴趴地垂在那裡，算是回應了你。

column1: Parts is parts and you don't have any need for them.
column2: 零件就是零件，你用不到。

column1: It smells shippy.
column2: 聞起來有股太空船的味道。

column1: No thanks, I have to drive.

column1: You really don't want to get handprints all over a valuable antique like this one.
column2: 你才不想在這麼珍貴的古董上留下一堆手印。

column1: You're a nosy little beggar, aren't you?

column1: I wouldn't mess with them if I were you.

column1: No answer is forthcoming.
column2: 沒有得到任何回應。

column2: 老兄，跟你講實話，這台寶貝我最低只能算你 %u 枚太空幣。

column1: Touching Tiny would be rude. However, you surmise from his scaly skin that he's probably about as slimy as his salespitches.
column2: 摸小不點是件很失禮的事。不過從他那身鱗片皮膚看來，你猜他大概跟他的推銷話術一樣滑溜。

column1: Something smells fishy about this salesbeing.
column2: 這個推銷生物身上有種說不出的可疑味道。

column1: Sushi, anyone? Na, Tiny looks like a tough cookie.
column2: 有人要來點壽司嗎？算了吧，小不點看起來可不是好惹的。

column1: There's nothing here to buy.
column2: 這裡沒什麼好買的。

column1: Maybe you could get Tiny to sell you something if you talked to him.

column1: It's a hole. In this game there's nothing you can do to one.

column1: The hole smells like freshly dug dirt.

column1: It's dirt, man!
column2: 就泥土啊，兄弟！

column1: The void does not answer.
column2: 這片虛空沒有回應。

column1: After carefully considering the hole matter, you decide not to throw anything down it.
column2: 你仔細考慮了一下這個洞的事，決定還是不要往裡面丟東西。

column1: There's an old saying in these parts: "You don't touch a ship that isn't yours, you don't die."
column2: 這一帶流傳一句老話：「別碰不屬於你的船，就不會死。」

column1: For some reason, this ship smells like freshly-dug dirt.
column2: 不知道為什麼，這艘船聞起來像剛挖起來的泥土。

column1: No wonder it smells like dirt. It also tastes like it.
column2: 難怪聞起來像泥土，嚐起來也是。

column1: The ship offers no response.
column2: 這艘船沒有任何回應。

column1: There's no need for that.
column2: 沒必要這麼做。

column1: It smells like boot bottoms.
column2: 聞起來像靴子底部的味道。

column1: UGGH! It tastes like boot bottoms!
column2: 噁！嚐起來就像靴子底部！

column1: It doesn't acknowledge your inquiry.
column2: 它沒有理會你的問題。

column1: My, my. It would appear that your skimmer has become the property of another. I wonder who forgot to remove the key?
column2: 哎呀哎呀，看來你的沙漠飛車已經變成別人的財產了。真不知道是誰忘了把鑰匙拔起來呢？

column1: Hi. My name's Roger. What's yours?
column2: 嗨，我叫羅傑，你叫什麼名字？

column1: The ground here smells exactly like the ground anywhere else on this planet.
column2: 這裡的地面聞起來，跟這顆星球其他地方的地面一模一樣。

column1: Don't lick the ground. You're libel to get more than you bargained for.
column2: 別舔地面，你可能會嘗到超乎預期的東西。

column1: Because it has treads, your robot cannot negotiate the steps leading down into the bar. It will wait here for you (provided nobody steals it).
column2: 你的機器人裝的是履帶，沒辦法應付通往酒吧的階梯，只能在這裡等你（前提是沒人把它偷走）。

column2: 你沒聽酒保的勸告，搖搖晃晃地走出酒吧。你醉得一塌糊塗，根本沒發現自己馬上就要變成這一帶各種寄生生物的頭號獵物。你的柯羅娜麥酒耐受度太低，很快就昏了過去。

column1: While your body tries to sleep it off you lose every possession you own, including your skimmer. Soon, your body is stripped for parts. Obviously, you don't make it through the night.
column2: 就在你的身體努力想睡醒酒的這段時間，你身上所有的東西都被摸走了，連沙漠飛車也不例外。沒多久，你的身體也被扒得一乾二淨。很顯然，你撐不過這一夜。

column1: After a truly stone-crushing journey, you have miraculously arrived safely in Ulence Flats. And just in time too, because the skimmer's power cell has been drained. It will take some time to recharge itself.
column2: 經過一趟真正屁股開花的顛簸旅程，你奇蹟似地平安抵達尤倫斯荒原。而且時間抓得剛剛好，因為飛車的電池已經耗盡，得花點時間才能重新充飽。

column1: This place isn't quite what you had expected. It is semi-bleak at best.
column2: 這地方跟你想像的不太一樣，說好聽一點也只是半荒涼而已。

column1: An odd-looking fellow is lounging against the wall of a nearby building, watching you with a great deal of interest.
column2: 一個模樣古怪的傢伙斜靠在附近一棟建築的牆上，饒富興味地打量著你。

column1: How'd ya like to unload it for the unheard-of price of 25 buckazoids?
column2: 「用聞所未聞的 25 枚太空幣把它出手，你意下如何？」

column1: Do we have a deal, or don't we?
column2: 「這筆交易做不做？」

column1: It's no use. The sand skimmer's power cells still haven't charged themselves.
column2: 沒用的，沙漠飛車的電池還沒充飽。

column1: You remove the skimmer's key from its dashboard.
column2: 你把鑰匙從飛車的儀表板上拔了下來。

column1: You sure know how to push things.
column2: 你還真的很懂得得寸進尺。

column1: He wants cash, not conversation.
column2: 他要的是現金，不是閒聊。

column1: He won't take kindly to that.
column2: 他不會高興的。

column1: You already have the keys.
column2: 你已經有鑰匙了。

column1: The sand skimmer is a one-passenger mode of transportation and it looks like it has skimmed quite a bit of sand in its time. On its control panel is a small readout, currently dark, and a keyhole without a key in it.
column2: 這輛沙漠飛車是單人座的交通工具，看起來這輩子沒少在沙地上滑過。控制面板上有個小小的顯示螢幕，現在是暗的，還有一個鑰匙孔，裡面沒插鑰匙。

column1: The sand skimmer is a one-passenger mode of transportation and it looks like it has skimmed quite a bit of sand in its time. On its control panel is a small readout, currently dark, and a keyhole with a key in it.
column2: 這輛沙漠飛車是單人座的交通工具，看起來這輩子沒少在沙地上滑過。控制面板上有個小小的顯示螢幕，現在是暗的，還有一個鑰匙孔，裡面插著鑰匙。

column1: Alas, it does not respond.
column2: 唉，它沒有反應。

column1: It smells warm after the long ride.
column2: 開了這麼久，聞起來還熱呼呼的。

column1: You take a quick look, notice it hasn't been cleaned in awhile, and change your mind.
column2: 你瞄了一眼，發現它好一陣子沒洗了，於是打消念頭。

column1: You decide it would be better not to tamper with it.
column2: 你覺得還是別亂動比較好。

column1: Like most spaceships in your experience, this one won't talk to you.
column2: 就像你遇過的大部分太空船一樣，這艘也不會理你。

column1: Smelling this ship seems like a giant waste of time.
column2: 聞這艘船簡直是浪費時間。

column1: There's not much point in licking the ship - it's already quite clean).
column2: 舔這艘船沒什麼意義——反正它已經夠乾淨了）。

column1: Better not - it'd probably fall over.
column2: 還是別這樣好了，它大概會倒下來。

column1: You shout in the direction of the ship, but no one answers.
column2: 你朝著那艘船大喊，但沒人回應。

column1: It mainly smells like the dust that's been accumulating on it for the past fifty years.
column2: 聞起來主要是這五十年來積下的灰塵味。

column1: What a revolting idea!
column2: 這什麼噁心的主意！

column1: The sign is very unusual. It looks as though the whole building has been constructed around the wreckage of a crashed spaceship.
column2: 這塊招牌很不尋常，整棟建築物看起來像是圍著一艘墜毀太空船的殘骸蓋出來的。

column1: Or maybe the traffic around here is just really awful.
column2: 或者這附近的交通真的有夠爛。

column1: The naked wiring you can see from here makes touching the sign seem unwise.
column2: 從這裡就看得到裸露的電線，摸這塊招牌感覺不太妙。

column1: The Rocket Bar sign has nothing to say to you.
column2: 火箭酒吧的招牌沒什麼好跟你說的。

column1: You detect the scent of neon and zapped bugs.
column2: 你聞到一股霓虹燈和電死蟲子的味道。

column1: That doesn't seem either intelligent or appetizing.
column2: 這既不聰明也沒什麼胃口。

column1: Why bother?
column2: 何必呢？

column1: You detect a bit of sulfur in the air here as well. Can't get away from it on this planet, it appears.
column2: 空氣裡還聞得到一點硫磺味，看來在這顆星球上是躲都躲不掉。

column1: Luck's turn has cost you dearly. As your dust particles gradually drift across Kerona's barren landscape, you reflect upon the irony of your fate. Many was the time you swept and dumped piles of dust very similar to your current state.
column2: 運氣一翻臉，你就死得慘兮兮。當你的塵埃顆粒緩緩飄過柯羅娜星的荒地時，你不禁感嘆起命運的諷刺——你這輩子掃過、倒過多少堆跟現在的你長得一模一樣的灰塵啊。

column1: Searching through the pile of dust, you find %u buckazoids!
column2: 翻找那堆灰塵，你找到 %u 枚太空幣！

column1: You find nothing but ashes, which filter through your fingers and blow away.
column2: 你什麼都沒找到，只有灰燼從指縫間流走，隨風飄散。

column1: The mugger impresses upon you that he was quite serious.
column2: 那個搶匪讓你徹底見識到，他是玩真的。

column1: %d buckazoids? I guess it's better than nothing. Here, keep five for yourself. I gotta admit you look like you need it.
column2: 「%d 枚太空幣？也算聊勝於無吧。來，留五枚給你自己，我承認你看起來挺需要的。」

column1: Well, he looked harmless before he pulled that blaster.
column2: 唉，他掏出雷射槍之前看起來人畜無害。

column1: This being is about the size of a humanoid but has some odd features. He seems to have a friendly-looking mug.
column2: 這傢伙體型跟人形生物差不多，但長得有點怪。他那張臉看起來還算和善。

column1: He just wants your buckazoids but will take your life if he has to.
column2: 他只想要你的太空幣，但必要的話他會要你的命。

column1: Don't be so generous. You've already given him enough money.
column2: 別這麼大方，你給他的錢已經夠多了。

column1: He hasn't offered to sell you anything yet.
column2: 他還沒開口要賣你任何東西。

column1: He doesn't want that. He wants your buckazoids.
column2: 他要的不是這個，他要的是你的太空幣。

column1: And you had better hurry!
column2: 你最好動作快點！

column1: It's controlled from the inside. You can't do anything to it.
column2: 這是從裡面控制的，你在外面搞不出什麼名堂。

column1: It smells like the outside of a building exposed to a filthy atmosphere for a long time.
column2: 聞起來就像一棟長年泡在髒空氣裡的建築物外牆。

column1: Yuck! This place could use a good beam-cleaning.
column2: 噁！這地方真該用雷射好好清一清。

column1: You can't reach it.
column2: 你搆不到。

column1: It's just a mechanical arm, not a head.
column2: 那只是一隻機械手臂，不是頭。

column1: I'm beginning to understand you a little better now. You snort some of the powder and feel a pain like that of a thousand krebble mites feasting on your nasal membranes. You won't want to be doing that again.
column2: 你現在稍微懂他多一點了。你吸了一點粉末，感覺就像有上千隻卡博蟲在你的鼻腔黏膜上大快朵頤。你不會想再來一次了。

column1: No way!
column2: 想都別想！

column1: You can't do anything to it.
column2: 你對它無能為力。

column1: If you're talking to that you must be frustrated.
column2: 你會跟那東西講話，可見你有多挫折。

column1: This is a seedy little place. Galactic riff-raff are seated at the bar. %s. There is a slot machine standing near the bar. You notice a sweeper in the corner of the room. It must get messy here. No one seems to notice or care that you have entered the bar.
column2: 這是個破破爛爛的小地方，吧台前坐著一堆銀河系的雜碎。%s。吧台旁擺著一台吃角子吃角子老虎，角落裡有台清潔機器人——這裡想必常常搞得亂七八糟。你走進酒吧，沒人多看一眼，也沒人在乎。

column1: Sour beer and stale sweat.
column2: 酸掉的啤酒和發臭的汗味。

column1: Why don't you just buy two or three drinks instead.
column2: 你何不乾脆買個兩三杯就好。

column1: You've had a couple of drinks now. What do you think.
column2: 你已經喝了幾杯了，感覺怎麼樣。

column1: Whoa!
column2: 哇喔！

column1: You wisely (although somewhat belatedly) decide to heed the bartender's advice.
column2: 你很聰明地（雖然有點慢半拍）決定聽酒保的勸。

column1: Do you want a beer? It costs 2 Buckazoids.
column2: 「要來杯啤酒嗎？兩枚太空幣。」

column1: Want another drink?
column2: 「要再來一杯嗎？」

column1: Listen, Mac, I shouldn't serve you any more. You're sledged! You'd better go sleep it off or something before you start making a public display of yourself.
column2: 「聽著，老兄，我不該再倒給你了。你已經醉茫茫了！你最好先去睡一覺醒醒酒，免得等一下在大家面前出糗。」

column1: The bartender doesn't exactly jump at your request.
column2: 酒保對你的要求一點也不積極。

column1: I would like to redeem this coupon for 5 buckazoids and a free beer.
column2: 我想用這張折價券兌換五枚太空幣和一杯免費啤酒。

column1: Excuse me, my good man. I would like a drink.
column2: 不好意思，這位大哥，我想喝一杯。

column1: Yo! How about a refill?
column2: 喂！再倒一杯如何？

column1: Hmmm... It tastes better than it smells (thank goodness). Another one would be nice.
column2: 嗯……喝起來比聞起來好多了（謝天謝地）。再來一杯應該不錯。

column1: Ah yes, that hits the spot. Just one more should do it.
column2: 啊，這味道真對了。再一杯應該就夠了。

column1: As you sip another of the odd brews, you overhear someone at the bar speaking: "There I was cruising through sector %s when I spot this blip on the scanner."
column2: 你又啜了一口那杯怪酒，聽到吧台有人在講話：「我當時正巡航經過 %s 星區，突然在雷達上看到一個光點。」

column1: So, I head toward it, ya see, and right there in front of me sits the Deltaur. It's just sittin' there. My hearts start hyperwarping on me.
column2: 「所以，你知道的，我就朝那邊飛過去，結果代爾它號就這樣停在我正前方，動也不動。我那幾顆心臟當場就開始超速狂跳。」

column1: I figure my milliseconds are numbered. All I can think of doin' is getting my craft outta there. So, I'm reachin' for the throttle.
column2: 「我當下就知道自己命不久矣，毫秒都嫌多。我腦子裡只想著趕快把船開走，於是伸手就去抓油門。」

column1: All of a sudden there's this incredible flash of light, ya see. And just like that this little planetoid explodes into a ball of fire! I tell ya, I've never seen anything like it. I mauled the throttle and got outta there quick you bet.
column2: 「突然間一道強光閃過，你知道嗎？下一秒那顆小行星就直接炸成一團火球！我跟你講，我這輩子沒見過那種場面。我死命踩下油門，這才逃了出來，你放心。」

column1: You feel a strange tingling sensation. The taste of the beer doesn't seem to be bothering you so much now, hee, hee.
column2: 你感覺到一陣怪異的刺麻感。啤酒的味道現在好像沒那麼難以下嚥了，嘿嘿。

column1: Oh my, you're starting to feel a bit unstable.
column2: 哎呀，你開始覺得有點站不穩了。

column1: You are supposed to walk out of the bar drunk, and pass out behind it. Waking up with an enormous headache and no earthly possessions. But for now you're normal.

column1: Looks to be something playing it already.

column1: Wow, I guess you over-heated the poor old thing.

column1: You'll have to get closer.
column2: 你得再靠近一點。

column1: Hi. The name's Wilco. Roger Wilco. What's yours?
column2: 「嗨，我叫威爾科，羅傑·威爾科。你呢？」

column1: I am sometimes called Speaker to Cartoons, and sometimes Flayer of Soft Pink Mammals.
column2: 「有人叫我『卡通代言人』，也有人叫我『剝軟粉紅哺乳類皮者』。」

column1: Mind if I sit down?
column2: 「介意我坐下嗎？」

column1: Buzz off, monkey-boy!
column2: 「滾開啦，猴崽子！」

column1: The thought of your tongue laid out in four neat slices like luncheon meat puts this idea right out of your head.

column1: Could be Rid-O-Fleaz Shampoo, or just a really manly after- shave.

column1: He might be insulted by an offer of money. You won't like him when he's insulted.

column1: Reality check! Does this seem like a good idea to you?
