column1: If he decided to keep it, you wouldn't live to get it back.
column2: 他要是決定把這東西留下來，你大概沒命把它拿回去了。

column1: He'll more than likely slice it up for practice, and then where'll you be, huh?
column2: 他八成會拿它來練習切東西，到時候你要怎麼辦，嗯？

column1: That would be my first clue not to bother this guy again.
column2: 換作是我，看到這個就會學乖，不會再去惹這傢伙了。

column1: He doesn't want to be bothered.
column2: 他不想被打擾。

column1: Leave him alone.
column2: 別去煩他。

column1: You'd rather not, really
column2: 你其實不太想這麼做，真的

column1: You left your slug recipes in your other pair of pants.
column2: 你的蛞蝓食譜忘在另一條褲子裡了。

column1: Forget it. This guy's not exactly a sparkling conversationalist.
column2: 算了吧，這傢伙聊天沒什麼看頭。

column1: Ahh, the heady fragrance of Eau de Banana Slug.
column2: 啊，「香蕉蛞蝓」香水的濃郁氣息。

column1: What could you possibly be thinking of?
column2: 你到底在想什麼？

column1: You decide against getting slug secretions on the cartridge.
column2: 你決定還是別讓資料匣沾上蛞蝓的黏液。

column1: He's not at all interested in your widget.
column2: 他對你的強力磁鐵一點興趣都沒有。

column1: Slugspeak is seldom improved by translation.
column2: 蛞蝓話翻譯過後也沒好懂到哪去。

column1: Do you really want to get slime on your knife.
column2: 你真的想讓黏液沾滿你的刀嗎。

column1: He seems supremely disinterested in your water.
column2: 他對你的水完全提不起興趣。

column1: You show him your jet pack. He shrugs. It's sort of a slug shrug. Spooky!
column2: 你把噴射背包給他看，他聳了聳肩——是那種蛞蝓式的聳肩。有夠詭異！

column1: Do you really want to get slug slime all over these? I thought not.
column2: 你真的想讓蛞蝓黏液沾得到處都是嗎？我猜不想吧。

column1: She'll make you SO sorry if you touch one of those.
column2: 你敢碰那個試試看，她會讓你後悔莫及。

column1: Most extraterrestrials won't do that on the first date. Maybe you should just listen to them.
column2: 大部分外星人第一次約會都不會這樣，你還是聽她的話比較好。

column1: So - you come here often?
column2: 「所以……妳常來這裡嗎？」

column1: Get outta my face, Pinky.
column2: 「滾開啦，小粉紅。」

column1: You've decided she's not your type. Heck, she's not even your species!
column2: 你已經斷定她不是你的菜。拜託，她根本不是你這個物種！

column1: She smells as great as she looks, but maybe a little less green.
column2: 她聞起來跟看起來一樣正，只是綠得沒那麼徹底。

column1: You're certain she will misunderstand your generous gesture.
column2: 你很確定她會誤會你這番好意。

column1: She ignores the cartridge, much as she ignores you.
column2: 她無視那個資料匣，就跟她無視你一樣。

column1: The thought of showing her your widget fills you with deep feelings of inadequacey.
column2: 一想到要把強力磁鐵拿給她看，你就湧起一股深深的自卑感。

column1: She remains unimpressed.
column2: 她依然無動於衷。

column1: You can't imagine she'd care about your genuine Xenon Army Knife.
column2: 你很難想像她會在乎你那把正宗氙星軍刀。

column1: Your dehydrated water couldn't possibly taste better than what she's drinking.
column2: 你那瓶濃縮水，喝起來絕對比不上她杯子裡那杯。

column1: She's pretty nearly as interested in your jet pack as she is in you, which is to say not much.
column2: 她對你的噴射背包，興趣大概跟對你本人差不多——也就是沒什麼興趣。

column1: She's seen lots of coupons bigger and better than yours.
column2: 她看過的折價券，比你這張又大又好的多得是。

column1: His fur has the texture of a nylon bath rug that has been microwaved on HIGH.
column2: 他的毛皮摸起來，就像被微波爐用強火加熱過的尼龍浴室地毯。

column1: Can I offer you a Milk-Bone? you inquire in an attempt to be friendly.
column2: 「要不要來根狗骨頭餅乾？」你想跟牠打好關係，這麼問道。

column1: Grrrrrrr!
column2: 「嗚嗚嗚嗚嗚！」

column1: You decide you just can't make friends with everybody.
column2: 你認清了一件事：不是每個人都能跟你當朋友。

column1: Pretty much like wet dog.
column2: 聞起來就跟濕狗差不多。

column1: This doesn't seem wise, even to you.
column2: 就連你自己都覺得，這樣做不太明智。

column1: He shows absolutely no interest in the cartridge.
column2: 他對這個資料匣一點興趣都沒有。

column1: He seems less interested in the widget than in that cute drink in his paw.
column2: 比起手裡那杯可愛的飲料，他對這個強力磁鐵興趣缺缺。

column1: Since he isn't inclinded to talk to you, there's not much point trying to translate.
column2: 他根本不想跟你講話，翻譯了也沒用。

column1: On second thought, maybe you'd just better keep it in your pocket.
column2: 想想還是算了，把它收回口袋裡比較保險。

column1: He seems well taken care of in the drink department.
column2: 看來他在喝的方面被照顧得很周到。

column1: You wonder why you're offering this giant hairball your new jet pack and are forced to admit you don't know.
column2: 你不懂自己幹嘛要把新噴射背包拿給這團大毛球，而且說真的，你也想不出理由。

column1: You wisely decide that flashing your coupons at fur-face here would be a serious waste of your time.
column2: 你很識相地明白，在這張毛臉面前秀折價券，根本是浪費時間。

column1: You decide you'd rather live.
column2: 你決定還是留條命比較實在。

column1: He doesn't seem willing to accept this in trade for a beer.
column2: 他好像不打算拿這個換一杯啤酒。

column1: The bartender only wants money.
column2: 酒保只認錢。

column1: He doesn't want this - he wants money.
column2: 他要的不是這個——他要的是錢。

column1: Threatening the bartender will probably get you Laze-O-Toasted. Try buying a drink instead.
column2: 威脅酒保大概只會讓你被雷射烤成焦炭。不如乖乖點杯酒吧。

column1: No, dummy - he's supposed to gieve YOU drinks.
column2: 不對，笨蛋——該倒酒給你喝的人是他。

column1: The bartender does not recognize your jet pack as currency. He wants to see Buckazoids.
column2: 酒保不認你的噴射背包當貨幣，他要看到的是太空幣。

column1: Try it and this guy is likely to use his beer tap on your head.
column2: 你敢試試看，這傢伙大概會拿啤酒龍頭往你頭上招呼。

column1: His armpits could etch glass.
column2: 他的腋下味道，濃到可以拿去蝕刻玻璃。

column1: Maybe you'd better buy your own beer
column2: 你還是自己買杯啤酒吧

column1: What's the use? You can't understand a word they're saying.
column2: 有什麼用？反正你一個字都聽不懂他們在講什麼。

column1: Sniffing others is a ritual best left to dogs and other four-legged creatures.
column2: 聞來聞去這種事，還是留給狗和其他四腳動物去做吧。

column1: The little purple guy doesn't seem to understand your offer of money.
column2: 這個紫色小傢伙好像聽不懂你要給錢的意思。

column1: The cartridge doesn't interest him in the least.
column2: 這個資料匣他一點興趣都沒有。

column1: He seems not to care about the widget.
column2: 他好像不在乎這個強力磁鐵。

column1: Even translated, his speech is gibberish.
column2: 就算翻譯過了，他講的話還是有聽沒有懂。

column1: He doesn't seem to be either interested or threatened by your knife.
column2: 你的刀，他既不感興趣，也不覺得害怕。

column1: He doesn't seem to be thristy.
column2: 他看起來不怎麼渴。

column1: Careful! You don't want to hurt the little guy.
column2: 小心點！你可不想傷到這小傢伙。

column1: The little guy shows no interest in your coupon. Did you think he would?
column2: 這小傢伙對你的折價券完全沒興趣。你該不會真以為他會要吧？

column1: The robot observes that your teeth haven't been cleaned in a long time.
column2: 機器人指出，你的牙齒已經很久沒清過了。

column1: The robot observes that your nostril hairs could use trimming.
column2: 機器人指出，你的鼻毛該修一修了。

column1: You'll only hurt yourself
column2: 你只會傷到自己

column1: A faint odor of ozone lingers in the air near the business end of the device.
column2: 這個裝置的出力端還殘留著一股淡淡的臭氧味。

column1: It's not likely you could taste it from here, or would want to, for that matter.
column2: 你不太可能從這裡嚐到味道，而且說真的，你也不會想嚐。

column1: The "Slots-O-Death" machine seems to have met its match. It will no longer be a deadly temptation for unsuspecting space-farers such as yourself.
column2: 「奪命吃角子老虎」似乎終於棋逢對手了。它再也不會是像你這種懵懂太空旅人的死亡陷阱了。

column1: Watch it or you'll get zapped.
column2: 小心點，不然你會被電到。

column1: Hmmm...It smells vaguely like burnt flesh.
column2: 嗯……聞起來隱約有股燒焦肉味。

column1: You Bet $%u You Have $%u
column2: 下注 $%u　持有 $%u

column1: You step back and place the widget on the slot machine. Let's see what this baby can do.
column2: 你退後一步，把強力磁鐵貼到吃角子老虎上。來看看這寶貝能耍什麼把戲。

column1: Eat Sand
column2: 去吃沙吧

column1: No Way
column2: 門都沒有

column1: Not A Chance
column2: 想都別想

column1: It's Hopeless
column2: 沒救了

column1: Tough Luck
column2: 算你倒楣

column1: Suck Methane
column2: 去吸甲烷吧

column1: So Sorry
column2: 真可惜

column1: You Win $%u You Have $%u
column2: 贏得 $%u　持有 $%u

column1: You step back nervously as the over-heated slot machine begins to sputter and smoke.
column2: 你緊張地退後，過熱的吃角子老虎開始噴煙冒火花。

column1: YOU LOSE, HOMEBOY!
column2: 你輸了，老兄！

column1: The pictures are protected by unbreakable windows.
column2: 這些照片有防碎玻璃保護著。

column1: Very good! You got all that gunk off the glass. Licking the glass windows makes the pictures easier to see.
column2: 很好！你把玻璃上那些髒東西舔乾淨了。舔過的玻璃窗，看照片清楚多了。

column1: A slight smell of ozone and charred meat permeates the machine.
column2: 機器裡瀰漫著一股淡淡的臭氧味和燒肉味。

column1: You're supposed to put your money in the money slot.
column2: 你應該把錢投進投幣口才對。

column1: Who are you trying to kid? You don't have any more buckazoids to gamble with. Hit the sand, pal.
column2: 你在唬弄誰啊？你已經沒有太空幣可以賭了，滾去外面的沙地吧，老兄。

column1: With shaking hands, you insert your last buckazoid into the "Slots-O-Death" machine.
column2: 你顫抖著雙手，把最後一枚太空幣投進「奪命吃角子老虎」。

column1: The "Slots-O-Death" machine will let you insert only three buckazoids per spin.
column2: 「奪命吃角子老虎」每次只讓你投三枚太空幣。

column1: Insert a buckazoid into the slot.
column2: 把一枚太空幣投進投幣口。

column1: Seated in the cruiser, you notice there are no controls within reach, just a button marked "LOAD". Tiny must have been serious when he said you would need a droid to fly this thing.
column2: 你坐進巡航艦，發現伸手可及的範圍內完全沒有操縱裝置，只有一個標著「LOAD」的按鈕。看來小不點說你需要機器人才能開這艘船，還真不是說著玩的。

column1: And, since you are currently droidless, there seems to be nothing else to do but climb out.
column2: 而既然你現在沒有機器人，好像也只能爬出去了。

column1: Once you are seated snuggly in the ship's compact cockpit, the robot moves into position, and you push the "LOAD" button.
column2: 你舒舒服服地坐進太空船的小巧座艙後，機器人就定位，你按下「LOAD」按鈕。

column1: Hey! Wait a minute! Where do you think you're goin' with my ship?!!
column2: 「喂！等一下！你以為你要開著我的船去哪啊？！」

column1: Darn the luck. You've crashed in the dunes and ended your life. The various inhabitants of the Keronian desert are now feasting on your remains. Guess that wasn't such a hot purchase.
column2: 衰到爆。你一頭撞進沙丘，小命就這麼沒了。柯羅娜沙漠裡的各路住民，現在正大快朵頤啃食你的殘骸。看來這筆買賣，一點都不划算。

column1: Of course, with your 70 buckazoid rebate, that's just %u to you.
column2: 當然啦，扣掉你 70 枚太空幣的折扣，你只要付 %u 就好。

column1: I'll tell ya, ol' buddy, %u buckazoids is as low as I can go on that baby.
column2: 老實跟你講，老兄，那艘寶貝我最多只能降到 %u 枚太空幣。

column1: Tiny isn't a great conversationalist. He just wants to sell, sell, sell.
column2: 小不點不太會聊天，他滿腦子只想著賣、賣、賣。

column1: Touching Tiny would be rude. However, you surmise from his scaly skin that he's probably about as slimy as his salespitch.
column2: 摸小不點很沒禮貌。不過從他那身鱗片皮膚看來，你猜他大概跟他那套推銷話術一樣滑溜。

column1: Maybe you'd better take a closer look at Tiny's merchandise before making a purchase.
column2: 你買之前，或許該把小不點的貨仔細看清楚。

column1: Actually, this ship is not bad-looking. It appears to be a Drallion cruiser. They have a reputation for quickness and reliability. You are surprised that someone of Tiny's caliber would be carrying it.
column2: 其實這艘船外型還不錯，看起來是德萊恩巡航艦，以速度快、耐操聞名。你很意外，像小不點這種等級的傢伙居然會有這種貨色。

column1: Actually, this ship is not bad-looking. It appears to be a Drallion cruiser They have a reputation for quickness and reliability.
column2: 其實這艘船外型還不錯，看起來是德萊恩巡航艦，以速度快、耐操聞名。

column1: There's a saying in these parts: "You don't touch a ship that isn't yours, you don't die."
column2: 這一帶有句老話：「不碰不是你的船，就不會死。」

column1: Hmmm... needs salt.
column2: 嗯……還要加點鹽。

column1: This ship smells a bit like space. It must've been there recently.
column2: 這艘船聞起來有點太空味，想必最近才剛從太空回來。

column1: An interesting idea, but applying the jetpack to a spacecraft makes about as much sense as attaching a C-64 to a Cray-64.
column2: 想法是挺有趣，但把噴射背包裝到太空船上，就跟把 C-64 接到 Cray-64 上一樣莫名其妙。

column1: Well, okay. If you really feel competent enough to assemble this thing, just do it. Start with the smallest box.
column2: 好吧，如果你真覺得自己有本事把這東西組起來，那就動手吧。先從最小的箱子開始。

column1: Oops.
column2: 糟了。

column1: It smells like a fine grade of light machine oil. You were expecting Hai Karate, perhaps?
column2: 聞起來像高級輕機油。你該不會是在期待「海克拉特」古龍水的味道吧？

column1: Why on earth - or Kerona for that matter - would you want to do that?
column2: 你到底為什麼——不管是在地球還是柯羅娜星——會想做這種事？

column1: Unfortunately, you AREN'T smarter than you look, so you'd best leave the incredibly complex robot parts alone before you hurt yourself. Too bad they don't give rebates to retrobates.
column2: 很遺憾，你並沒有看起來那麼聰明，所以還是離這些超複雜的機器人零件遠一點，免得傷到自己。可惜他們不會因為你笨手笨腳就給你打折。

column1: You can tell this is definitely out of your league. You can't even open the boxes, much less assemble what's inside.
column2: 你看得出來，這絕對超出你的能耐。你連箱子都打不開，更別說組裝裡面的東西了。

column1: Like many buildings on these backwater planets, this one is a quickie Construct-O-Foam job that won't last more than a couple of thousand years at the outside. They just don't make `em like they used to.
column2: 就跟這種鄉下星球上很多建築一樣，這棟也是「速成泡棉工法」隨便蓋一蓋，撐死也就撐個幾千年。現在的東西啊，就是做得不比從前扎實。

column1: Talking to buildings is likely to get you arrested on this planet.
column2: 在這顆星球上，跟建築物講話大概會讓你被抓去關。

column1: Why would you possibly care what this building smells like?
column2: 你幹嘛在乎這棟建築聞起來是什麼味道？

column1: Oh, blecchhh!
column2: 噁，噁心死了！

column1: No matter how you try to convince it otherwise, the sign will only say "Droids-B-Us Pickup."
column2: 不管你怎麼想說服它，這塊招牌永遠只會寫著「機器人量販店 取貨處」。

column1: From here, you can discern no particular smell on the sign.
column2: 從這裡聞，你聞不出這塊招牌有什麼特別的味道。

column1: If your neck was as long as a giraffazoid's, then maybe you could do that. But why would you want to?
column2: 如果你的脖子跟長頸鹿佐德一樣長，或許還做得到。但你幹嘛會想這麼做？

column1: This isn't the real Gerry Giraffazoid, Roger - it's just a picture.
column2: 羅傑，這不是真的傑瑞·長頸鹿佐德——只是一張照片。

column1: Gerry Giraffazoid's picture doesn't smell like much of anything.
column2: 傑瑞·長頸鹿佐德的照片，聞起來沒什麼特別的味道。

column1: Trust me - that logo lacks any taste.
column2: 相信我——那個標誌一點味道都沒有。

column1: Shaking hands could be a shocking experience.
column2: 握手可能會是很「觸電」的體驗。

column1: The salesbug would appreciate it if you'd give him the money. It would make his job soooo much easier.
column2: 這隻推銷蟲會很感激你把錢給他，這樣會讓他的工作輕鬆許多許多。

column1: A shodily manufactured jet pack is certainly not worth the price of one of these fine previously-owned droids. My advice, sir, is to come up with the cash or walk.
column2: 一個做工粗糙的噴射背包，絕對配不上這些上等二手機器人的身價。先生，我的建議是，拿出現金，不然就請便吧。

column1: The robot doesn't speak, but you think you can see a bloodthirsty gleam in his metallic eye.
column2: 這機器人不會說話，但你覺得牠金屬眼裡似乎閃著一絲嗜血的光。

column1: Course is plotted. Stand by for warp speed.
column2: 航線已設定完畢。準備進入超空間航速。

column1: In the face of danger you decide to turn and run, leaving Xenon and the rest of the universe to fend for themselves against those bad boys of the universe, the Sariens. When things get tough, the cream rises to the top. I guess you know which stratum you occupy.
column2: 面對危險，你決定掉頭就跑，把氙星和宇宙其他角落丟給那群宇宙頭號惡霸——沙利安人自生自滅。俗話說，危難見真章。看來你也很清楚，自己是屬於哪個層級的貨色。

column1: We have achieved escape velocity.
column2: 我們已經達到脫離速度。

column1: It might help if you were to tell me where we are going. Please indicate our destination on the touch pad in front of you.
column2: 如果你能告訴我們要去哪裡，應該會有幫助。請在你面前的觸控板上指出我們的目的地。

column1: If it doesn't matter to you, we can go to CES (Cosmic Electronics Show) on Rudicube 3. I just love seeing all of those new, big, shiny robots. You could buy me companion.
column2: 如果你不介意的話，我們可以去魯迪丘布三號參加宇宙電子展（CES）。我最愛看那些又新又大又閃亮的機器人了。你可以幫我買個伴。

column1: OH, NO!!! We're headed straight for an asteroid belt!
column2: 喔，不！！！我們正朝著一個小行星帶直直衝過去！

column1: Sensors indicate a large ship in this sector. I wonder who it could be? Will continue to scan for an I.D.
column2: 感測器顯示這個星區有一艘大型船艦。不知道會是誰呢？將繼續掃描以確認身分。

column1: Whoa! That's a Sarien battle cruiser! We'd better stand off. If we get any closer, they'll detect us for sure and we'll be space sputum!
column2: 哇！那是艘沙利安人的戰鬥巡航艦！我們最好保持距離。再靠近一點，他們肯定會發現我們，到時候我們就會變成太空裡的一坨痰！

column1: Let's head on out of here, okay boss?
column2: 我們還是快點離開這裡吧，老大，好嗎？

column1: You drift endlessly through space wishing you had worn a jetpack to maneuver with. A you drift away never to be seen again the only thing you can think of to say is "Mommy!"
column2: 你在太空裡無止盡地漂流，心裡希望自己當初有穿噴射背包好操控方向。就在你漸漸飄遠、再也不會有人看見你的時候，你腦中唯一想得到能喊出的一句話就是：「媽咪！」

column1: As you exit the ship, you carefully slide the jetpack on your back.
column2: 你走出太空船時，小心翼翼地把噴射背包揹到背上。

column1: As you undo your seatbelts and exit the escape pod. You can feel yourself just start to uncontrollably drifting away.
column2: 你解開安全帶、走出逃生艙，才發現自己整個人不受控制，就這樣飄了出去。

column1: The inhabitants of this vessel apparently do not appreciate your desire to sight-see. I guess it's a good idea not to be wandering around the outside this ship. You were a carbon-based being. Now your just carbon.
column2: 看來這艘船上的住客不太欣賞你觀光的興致。看樣子在船外閒晃真的不是什麼好主意。你原本是碳基生物，現在只剩下一堆碳了。

column1: You are floating in space just outside the biggest darn spaceship you've ever seen. You see a door. Perhaps it is a way in?
column2: 你正漂浮在太空中，就在你這輩子看過最誇張的一艘太空船外面。你看到一扇門，也許是個入口？

column1: It appears to be a standard airlock. There is a handle off to the side.
column2: 這看起來是標準的氣密艙門，旁邊有個把手。

column1: Its too big to move by hand. There must be a better way.
column2: 這東西太大了，用手推不動，一定有更好的辦法。

column1: Not through your helmet.
column2: 隔著頭盔可不行。

column1: You would have to take your helmet off first, and that's not a very good idea.
column2: 你得先把頭盔脫掉才行，但這可不是什麼好主意。

column1: It's a handle.
column2: 這是個把手。

column1: You'd have to take your helmet off first and that would prove fatal.
column2: 你得先脫掉頭盔才行，不過那樣做絕對會要你的命。

column1: Outta my way! beeps the rude little droid.
column2: 「閃開啦！」那個沒禮貌的小機器人嗶了一聲。

column1: Bumping you, the droid causes you to come into contact with exposed wiring. Your heart, not to mention the rest of your body, doesn't react well to this (have you ever seen rhubarb pie without the crust?). Guess you'll have to be a little more clever next time.
column2: 機器人這麼一撞，你就這樣碰上了裸露的電線。你的心臟——更別說全身其他部位——對這件事反應非常不妙（你看過沒有派皮的大黃派長什麼樣子嗎？）。看來下次得聰明一點囉。

column1: You missed a golden opportunity while that door was open. Oh well, what's new. All alone and by yourself, you grow incredibly hungry and begin sampling your own body parts. Finding that you have absolutely no taste, (like we didn't already know that) you end up shriveling away to nothing and dying in the process.
column2: 剛剛那扇門開著的時候，你錯過了大好機會。唉，反正也不是第一次了。你孤零零一個人，餓得受不了，開始啃起自己的身體。結果發現自己一點味道都沒有（這我們早就知道了），最後你就這樣枯萎成一團什麼都不剩，死掉了。

column1: ALERT ! ALERT ! Organic contamination detected in airlock.
column2: 警報！警報！氣密艙內偵測到有機體污染。

column1: Those laser shots are incredibly effective as your body will attest. Being in plain sight probably didn't help you much.
column2: 那些雷射砲火有多厲害，你的身體可以作證。站在那麼顯眼的地方，大概也幫不了你什麼忙。

column1: This seems to be some sort of special door control panel. It requires some sort of special keycard which you obviously don't have.
column2: 這看起來是某種特殊的門禁控制面板，需要一種特殊磁卡才能用，而你顯然沒有。

column1: There is nothing you can do to it without one of those keycards.
column2: 沒有那種磁卡，你對它一點辦法都沒有。

column1: You would have to take your helmet off to do that and it's not a very good idea right now.
column2: 你得先脫掉頭盔才能這麼做，現在這麼做可不是什麼好主意。

column1: You can't do that with a helmet on.
column2: 戴著頭盔沒辦法這麼做。

column1: Your screams will do nothing in this airlock.
column2: 在這氣密艙裡，你怎麼叫都沒用。

column1: That appears to have no noticeable affect on the panel.
column2: 這麼做對面板似乎沒什麼作用。

column1: It appears to be some sort of high-tech fire droid.
column2: 這看起來是某種高科技滅火機器人。

column1: There is nothing you can do to this droid. It's virtually indestructable.
column2: 你拿這機器人一點辦法都沒有，它幾乎是打不壞的。

column1: If you could smell through your helmet you would know that this droid smells like smoke and fire.
column2: 要是頭盔能讓你聞到味道，你就會知道這機器人聞起來一股煙硝味。

column1: Not out here.
column2: 在外面不行。

column1: Intent on his cleaning duties, the little droid ignores your feeble attempts at a bribe.
column2: 這小機器人一心只顧著打掃，根本沒把你那沒誠意的賄賂放在眼裡。

column1: The droid seems totally unconcerned with the data cartridge.
column2: 這機器人對資料匣完全沒興趣。

column1: The widget and the droid do not appear to have any affect on one another.
column2: 強力磁鐵和這機器人似乎彼此都沒有反應。

column1: This robot is not equipped with speech circuits, therefore there's nothing to translate.
column2: 這機器人沒有裝語音電路，根本沒什麼好翻譯的。

column1: He doesn't seem threatened, does he?
column2: 他看起來一點都不怕，對吧？

column1: Somehow you doubt the droid would have need of water.
column2: 你怎麼想都覺得這機器人應該用不到水。

column1: It's much to busy to spend time talking to the likes of you.
column2: 它忙得很，沒空跟你這種人閒聊。

column1: The airlock door looks unfortunately thick and sturdy.
column2: 這氣密艙門看起來厚實又堅固，真不巧。

column1: This door is designed to withstand the vacuum of space. I seriously doubt that you could do anything to it.
column2: 這扇門是設計來抵擋太空真空的，我很懷疑你能拿它怎麼樣。

column1: The door smells much like other doors you have sniffed in the past.
column2: 這扇門聞起來跟你以前聞過的門差不多。

column1: The taste of the door - ferrous metal with just the slightest nuance of industrial-strength bulkead polish - reveals no new insights.
column2: 這扇門嚐起來——鐵金屬的味道，帶點工業級艙壁亮光劑的淡淡氣息——沒讓你多懂什麼新東西。

column1: Shouting for help would be useless at best and fatal at worst.
column2: 大喊求救，往好處想沒用，往壞處想會要你的命。

column1: It appears to be a decontamination unit, something like the ones used to zap Andromedan cockroaches aboard the Arcada. You wonder what it's here for.
column2: 這看起來是一台除污裝置，跟阿寇達號上用來電死仙女座蟑螂的那種很像。你很好奇它擺在這裡幹嘛。

column1: Touching these things can be hazardous to your health.
column2: 碰這些東西對你的健康可能有害。

column1: Ozone. Definitely ozone.
column2: 臭氧味，絕對是臭氧味。

column1: After seeing what a decontaminator can do to an unwary cockroach, you've never had the least desire to lick one.
column2: 看過除污裝置怎麼對付一隻沒注意的蟑螂之後，你從此對舔這種東西完全沒有興趣。

column1: You really don't want to attract its attention.
column2: 你真的不會想引起它注意。

column1: That just doesn't seem to work here.
column2: 這招在這裡似乎不管用。

column1: Well it looks like you won't be using that unit again.
column2: 看樣子這台裝置你是沒機會再用了。

column1: Your overheating backpack lies smoking on the floor - you hope that it doesn't explode.
column2: 你那過熱的背包正冒著煙躺在地上——你只希望它別爆炸。

column1: It's pretty much useless. No sense in wasting your time on it now.
column2: 這東西差不多沒用了，現在浪費時間在它身上不值得。

column1: You don't want to go near it. It may explode.
column2: 你可不會想靠近它，它可能會爆炸。

column1: The jetpack is soaked in foam fire retardant. I'd pass if I were you.
column2: 這噴射背包整個泡在滅火泡沫裡，換作是我就不會碰它了。

column1: You can't vent your suit enough to do that in the airlock.
column2: 在這氣密艙裡，你的太空裝洩壓不夠，沒辦法這麼做。

column1: You can't taste anything from here.
column2: 從這裡你什麼味道都嚐不到。

column1: You can talk to it all you want, but it's still damaged beyond repair.
column2: 你要跟它講什麼都行，反正它已經壞到沒得修了。

column1: The only item that might be useful is a blow dryer and you don't have one.
column2: 唯一派得上用場的東西是吹風機，可惜你身上沒有。

column1: The only item that would be of any use right now would be a fire extingisher and you don't seem to have one right now.
column2: 現在唯一有用的東西是滅火器，看來你手邊沒有。

column1: This seems to be some sort of special door control panel. It seems to require some sort of special keycard which you obviously don't have. You'll need to try something else.
column2: 這看起來是某種特殊的門禁控制面板，似乎需要一種特殊磁卡才能用，而你顯然沒有。你得換個辦法試試。

column1: You would have to take off your helmet to do that. It's a poor idea at this time.
column2: 你得先脫掉頭盔才能這麼做，現在這麼做可不太妙。

column1: Your screams will do nothing but let the Sariens know you're here.
column2: 你怎麼叫都沒用，只會讓沙利安人知道你在這裡。

column1: You are in some sort of storage room.
column2: 你人在某個儲藏室裡。

column1: You are in some sort of storage room. A large trunk occupies the center of the room. Perhaps one of the little Sariens is away at Enemy Eviscerating Training Camp.
column2: 你人在某個儲藏室裡，房間正中央擺著一個大箱子。也許哪個沙利安小兵正在「敵人開膛訓練營」受訓吧。

column1: The vent grill is now open.
column2: 通風柵欄現在開了。

column1: An air shaft protrudes from the wall above your head. It's covered by a vent grill.
column2: 頭頂上方的牆壁伸出一根通風管，上面蓋著一片通風柵欄。

column1: You can't reach the vent and besides, you don't need to climb through the vent now that you have a Sarien uniform on.
column2: 你搆不到通風口，而且你現在穿著沙利安人制服，也用不著爬通風管了。

column1: The vent is already open.
column2: 通風口已經開著了。

column1: Standing in the open trunk won't give you any height advantage.
column2: 站在打開的箱子裡，高度也沒有增加多少。

column1: It's already moved.
column2: 已經搬過了。

column1: The trunk on the floor appears to be open. It looks big enough to hold a body.
column2: 地上這個箱子看起來是開著的，大小裝得下一具身體。

column1: The trunk is unremarkable in every way.
column2: 這箱子怎麼看都平平無奇。

column1: You don't need to mess with the trunk now.
column2: 現在不用再去弄這箱子了。

column1: Your hands by themselves are incapable of opening it.
column2: 光靠你的手，打不開這個。

column1: You feel a fresh breeze coming through the grill of the vent. If you were a lot taller, you could touch the grill itself.
column2: 你感覺到一陣涼風從通風柵欄吹來。要是你再高一點，就能摸到那片柵欄了。

column1: It sounds like someone (or something) is approaching.
column2: 聽起來有什麼人（或什麼東西）正在靠近。

column1: You hear footsteps approaching and they're getting close. You might only have seconds to do something!
column2: 你聽到腳步聲越來越近，可能只剩幾秒鐘可以行動了！

column1: Bingo! He got you. You might consider not being around when these guys are shooting. Those things hurt.
column2: 中獎了！他打中你了。下次這些傢伙開槍時，你最好別待在附近，那東西打下去很痛的。

column1: This is the ventilation system for the Deltaur. Around you, you can see ventilation shafts running in three different directions. A ladder provides access to all three directions. At the end of the shaft in the middle, you see a ventilation grill.
column2: 這裡是代爾它號的通風系統。你四周可以看到通風管往三個方向延伸，一座梯子連接這三個方向。正中間那條通風管的盡頭，你看到一片通風柵欄。

column1: This is the ventilation system for the Deltaur. Around you, you see the ventilation shafts running in two directions with a ladder leading from one shaft to the other.
column2: 這裡是代爾它號的通風系統。你四周可以看到通風管往兩個方向延伸，一座梯子連接這兩條通風管。

column1: Ouch! That grill is stuck tight. Its going to take more than that impervious head of yours to knock it open.
column2: 唉唷！這片柵欄卡得死緊，光靠你那顆刀槍不入的頭，可打不開它。

column1: With a mighty (wimpy) kick you manage to hurt your foot. However, the vent grill opens.
column2: 你狠狠踹了一腳——其實遜斃了——成功把自己的腳踢得半死。不過，通風柵欄總算開了。

column1: You are not close enough to the vent grill to open it.
column2: 你離通風柵欄不夠近，打不開它。

column1: This is a vent grill which appears to lead to another room on the Deltaur. It appears to be closed.
column2: 這是一片通風柵欄，看起來通往代爾它號上的另一個房間，目前是關著的。

column1: This is the vent grill you pried open to get in here.
column2: 這就是你撬開、鑽進來這裡的那片通風柵欄。

column1: Nothing like a nice tongue load of dust.
column2: 沒什麼比舌頭上沾滿灰塵更棒的了。

column1: It smells dusty.
column2: 聞起來一股灰塵味。

column1: That doesn't help.
column2: 這樣沒用。

column1: The little buggers are too fast.
column2: 這些小東西動作太快了。

column1: It's just a ladder. Go crazy.
column2: 就只是一座梯子，你想爬就爬吧。

column1: It's an interesting device. Two upright parallel tubes connect many shorter rungs spaced at regular intervals allowing one to change their elevation in a positive or negative direction.
column2: 這是個挺有意思的裝置：兩根直立平行的管子，中間連著許多間隔均等的短橫桿，讓人可以往上或往下改變自己的高度。

column1: It tastes like smoething that might have been stuck to boot bottoms.
column2: 嚐起來像是黏在鞋底上的什麼東西。

column1: That's not effective here.
column2: 這招在這裡不管用。

column1: It's served its purpose already.
column2: 它已經完成任務了。

column1: On the floor sits the trunk you rode here in.
column2: 地上放著你搭來這裡的那個箱子。

column1: The vent grill is open. Its pattern, however, is permanently engraved upon your memory and your foot.
column2: 通風柵欄開著。不過它的紋路，已經永遠刻進你的記憶——還有你的腳裡了。

column1: This is another vent grill.
column2: 這是另一片通風柵欄。

column1: You don't need to bother with the vent now.
column2: 現在不用再管這通風口了。

column1: Ahh! You've apparently acquired a taste for dust. I'll bet you're going to miss it when the game is over.
column2: 啊！看來你已經愛上灰塵的味道了。我敢打賭遊戲結束後你會很想念它。

column1: It only makes you sneeze.
column2: 這只會讓你打噴嚏。

column1: Behind the glass door of the machine, you can see a load of dirty Sarien uniform components.
column2: 透過機器的玻璃門，你可以看到一堆髒兮兮的沙利安人制服零件。

column1: In the machine area are your old duds. Good thing you got rid of them. You'd be awfully conspicuous in them.
column2: 機器那邊放著你的舊衣服。還好你把它們甩掉了，穿著那些衣服，你可會顯眼得不得了。

column1: No way would you consider repeating the experience.
column2: 你才不會想再經歷一次那種事。

column1: See the nose message.
column2: 參見「鼻子」的訊息。

column1: You're doing it again - clicking cursors on things to get funny messages. Stop that - this is a serious game!
column2: 你又來了——到處點滑鼠只為了看好笑的訊息。別鬧了，這可是一款嚴肅的遊戲！

column1: That proves unfulfilling.
column2: 結果一點滿足感都沒有。

column1: You don't need those. When, or should I say if, you get home, you can buy some new ones.
column2: 你不需要那些東西。等你回家的時候——或者該說「如果」你回得了家——再買新的就好。

column1: Old fabris softener sheets rest on the floor here.
column2: 地上散落著幾張舊的衣物柔軟片。

column1: Old fabris softener sheets rest on the floor here. Hey! There's an ID card there also.
column2: 地上散落著幾張舊的衣物柔軟片。嘿！那邊還有一張識別卡。

column1: Your tongue is now wrinkle and static free.
column2: 你的舌頭現在不皺也不會有靜電了。

column1: They smell spring fresh.
column2: 聞起來有股春天般的清新味。

column1: That of no use.
column2: 那沒什麼用。

column1: You can't do that from in here.
column2: 你待在這裡面，沒辦法這麼做。

column1: Now, this is truly unpleasant. You're definitely seeing more than you want to. Check out those incredibly ugly boxers!
column2: 這下真的很尷尬了。你看到的東西絕對超出你想看的範圍。瞧瞧那條醜到爆的四角褲！

column1: Uh, oh! It's one of those Sarien dudes you saw on the Arcada monitors. You might be in deep stuff now.
column2: 糟了！這就是你在阿寇達號監視器上看到的那種沙利安傢伙。你這下麻煩大了。

column1: There's no need to go through that again!
column2: 沒必要再經歷一次那種事了！

column1: Another helmet sits in the washer.
column2: 洗衣機裡還有一頂頭盔。

column1: Ugh! It tastes like detergent.
column2: 噁！嚐起來像洗衣精。

column1: You see a hint of scaley dandruff.
column2: 你看到一點鱗片狀的頭皮屑。

column1: That's not helpful.
column2: 那沒用。

column1: A large vent shaft protrudes from the left wall of the laundry room.
column2: 洗衣間左邊牆上突出一根粗大的通風管。

column1: That's not a good idea.
column2: 這主意不太好。

column1: It's just a shadow.
column2: 那只是個影子。

column1: Various pipes, ducts and other innocuous pieces of equipment form pronounced shadows throughout the room.
column2: 各種管線、風管，還有一些無害的設備，在房間裡投下清晰的影子。

column1: The floor's nice and shiny. Even if it wasn't, you don't have the spare to work on it.
column2: 地板亮晶晶的。就算不亮，你也沒空去處理它。

column1: The floor's nice and shiny.
column2: 地板亮晶晶的。

column1: Just what you thought - waxey build-up. You'd be ashamed if you were in charge of this floor.
column2: 跟你猜的一樣——一層蠟垢。要是這地板歸你管，你會丟臉丟到家。

column1: It smells waxey.
column2: 聞起來有蠟味。

column1: No result is forthcoming.
column2: 沒有任何反應。

column1: This is almost certainly a cheap Sarien knock-off of the genuine Cleanse-O-Matic Rinse 'n Dip used to launder the crew uniforms aboard the Arcada.
column2: 這幾乎可以肯定是山寨版的沙利安貨，仿冒阿寇達號上用來洗船員制服的正牌「潔淨神通洗烘機」。

column1: Quit goofing off and do something useful!
column2: 別鬼混了，做點正經事吧！

column1: A faint miasma of Hijax liquid detergent hovers in the air near the machine.
column2: 機器附近瀰漫著一股淡淡的「海爵」洗衣精味道。

column1: That's of no help.
column2: 那沒什麼用。

column1: Whoa... what a ride!
column2: 哇賽……這趟真刺激！

column1: Uh, oh! You hear someone coming.
column2: 糟了！你聽到有人過來了。

column1: Darn static cling! Hey, look at that! By the most amazing stroke of luck, you've traded in your extremely conspicuous Xenon space suit for a Sarien officer's uniform complete with helmet.
column2: 討厭的靜電黏黏！嘿，你看看這個！運氣好到不像話，你那套顯眼到爆的氙星太空裝，就這樣換成了一套連頭盔都有的沙利安軍官制服。

column1: Searching the pockets of your newly found disguise, you find the number of possessions you were packing has been greatly reduced. In fact, lost in that limbo void to where socks and baseballs disappear is everything but the data cartridge.
column2: 你搜了搜新換來的偽裝口袋，發現身上原本帶的家當少了一大半。事實上，除了資料匣之外，其他東西全都消失在那個專門吞襪子和棒球的異次元空間裡了。

column1: Searching the pockets of your newly found disguise, you find the number of possessions you were packing has been greatly reduced. In fact, everything was lost in that limbo void to where socks and baseballs disappear except one lucky buckazoid.
column2: 你搜了搜新換來的偽裝口袋，發現身上原本帶的家當少了一大半。事實上，除了一枚走運的太空幣之外，其他東西全都消失在那個專門吞襪子和棒球的異次元空間裡了。

column1: It sounds like someone is approaching this room!
column2: 聽起來有人正朝這個房間走過來！

column1: You hear footsteps approaching. You only have seconds to do something!
column2: 你聽到腳步聲越來越近，只剩幾秒鐘讓你反應！

column1: This vent is shut tight. You don't think anything short of kicking it from the other side could get it open.
column2: 這通風口關得死緊。你覺得除非有人從另一邊把它踹開，不然根本打不開。

column1: You can't seem to reach the vent from here
column2: 你這個角度好像搆不到那個通風口

column1: You can't get that from here.
column2: 你這裡拿不到那個。

column1: It looks like a gas grenade.
column2: 看起來像顆瓦斯手榴彈。

column1: It's a counter panel capable of opening to allow passage behind the counter.
column2: 這是個櫃檯板，打得開，可以讓人繞到櫃檯後面。

column1: Naw. Bad idea.
column2: 唉唷，這主意不好。

column1: The droid is to busy to chitchat.
column2: 這台機器人忙得沒空跟你哈拉。

column1: I really have no idea why you feel I'd want to waste my enormous brain power contemplating a common data cartridge. You really are a dim-witted lifeform, aren't you?
column2: 我實在搞不懂，你怎麼會覺得我願意浪費我這顆超級大腦去研究一個普通的資料匣。你這種生物，腦袋真的不太靈光，對吧？

column1: The droid is too busy.
column2: 這台機器人正忙著。

column1: This is a storeroom where a great deal of the Deltaur's weaponry is kept. Various other weapons are firmly secured to the exterior of the small structure.
column2: 這是間儲藏室，代爾它號大部分的武器都放在這裡。其他各式武器則牢牢固定在這座小建築外側。

column1: This is a storeroom where a great deal of the Deltaur's weaponry is kept. Various other weapons are firmly secured to the exterior of the small structure. On the counter, in front of the storeroom, is a loose gas grenade.
column2: 這是間儲藏室，代爾它號大部分的武器都放在這裡。其他各式武器則牢牢固定在這座小建築外側。儲藏室前的櫃檯上，擺著一顆沒固定好的瓦斯手榴彈。

column1: This is a store room where a great deal of the Deltaur's weapons are kept. Various other weapons are firmly secured to the exterior of the small structure. On the counter, in front of the storeroom, are two loose gas grenades.
column2: 這是間儲藏室，代爾它號大部分的武器都放在這裡。其他各式武器則牢牢固定在這座小建築外側。儲藏室前的櫃檯上，擺著兩顆沒固定好的瓦斯手榴彈。

column1: That yields no result.
column2: 這麼做什麼都沒發生。

column1: This is a long S-shaped counter top that runs from one end of the armory to the other. At one end there is an opening, probably used to allow access to the other side of counter.
column2: 這是一張S形的長櫃檯，貫穿整間軍械庫。其中一端有個開口，看起來是讓人繞到櫃檯另一側用的。

column1: It tastes very mica-like.
column2: 嚐起來很有雲母的味道。

column1: It smells like you'd expect a counter to smell.
column2: 聞起來就跟你想像中的櫃檯味道一樣。

column1: Funny, no taste.
column2: 奇怪，沒有味道。

column1: It smells void.
column2: 聞起來，嗯，什麼味道都沒有。

column1: You can't do anything to or with a shadow.
column2: 你對一個影子做不了什麼事。

column1: You can carry only one grenade at a time.
column2: 你一次只能帶一顆手榴彈。

column1: I wouldn't mess with him if I were you.
column2: 換作是我，才不會去惹他。

column1: It's a pretty stupid-looking robot, but, then, looks can be deceiving (except in your case).
column2: 這台機器人看起來蠢蠢的，不過，人不可貌相——你除外。

column1: I don't think it would take kindly to that action.
column2: 我看它不會太喜歡你這個動作。

column1: You are on the wrong level to do that.
column2: 你不在對的樓層，做不了這件事。

column1: My, aren't you the clumsy one. Because of your inability to walk without falling on your face, your helmet has been collected by the trash droid. Now you've blown your cover. The Sariens are sure to shoot first and ask questions later.
column2: 唉呀，你還真是笨手笨腳。你走路走到跌了個狗吃屎，頭盔就這樣被垃圾機器人撿走了。你的偽裝現在整個曝光，沙利安人絕對是先開槍再問問題的那種。

column1: You are reluctant to tarnish the shiny gold casing.
column2: 你捨不得弄髒這層閃亮的金色外殼。

column1: It smells expensive.
column2: 聞起來很值錢。

column1: Not bad.
column2: 還不錯。

column1: It does sort of look like a speaker, doesn't it. But it isn't.
column2: 看起來是有點像喇叭，對吧？但其實不是。

column1: It looks fragile - better leave it alone.
column2: 看起來很脆弱，還是別碰的好。

column1: A subtle ozone odor clings to the egg-shaped doodad.
column2: 這顆蛋形小玩意散發著一絲淡淡的臭氧味。

column1: Tongue-zaps are no fun.
column2: 舌頭被電到可一點都不好玩。

column1: It crackles and hums, but does not speak.
column2: 它劈啪作響，還嗡嗡叫，但就是不說話。

column1: Somehow it doesn't seem wise to fiddle with it.
column2: 總覺得亂碰它不是什麼聰明的做法。

column1: The static electricity clinging to the spectrofonic module tickles your tongue, not unpleasantly.
column2: 「頻譜音控模組」上殘留的靜電讓你舌頭有點酥麻，感覺還不賴。

column1: It seems to be saying: `And now, live from the Sobodno Ballroom in beautiful downtown Knogsville, KSAR presents Boggo Snard and his orchestra in the Sarien Swing Hour.' Of course it could be some kind of code.
column2: 它似乎正在說：「現在為您做現場直播，地點是風光明媚的諾格斯維爾市中心索柏多諾舞廳，KSAR電台為您獻上波哥·斯納德樂團的《沙利安搖擺時間》。」當然，這也可能是某種暗號。

column1: You're afraid to mess with it.
column2: 你不敢亂碰它。

column1: You want to talk to a generator?
column2: 你想跟一台發電機講話？

column1: You discover the lights are not flavored as you suspected.
column2: 你發現這些燈其實沒什麼味道，跟你猜的不一樣。

column1: Smells like garbage, doesn't it?
column2: 聞起來像垃圾，對吧？

column1: Oh, come on!
column2: 拜託，別鬧了！

column1: You holler down the chute, but no one answers. You're relieved, somehow.
column2: 你對著滑槽大喊，但沒人回應。不知道為什麼，你反而鬆了一口氣。

column1: Your on the wrong level to do that.
column2: 你不在對的樓層，做不了這件事。

column1: You're not at home with the idea of touching this thing.
column2: 你對摸這東西這件事，完全提不起勁。

column1: The electric charge around the globe tickles your nose hairs.
column2: 這顆球周圍的電荷讓你的鼻毛癢癢的。

column1: You really don't want to lick this.
column2: 你真的不會想舔這個。

column1: Yikes! I guess that was a bad idea, eh! I guess you'll be staying out of the garbage disposal in the future.
column2: 哎唷！看來這主意真的很爛，對吧！看來你以後會離垃圾處理機遠遠的。

column1: Gee, that must have been a pretty powerful energy beam, seeing as how it reduced you to a pile of carbonized matter.
column2: 哎呀，那道能量光束威力一定不小，把你直接烤成了一堆碳渣。

column1: Good shootin', Tex. You really did it now, Wilco. Don't you know that macromat field integrators are extremely fragile pieces of equipment and indiscriminatly shooting at them with a pulseray gun can be hazardous to your health?
column2: 神槍手，威爾科，你這下真的搞大條了。你不知道巨積場整合器是超級脆弱的精密設備，隨便拿雷射槍亂轟，會要你的命嗎？

column1: This close to the Wally globes, all your nose hairs are standing on end.
column2: 離「瓦利球」這麼近，你的鼻毛全都豎起來了。

column1: I don't think you want to do that.
column2: 我看你不會想這麼做。

column1: Get real.
column2: 醒醒吧。

column1: Smells sort of blue.
column2: 聞起來有點像藍色的味道。

column1: Hmmmm. Soft.
column2: 嗯……軟軟的。

column1: Fuzzy. Provocative. Well-seasoned.
column2: 毛茸茸的。有點挑逗。而且很夠味。

column1: There's nobody in there.
column2: 裡面沒有人。

column1: Your engineering expertise informs you that this is a carelessly discarded Williamson coil.
column2: 憑你的工程專業判斷，這是一個被隨手亂丟的威廉森線圈。

column1: Of course it could also be a humongous escargot.
column2: 當然，它也可能是隻超級巨大的蝸牛。

column1: Not knowing whether it's alive or not, you're not eager to touch it.
column2: 你搞不清楚這東西是死是活，實在不太想去碰它。

column1: Garlic - chives - butter...
column2: 蒜頭……韭菜……奶油……

column1: No time for chit-chat. You're here on a mission, remember?
column2: 沒空聊天，你可是身負任務來的，記得嗎？

column1: You give the cleaning droid a shove. It appears to be in standby mode and doesn't budge.
column2: 你推了清潔機器人一把。它看起來正處於待機模式，動也不動。

column1: The heady scents of petroleum distillates and Sarien refuse titillates your nostrils.
column2: 石油餾出物混著沙利安人垃圾的濃烈氣味，直衝你的鼻腔。

column1: You can't be serious!
column2: 你不是認真的吧！

column1: The droid does not speak to you. It's possible you've been snubbed.
column2: 這台機器人沒有理你。看來你可能被冷落了。

column1: It smells like transparent.
column2: 聞起來像是透明的味道。

column1: It tastes like shit.
column2: 嚐起來像大便一樣。

column1: It tastes like built-up glass cleaner.
column2: 嚐起來像是一層厚厚的玻璃清潔劑。

column1: Deciding to give your Sarien counterpart some work, you smudge the glass.
column2: 你決定讓你那位沙利安同行多點事做，故意把玻璃弄髒。

column1: They smell globular.
column2: 聞起來圓滾滾的。

column1: They taste globular.
column2: 嚐起來圓滾滾的。

column1: Deciding to give your Sarien counterpart some more work, you smudge the globes with your dirty hands.
column2: 你決定再讓你那位沙利安同行多做點事，用髒手把那些球弄得髒兮兮的。

column1: You can't shoot that from here.
column2: 你這裡打不到那個。

column1: There's no need to use the remote now, the force field is already off.
column2: 現在不需要再用力場遙控器了，力場已經關掉了。

column1: There is a force field around the Star Generator. You will need to turn if off first.
column2: 星辰產生器外圍有力場保護，你得先把它關掉才行。

column1: The Star Generator is already set to blow, Roger! Maybe you oughtta do the same!
column2: 星辰產生器已經設定好要爆了，羅傑！你也差不多該跟著「開溜」了吧！

column1: You can't do that from up here.
column2: 你在這上面做不了那件事。

column1: Don't you think you've gassed this guy enough?
column2: 你不覺得已經薰他薰得夠多了嗎？

column1: You could drop the cartridge on his big ugly head, but you might damage the data. Better find something more suited to the task.
column2: 你是可以把資料匣往他那顆醜到爆的大頭上砸下去，但這樣可能會把資料弄壞。還是找個更適合幹這件事的東西吧。

column1: You think he might be more interested in it if he were alive.
column2: 你覺得要是他還活著，搞不好會對這東西更有興趣。

column1: This is the biggest, toughest (not to mention ugliest) Sarien guard you have ever seen. At present he is diligently guarding the Star Generator from intruders such as yourself. He's wearing some sort of gadget on his belt, but from here you can't tell what its purpose might be.
column2: 這是你見過最壯、最凶悍（更別提最醜）的沙利安守衛。他此刻正盡忠職守地看守著星辰產生器，提防像你這樣的入侵者。他腰帶上掛著某種小裝置，但你這個角度看不出那是做什麼用的。

column1: He's also wondering what your doing back there.
column2: 他同時也在納悶，你躲在後面到底在幹嘛。

column1: You notice a remote control device on the guards belt.
column2: 你注意到守衛的腰帶上掛著一個力場遙控器。

column1: The guard lies in a red heap on the floor, overcome by the toxic gas from the grenade. Some kind of electronic gadget is hanging from his belt.
column2: 守衛整個人紅通通地倒成一堆，被手榴彈的毒氣給撂倒在地。他的腰帶上還掛著某種電子小裝置。

column1: This is a guy of few words, none of them for you.
column2: 這傢伙是個惜字如金的人，一個字都不打算跟你講。

column1: I can not answer any questions without proper ID.
column2: 沒有適當的身分證明，我沒辦法回答任何問題。

column1: This guy is more talkative dead than alive. He's dead silent.
column2: 這傢伙死後反而比生前愛講話——才怪，他安靜得跟具屍體一樣。

column1: If you touch him, he might touch you back.
column2: 你要是敢碰他，他可能也會碰你一下喔。

column1: The guard has nothing else of interest.
column2: 這守衛身上沒有其他有意思的東西了。

column1: Oh no Roger! The guard has seen you and you're not wearing the helmet! You're in for it now Wilco!
column2: 糟了羅傑！守衛看到你了，你沒戴頭盔！威爾科，你這下慘了！

column1: Boy, you're no Marshall Dillon, that's for sure. And you were so close. You'll need to react a little faster be little sharper than that. Well, throw a little bondo into that hole and get back in there.
column2: 少來了，你才不是什麼神槍手警長，這點無庸置疑，你只差了那麼一點點而已。下次得反應快一點、機伶一點才行。好啦，先拿補土把那個洞補一補，然後回去繼續幹活吧。

column1: The Sarien warrior is guarding the stolen Star Generator so intensly, he didn't notice the gas grenade exploding.
column2: 那名沙利安戰士看守被偷來的星辰產生器看得太專心，根本沒注意到瓦斯手榴彈就在旁邊炸開了。

column1: Actually, his walkman is cranked up too high.
column2: 其實是他的隨身聽開得太大聲了啦。

column1: The dead Sarien guard might have noticed that, if he were alive.
column2: 那個死掉的沙利安守衛要是還活著，說不定會注意到吧。

column1: You remove the device from the guard's belt. It looks like you have found the remote control that turns off the force field around the Star Generator.
column2: 你從守衛的腰帶上拿下那個裝置，看起來你找到了能關掉星辰產生器周圍力場的遙控器。

column1: You press the stud on the remote and the force field around the Star Generator begins to deplete.
column2: 你按下遙控器上的按鈕，星辰產生器周圍的力場開始減弱。

column1: Ouch! That stings just a tad. You'll obviously need to disarm that baby before trying that again.
column2: 哎唷！這下有點刺痛喔。看樣子你得先把那玩意兒解除，才能再試一次。

column1: Sir, the destruct code is %d.
column2: 長官，自爆密碼是 %d。

column1: It appears the shield is preventing you from getting to the Star Generator's control panel and boy is it hot. You'd better not try to get close to the Star Generator again.
column2: 看來這道護盾擋住了你靠近星辰產生器控制面板的路，而且燙得要命。你最好別再想靠近星辰產生器了。

column1: The Star Generator is already set to blow Roger! You had better find someway to get a million miles from the Deltaur and quick!
column2: 星辰產生器已經設定好要爆炸了，羅傑！你最好想辦法趕快離代爾它號遠一點，越快越好！

column1: Oh No! Your rotten aim has attracted the attention of one of the patrol guards. You're in for it now!
column2: 糟了！你這爛準頭引來了一名巡邏守衛的注意，這下你慘了！

column1: Boy, you're no Marshall Dillon, that's for sure. And you were so close. You'll need to react a little faster be little sharper than that. Well, throw a little bondo into that whole and get back in there.
column2: 少來了，你才不是什麼神槍手警長，這點無庸置疑，你只差了那麼一點點而已。下次得反應快一點、機伶一點才行。好啦，先拿補土把那個洞補一補，然後回去繼續幹活吧。

column1: Enter Code:
column2: 輸入密碼：

column1: Self Destruct Engaged
column2: 自爆程序啟動

column1: Invalid Code Entered
column2: 密碼輸入錯誤

column1: Have a nice day
column2: 祝你有個美好的一天

column1: You close your eyes in hopes your death will be quick, but, to your surprise, the guards do not notice you. In fact, you think your uniform is that of a higher-ranking Sarien officer worth sucking up to. Cool!
column2: 你閉上眼睛，希望死得痛快一點，沒想到守衛根本沒注意到你。看來你這身制服像是哪個階級比較高的沙利安軍官，還讓人想巴結咧。酷！

column1: You hear a strange rumbling sound. Uh, oh. It seems that you didn't make it out in time. Be seeing you.
column2: 你聽到一陣奇怪的隆隆聲。糟了，看來你沒能及時逃出去。咱們有緣再見了。

column1: There goes your ride, Roger. Too bad you can't call a taxi.
column2: 你的座車就這樣飛了，羅傑。可惜這裡叫不到計程車。

column1: Out of the kindness of our hearts, we're just going to kill you off right now and save you the wait until the ship blows up. Be seeing you.
column2: 出於好心，我們決定現在就讓你痛快歸西，省得你在船爆炸前一直等。咱們有緣再見了。

column1: It's an escape pod launch tube minus the escape pod. This presents a serious survival problem.
column2: 這是逃生艙的發射管，只不過裡面沒有逃生艙——這下你的存活問題可大了。

column1: There's not much you can do without an escape pod.
column2: 沒有逃生艙，你也做不了什麼。

column1: There's nobody here to talk to.
column2: 這裡沒有人可以說話。

column1: Exhaust fumes from the escaped pod nauseate you, not to mention the tought that you're doomed.
column2: 逃生艙噴出的廢氣讓你反胃，更別提一想到自己死定了就更想吐。

column1: I don't think licking the floor is the answer to your current dilemma.
column2: 舔地板應該解決不了你現在的困境吧。

column1: It's definitely some sort of ...thing.
column2: 這絕對是某種……東西。

column1: If you knew what it was, you might have a clue what to do with it, but since you don't, you don't.
column2: 如果你知道這是什麼，或許就知道該拿它怎麼辦——可惜你不知道，所以你不知道。

column1: Nope. Not voice-activated.
column2: 不對，這東西不是語音控制的。

column1: You're really 'way too busy for this, Roger.
column2: 羅傑，你現在真的沒空搞這個。

column1: No time for funny messages, get off the ship!
column2: 沒空講幹話了，快點離開這艘船！

column1: It's an elevator door.
column2: 這是電梯門。

column1: This door is controlled by the elevator, there is nothing you can do to it from here.
column2: 這扇門是由電梯控制的，你在這裡對它無能為力。

column1: It doesn't want to talk to you.
column2: 它不想理你。

column1: It smells like the many elevator doors you've smelled in the past.
column2: 聞起來就跟你以前聞過的一堆電梯門一樣。

column1: It tastes like the many elevator doors you've smelled in the past.
column2: 嚐起來就跟你以前聞過的一堆電梯門一樣。

column1: It's the elevator that brought you down here.
column2: 這就是把你載下來的那台電梯。

column1: It is not voice activated.
column2: 這不是語音控制的。

column1: It smells like the many elevators you've smelled in the past.
column2: 聞起來就跟你以前聞過的一堆電梯一樣。

column1: It tastes like the many elevators you've smelled in the past.
column2: 嚐起來就跟你以前聞過的一堆電梯一樣。

column1: This must be the captain's personal escape pod!
column2: 這一定是艦長的私人逃生艙！

column1: It's too late to do that now.
column2: 現在做這個已經太遲了。

column1: The escape pod is not equipped with voice-recognition capability.
column2: 這艘逃生艙沒有語音辨識功能。

column1: The ship could blow up in a million fiery pieces while you waste time licking the only thing that can get you off it in one piece!
column2: 這艘船隨時可能炸成漫天火花，你卻在這裡浪費時間舔唯一能讓你全身而退的東西！

column1: You're wasting valuable time here.
column2: 你在這裡浪費寶貴的時間。

column1: Well, Roger, you did it. You saved the galaxy, received your profession's most noble tribute and got the girl.
column2: 好啦，羅傑，你辦到了。你拯救了銀河系，得到了你這一行最崇高的表揚，還抱得美人歸。

column1: Wait a minute - there wasn't any girl! Sorry. Well, you got the mop, anyway. From now on, Xenon's your oyster. All you have to do now is sit back and let the book and movie offers roll in. Who knows - maybe you'll even have a series.
column2: 等等——才沒有什麼美人！抱歉啦。不過你好歹拿回了那支拖把。從現在起，整個氙星都是你的天下了。你只要坐著等書約跟電影邀約自己送上門就好。誰知道呢，說不定你還能拍成影集。

column1: And now, as the sun sets on the peaceful blue planet, Xenon, and Roger Wilco's first adventure (yes, I'm afraid there are more), we hope you will remain in your seat long enough to let us express OUR limitless appreciation.
column2: 此刻，夕陽緩緩落在這顆祥和的藍色行星氙星上，羅傑·威爾科的第一場冒險也告一段落（沒錯，很遺憾還有更多集在後頭）。我們希望你能在座位上多留一會兒，好讓我們表達由衷無盡的感謝。

column1: Whew! You're off the Deltaur and safe at last. You can't ignore, however, a nagging feeling that you've forgotten something important. Now what could that be?
column2: 呼，你總算離開代爾它號，安全脫身了。不過你心裡總覺得好像忘了什麼重要的事，揮之不去。到底是什麼呢？

column1: We hate to tell you this, but your dead again. At this rate you'll never see the end of the game.
column2: 很不想這樣說，但你又死了。這樣下去，你永遠看不到遊戲結局。

column1: While you sit back and relax, soaking in the distant view as you excitedly approach Xenon, you have the uneasy feeling that you might have forgotten something.
column2: 你坐著放輕鬆，欣賞遠方的風景，興奮地接近氙星，心裡卻隱約覺得自己好像忘了什麼。

column1: Congratulations. You did a great job - to a point. That is, if you overlook the fact that you forgot to set the self-destruct seqeunce on the Star Generator leaving it ready for the Sariens to use against Xenon and the rest of the universe. Nice try.
column2: 恭喜你，表現得不錯——只不過差了那麼一點：你忘了設定星辰產生器的自爆程序，讓沙利安人還能拿它去對付氙星跟宇宙其他地方。算你厲害。

column1: Somebody wasted the CRT.
column2: 有人把這台CRT螢幕給砸爛了。

column1: This is the Data Cartridge Retrieval System.
column2: 這是資料匣讀取系統。

column1: Cartridge viewing on this system has been rendered impossible.
column2: 這套系統上的資料匣顯示功能，現在沒辦法用了。

column1: Please enter a Cartridge Code Sequence before pressing "ENTER".
column2: 請先輸入資料匣代碼，再按下「ENTER」。

column1: Cartridge found. Now retrieving.
column2: 找到資料匣了，正在讀取中。

column1: That cartridge is currently out on loan. Please try again later.
column2: 那個資料匣目前外借中，請稍後再試。

column1: Sorry, that cartridge is reserved. Please check again later.
column2: 抱歉，那個資料匣已經被預約了，請稍後再查詢。

column1: Sorry, that cartridge was destroyed in a freak fusion accident. Check back with us in a few months. Purchasing should have a new one in by then.
column2: 抱歉，那個資料匣在一次離奇的核融合意外中被毀了。請過幾個月再來看看，到時候採購部應該會補到新的。

column1: Ken took that one home. That means we'll never get it back, so don't bother checking back later.
column2: 肯把那個帶回家了，代表我們永遠拿不回來了，所以不用麻煩之後再回來查。

column1: Cartridge title not found.
column2: 查無此資料匣名稱。

column1: These buttons don't seem to be functioning properly.
column2: 這些按鈕好像運作不太正常。

column1: Howdy, bucko! Can I interest you in one of the finest little used space ships in the galaxy? You look like a man of discerning taste. This one, for instance, is just your speed... er... style, that is!
column2: 「哈囉啊，兄弟！有沒有興趣看看銀河系裡數一數二的二手太空船啊？你這人一看就很有品味。就拿這台來說吧，簡直就是為你的速度……呃，我是說風格量身打造的！」

column1: Oops, sorry, chief. I forgot, you've already purchased that ship. What was I thinking of?
column2: 「唉唷，抱歉啦老大。我都忘了你已經買過那艘船了，我在想什麼啊？」

column1: Well, we're back for another look at this fine, fine, piece of jun... uh... spaceware. Right, chief?
column2: 「好啊，又回來看看這艘精緻無比的破……呃，太空好貨了，對吧，老大？」

column1: This is quite a unique little unit. Never been flown over Mach 3. It was owned by a little old lady from Glansadrom. You have to fly it to believe it. And she can be yours for only 99 buckazoids. One time offer only. TALK to me, friend!
column2: 「這台可是獨一無二的寶貝，從沒飛超過三馬赫。之前的主人是格蘭薩德隆的一位小老太太。你得親自開開看才會相信。而且只要99枚太空幣就能帶她回家，機會只有這一次。跟我談談吧，朋友！」

column1: So how 'bout it, partner? Can I interest you in anything here? Can we do business, or what? I'm at your service. Talk to me, chief.
column2: 「那怎麼樣啊，夥伴？這邊有沒有什麼合你意的？咱們談得成生意嗎？我隨時候教。跟我聊聊吧，老大。」

column1: Hey, fella, waitup! S'long as you're headed in that direction, why don'tcha let me show you my other fine spacecraft? No obligation whatsoever to you, pal. Just tryin' to be helpful to one in need.
column2: 「嘿，老兄，等一下！你反正也是往那邊走，何不讓我帶你看看我另一艘好貨呢？完全不強迫你，兄弟，我只是想幫幫需要的人。」

column1: It's been a heckuva pleasure doin' business with you. Well, good luck. Come again!
column2: 「跟你做生意真是一大樂事啊。祝你好運，歡迎再來！」

column1: Well, geez, guy! It seems it's developed some minor malfunction since we acquired it. We did have a small micro-meteoroid shower the other day. Maybe that was it! Yeah, that was probably it.
column2: 「哎呀，老兄！看樣子這台自從我們收進來以後出了點小狀況。前幾天是有一場小型微隕石雨啦，說不定就是那個造成的！對，八成就是那樣。」

column1: Much as I'd like to, I can't refund your money. Company policy. It's out of my hands. However, I can give you seventy buckazoids credit on any other ship in our fine line of used spacecraft. Look around, see what you like.
column2: 「我也很想幫你，但沒辦法退錢，公司規定，我也無能為力。不過我可以給你70枚太空幣的折抵額度，換購我們其他任何一艘優質二手太空船。四處看看，挑個喜歡的吧。」

column1: Say, pal - I couldn't help noticing your skimmer. It's a genuine '86 Pleiades GL. I've been looking everywhere for one of these babies.
column2: 話說啊，朋友——我忍不住注意到你那台沙漠飛車，這可是貨真價實的86年昴宿星GL型耶。我到處在找這種寶貝呢。

column1: Fine. Be that way.
column2: 「好啊，隨便你。」

column1: Glad we could do business. I'll just take that key. Thank you kindly. Hope your stay in Ulence Flats is an interesting one.
column2: 「很高興能跟你做成生意。鑰匙就給我吧，謝啦。祝你在尤倫斯荒原玩得愉快。」

column1: Glad we could do business. Hope your stay in Ulence Flats is an interesting one.
column2: 「很高興能跟你做成生意。祝你在尤倫斯荒原玩得愉快。」

column1: Okay, buddy - you drive a hard bargain. This is my final offer and I'm only making it 'cause I can see you need it pretty bad.
column2: 「好吧，兄弟——你還真會殺價。這是我的最後一次開價，我肯開這個價，是因為看得出來你真的很需要。」

column1: I'll make it 30 buckazoids and I'll throw in this swell jetpack. It was previously owned by a little old Thark who only flew it back and forth to Phleebhut on Sunday. It works great in zero gravity. You'll love it.
column2: 「這樣吧，30枚太空幣，再送你這具超讚的噴射背包。之前的主人是個塔克族的老先生，禮拜天才會飛去弗利布特來回一趟而已。零重力下好用得很，你一定會愛上它。」

column1: Glad we could do business. I'll just take that key. Thank you kindly.
column2: 「很高興能跟你做成生意。鑰匙給我吧，謝啦。」

column1: Glad we could do business.
column2: 「很高興能跟你做成生意。」

column1: In addition, I'd like you to have these coupons good for discounts and free merchandise from some of our local merchants. As a representative of the Ulence Flats Chamber of Commerce, I hope you enjoy your visit to our friendly little community.
column2: 「另外，這幾張折價券送給你，可以在我們當地一些店家換折扣或免費商品。身為尤倫斯荒原商會的一份子，希望你喜歡這個友善的小地方。」

column1: Say there, pal. It's come to my attention that you're in the market for some transportation.
column2: 「嘿，朋友。我聽說你正在找代步工具啊。」

column1: I may be able to help. If you'll follow me, I'd like to show you a fine little piece of machinery that'll knock your eyes out.
column2: 「說不定我能幫上忙。跟我來，我帶你看一台會讓你嚇到說不出話的好機器。」

column1: Hold on Mac, I'll get to you when I can.
column2: 等一下啊老兄，我一有空就馬上招呼你。

column1: I'm busy, wait your turn.
column2: 我現在很忙，排隊等一下。

column1: I'll get to you in just a sec.
column2: 馬上就輪到你了。

column1: Here is your 5 buckazoids and your free beer.
column2: 這是你的5枚太空幣，還有你的免費啤酒。

column1: C'mon, bud. If you haven't got the money, hit the sand.
column2: 拜託喔，兄弟。沒錢就滾去外面吹沙子吧。

column1: Now, just take a gander at these beauties, sport. If ya see one ya like, just give a hoot. I'll stand right over here. No pressure. Absolutely none.
column2: 「來，瞧瞧這些寶貝，小伙子。看到喜歡的就吭一聲，我就站在這邊，完全不會給你壓力，一點都不會。」

column1: So how 'bout it partner? Can I interest you in anything here?
column2: 「那怎麼樣啊，夥伴？這邊有沒有什麼合你意的？」

column1: Can we do business, or what? I'm at your service.
column2: 「咱們談得成生意嗎？我隨時候教。」

column1: I'd really like to help you out, bud. Just give me a chance to treat you right!
column2: 「我真的很想幫你一把，兄弟。給我個機會好好照顧你！」

column1: My sole purpose in life is to make you happy.
column2: 「我這輩子唯一的目標，就是讓你開心。」

column1:
Have I mentioned that I have another party or two who are ready to deal? Not that I'm pressuring you or anything, partner. Just so you know.	「我有跟你提過還有一兩組人也準備要下手了嗎？我不是在給你壓力啦，夥伴，只是讓你知道一下。
Hey, wait a sec, sport. Follow me and I'll show you the greatest ship you've ever seen. Truly unique! You'll be the envy of all your friends. The girls'll love it.	嘿，等一下，小伙子。跟我來，我帶你看你這輩子見過最棒的船。獨一無二！你朋友看了都會眼紅，馬子也會愛死它。
Don't let appearances fool ya. This baby may be a relic, I mean, a classic, but she's as dependable as the day we got her. And just think, you'll be the only one in the quadrant with one. I guarantee it!"
column2: 「別被外表騙了。這寶貝雖然有點年紀，我是說，算是經典款啦，但她可靠得跟我們剛拿到她那天一模一樣。你想想看，整個星區就你有這一台，我掛保證！」

column1: She's a beaut, isn't she? This little baby can do a spin around the planet in just under an hour. Look at the lines in that body work. They just don't make 'em like this any more, ya' know what I mean? And she's a real bargain at 185 buckazoids.
column2: 她很漂亮吧？這小妞繞行星一圈不用一個鐘頭。你看看那車身線條，現在已經沒人做得出這種貨色了，你懂我意思吧？才185枚太空幣，真的划算。

column1: Of course, minus your 70 buckazoid credit, that would come to 115 buckazoids.
column2: 當然啦，扣掉你的70枚太空幣折抵額度，就是115枚太空幣。

column1: Well, there's a man with a good eye. This here is the keenest little scrambler in the hemisphere. Top of the line. Handles like a charm. Perfect for cruising the asteroid fields.
column2: 「唷，真有眼光啊。這台可是這半球裡數一數二犀利的飛船，頂級規格，操控起來順到不行，最適合在小行星帶裡巡航了。」

column1: And she's got all the thrust a guy could need. I tell ya, she's an outright steal at 214 buckazoids.
column2: 「她的推力更是應有盡有。老實跟你說，214枚太空幣根本是白撿的價錢。」

column1: Of course, minus your 70 buckazoid credit, that would come to, uh... 144 buckazoids.
column2: 當然啦，扣掉你的70枚太空幣折抵額度，那就是……呃，144枚太空幣。

column1: It's been a heckuva pleasure doin' business with you. It's a good thing you've already got a pilot droid, 'cause you need one to help you fly that thing. Well, good luck. Come again.
column2: 「跟你做生意真是一大樂事。還好你已經有導航機器人了，因為你需要一台才能開得動那玩意兒。祝你好運，歡迎再來。」

column1: It's been a heckuva pleasure doin' business with you. Oh, by the way, you're gonna need a droid to help you fly that thing. Well, good luck. Come again.
column2: 「跟你做生意真是一大樂事。對了，你會需要一台機器人才能幫你開那玩意兒。祝你好運，歡迎再來。」

column1: I still have that other, fine ship just to the south of here. Whad'ya say, sport, shall we go give her another look-see?
column2: 「我南邊那邊還有另一艘好船呢。怎麼樣，小伙子，要不要再去瞧一瞧？」

column1: So, what are ya tryin' to pull? If you don't have the cash you can hit the sand. Go on, get out of here. You're wasting my time!
column2: 「你到底想幹嘛啊？沒錢就滾去外面吹沙子吧。走啦，別在這裡浪費我的時間！」

column1: I tell ya, I think you've made a wise decision. She's a beauty. The keys are in her. If you have any problems don't hesitate to come back and tell us about 'em.
column2: 「老實跟你說，我覺得你這個決定很明智。她漂亮得很，鑰匙就插在裡面。有什麼問題儘管回來跟我們說一聲。」

column1: Thanks, pal. I can't say how long I've wanted one of these.
column2: 多謝啦，老兄。這個我想要好久好久了，久到我自己都數不清。

column1: All riiiight! Is this that new Earth Wars movie?
column2: 太讚了吧！這該不會是新出的《地球大戰》電影吧？

column1: Yeah, I've heard about how your kind likes to skin my kind. If you only knew what WE do to monkeys on MY planet, you'd think twice about waving that little sticker in my direction. But, hey, I'd still like to sell you somethin'. What d'ya say?
column2: 「對啊，我早聽說你們這種生物很愛剝我們的皮。要是你知道我們星球怎麼對付猴子，你拿那張小貼紙在我面前晃啊晃的時候，就會多想兩秒了。不過，嘿，我還是很樂意賣你點東西啦。你說怎樣？」

column1: Thanks a bunch, guy! This planet really dries me out. I feel like a you-know-what outa water.
column2: 太感謝了，老兄！這顆星球把我整個榨乾了。我現在整個人就像離了水的……你知道的，那個什麼東西。

column1: Hey! I'm not responsible. That ship was in A-1 shape when I sold it to you. I swear it! Hey, wait a minute. That's not from any of MY ships. What are you tryin' to pull here?
column2: 喂！這可不能怪我。這艘船賣給你的時候好得很，我發誓！嘿，等一下，這根本不是我哪艘船上的東西。你到底想耍什麼把戲？

column1: Right, guy. Like I need a stupid rock. Do I look like I was hatched just yesterday?
column2: 得了吧，老兄。我才不需要什麼笨石頭。你當我是昨天才孵出來的喔？

column1: What do you want to do, make faces at him to scare him away?
column2: 你想幹嘛，對他扮鬼臉把他嚇跑？

column1: Oh, crud! It's one of the Sarien guards. I don't think you're going to enjoy this visit.
column2: 喔，糟了！是沙利安守衛。我看你這趟拜訪應該不會太愉快。

column1: Go ahead. Walk on up and give it a try.
column2: 去啊，儘管走上去試試看。

column1: You probably thought that was actually going to work. Ha!
column2: 你該不會真的以為那招會成功吧。哈！

column1: You carbon based life forms are soooo annoying. My counterpart at Ulence Flats on Kerona told me about this one pesky humanoid in a grungy blue space suit who just kept pestering him. Oh why does commiting genocide seem such a good idea right now.
column2: 你們這些碳基生物有夠煩的。我在柯羅娜星尤倫斯荒原的同事跟我提過，有個穿著髒兮兮藍色太空裝的討厭人形生物，一天到晚纏著他。喔，現在滅絕你們整個種族聽起來怎麼這麼吸引人啊。

column1: Go away, I'm not talking to you.
column2: 走開，我沒在跟你講話。

column1: I'm not talking to you.
column2: 我沒在跟你講話。

column1: I'm still not talking to you.
column2: 我還是沒在跟你講話。

column1: Oh... welcome to the Weapons Dispensary, I guess. I've got an IQ of 5000 but they feel I'm only good enough to fetch weapons, like some whimpering puppy dog.
column2: 喔……我猜，歡迎光臨軍械供應處。我的智商有五千，但他們就是覺得我只配去幫忙拿武器，跟隻搖尾乞憐的小狗沒兩樣。

column1: You'll have to show me your ID card so I can scurry off and fetch your weapon. Why they don't just wire me into the ship's systems - so I would know who you are without an ID card - is beyond even my supreme intellect.
column2: 你得先給我看你的識別卡，我才能一溜煙跑去幫你拿武器。他們幹嘛不乾脆把我接上戰艦系統，讓我不用看識別卡就認得出你是誰——這問題就連我這種頂級智慧都想不透。

column1: Oh dear, you carbon-based life forms can be soooo annoying. Even something with your incredibly low intelligence should know enough not to enter a restricted area. I guess I'll just have to destroy you to prevent you from reproducing more of your kind.
column2: 唉呀，你們這些碳基生物有夠煩的。就算智商低得跟你一樣，也該知道不能亂闖管制區吧。我看我只好把你毀掉，免得你們這種生物又多繁殖幾隻。

column1: Oh dear... another intruder. If it isn't fetching weapons for so-and-so or checking ID cards, its vaporizing bothersome simians.
column2: 唉呀……又一個入侵者。要不是幫某某人拿武器、就是在查識別卡，不然就是把煩人的猿猴蒸發掉。

column1: As my supreme intellect suspected, another obvious organic life form error. Let me say this verrrryyyy sllloooowwwlllly, THERE ARE NO MORE WEAPONS FOR YOU.
column2: 正如我的頂級智慧所料，又是一個明顯的有機生物錯誤。讓我說得非——常——慢——一——點，你——已——經——沒——有——武——器——可——拿——了。

column1: Oh, how clever, you have an ID card and, my my what a ehem... lovely photo of a pre- proto, organic biped you have too. I guess I'll use my vast resources to fetch your silly weapon for you. Please wait here if you can handle such a simple command.
column2: 喔，真聰明啊，你有識別卡，而且，唉唷唉唷，呃……上面那張原始雙足生物的照片還真是「好看」。我看我就動用我的龐大資源，去幫你拿那把蠢武器吧。如果你應付得了這麼簡單的指令，就請在這裡等著。

column1: Hmm... are you sure you don't already have your weapon? Organics like you have such a 'tricky' memory. Are you sure you didn't do something silly like accidently eating it or something? Oh never mind. Don't overtax yourself. I'll just go check.
column2: 嗯……你確定你身上還沒有武器嗎？你們這種有機生物的記憶力還真是『高深莫測』。你確定沒做過什麼蠢事，比如不小心把它吃下肚之類的？喔，算了，別太為難自己了，我去查一下就好。

column1: Oh dear, you again. Actually, looking at your past track record, I'm surprised you didn't take off your boot and start showing me that. I'd better do evolution a favor and prevent you from reproducing. Bye.
column2: 唉呀，又是你。老實說，看你以前的紀錄，我還很驚訝你沒脫下靴子拿給我看。我看我還是幫演化一個忙，阻止你們繁殖好了。掰。

column1: Oh dear, how inconvenient. Another life form is in a restricted area. How your race manages not to vaporize itself into extinction is beyond me. I guess I'll have to be polite about this. Pardon me for terminating you.
column2: 唉呀，真不方便。又一個生物闖進管制區了。你們這個種族到現在還沒把自己蒸發滅絕，真是奇蹟。我看我還是禮貌一點好了。恕我要把你終結了。

column1: Allow me to state the obvious. This is an entirely bullet-proof environment, designed to protect us from the acts of imbeciles who fire off rapid-action implements in an enclosed space. Nevertheless, don't do that again.
column2: 容我說句廢話。這裡是完全防彈的環境，就是設計來保護我們，免得有笨蛋在密閉空間裡亂開快速擊發裝置。不過，還是別再這樣做了。

column1: Oh my, we are even below organic intellectual levels aren't we? Don't tell me, let me guess, your race evolved from belly button lint. Well, let's get this over with and do evolution a favor.
column2: 我的天，我們居然連有機生物的智力水準都不到，是吧？先別說，讓我猜猜，你們這個種族該不會是從肚臍垢演化來的吧。好啦，長痛不如短痛，就當幫演化一個忙。

column1: Well... Are we going to do something or are you practicing to walk?
column2: 怎樣……我們到底要幹嘛，還是你在練習走路啊？

column1: Heeelllllllllooo. Are we still conscious? You organic models can be soooo trying sometimes.
column2: 喂——喂。你還有意識嗎？你們這些有機款式有時候真的很磨人耐性。

column1: That's ok. Just stand around mindlessly - I don't mind. I'm just a robot, slave to you ehem... superior organic life forms, and I've been endowed with infinite patience.
column2: 沒關係，你就儘管在那邊發呆吧，我不介意。反正我只是個機器人，服侍你們這些呃……高等有機生物的奴才，天生就有無限的耐心。

column1: What's your name, soldier?
column2: 你叫什麼名字，士兵？

column1: My name's 4563345389843734763043603209350759, sir, but everyone just calls me 45633453898437 for short.
How're you doing, son.
column2: 你好啊，小子。

column2: 小子，長官？

column1: Sir, are you going to attend the maturation and reproduction ceremony tonite?
column2: 長官，你今晚會去參加成熟繁殖典禮嗎？

column1: Where might I find the Star Generator, soldier?
column2: 士兵，星辰產生器在哪裡？

column1: I'm sorry sir, it's confidential. If I told you, I'd have to kill you. No offense, its just my job.
column2: 抱歉，長官，這是機密。要是我告訴你，就得殺了你。別介意，這只是我的職責。

column1: Uh... Uh... No offense taken soldier. Good work. Just checking your alertness. Yeh, that's it, just checking your alertness.
column2: 呃……呃……不介意，士兵。做得好。我只是在測試你的警覺性。對，沒錯，就是在測試警覺性。

column2: 長官，我不能閒聊，請你快走開！

column2: 站住！任何人都不准接近艦長的私人逃生艙。

column1: If he can't use it in the slot machine, he doesn't want it.
column2: 只要沒辦法拿去吃角子老虎上用，他就沒興趣。

column1: This is strange. The sensors are returning phantom images. There seems to be another ship in the vicinity, but its location is tough to pinpoint.

column2: 現在你的植物樣本上沾滿了歐拉特的體液。不過話說回來，誰看得出差別呢？

column2: 你實在想不出有什麼理由，要把你座駕的鑰匙弄得黏答答的。

column2: 你把噴射背包抹得到處都是黏糊糊的植物汁液。恭喜你，在製造髒亂這件事上又締造了新猷。

column1: Why would you want a sticky widget?
column2: 你幹嘛會想要一個黏答答的強力磁鐵？

column2: 你現在手上的折價券黏答答的了。

column2: 磁卡你已經有了，打折也沒用。

column2: 拿折價券碰小裝置，看不出有什麼效果。

column2: 折價券對求生包沒有任何作用。

column2: 你拿折價券碰小刀，但小刀是收著的，沒什麼事發生。

column1: Now you have a soggy coupon.
column2: 你現在手上的折價券濕答答的了。

column1: You suddenly feel like touching the glass with the coupon might just be a waste of time.
column2: 你突然覺得，拿折價券去碰玻璃碎片大概只是在浪費時間。

column1: Putting the coupon on your money does not increase its value one bit.
column2: 把折價券放到你的錢上，一點都不會讓錢變多。

column1: The coupon sits on the jet pack Nothing further happens.
column2: 折價券擺在噴射背包上，沒有再發生什麼事。

column1: You touch the coupon to the widget. The results are pretty much what you expected.
column2: 你拿折價券碰了強力磁鐵，結果跟你猜的差不多。

column1: You now have gooey coupons.
column2: 你現在手上的折價券黏糊糊的了。

column1: You hear footsteps.
column2: 你聽到腳步聲。

column1: Failing to notice anyone or anything in the room, the Sarien guards decide to check elsewhere. Way to go, Roger!
column2: 沙利安守衛沒發現房間裡有任何人或任何東西，決定去別處查看。幹得好啊，羅傑！

column1: Failing to notice anyone or anything in the room, the guard decides to check elsewhere. Way to go, Roger!

column1: The aliens observe their handiwork briefly before looking for others to process in similiar fashion.
column2: 外星人短暫欣賞了一下自己的「傑作」，接著又去找下一個目標，準備如法炮製。

column2: 那個外星人短暫欣賞了一下自己的「傑作」，接著又去找下一個目標，準備如法炮製。

column1: As you lie on the floor in a smoldering, carbogelatinous heap, you just can't help but wonder why you bothered getting up this morning.
column2: 你倒在地上，變成一坨還冒著煙、黏糊糊的焦炭，忍不住開始納悶——今天早上到底幹嘛要起床。

column1: Bad news travels fast - especially when it's in the form of a shock wave.
column2: 壞消息傳得快——尤其當它是用震波的形式傳過來的時候。

column1: The explosion was pretty messy. It's a judgment call as to which one critically damaged you first. Was it the concussion? Or, maybe, the fragments of ship that were located more closely to the epicenter than yourself and attempted to escape THROUGH you?
column2: 這場爆炸搞得亂七八糟。到底是什麼先要了你的命，還真不好說。是震波本身？還是那些比你更靠近爆心、拚了命想「穿過」你逃出去的船體碎片？

column1: Regardless of what got you first, enough molecular relocation (in bulk and in individual units) occurred to forever alter your form and place in the universe.
column2: 不管是哪個先解決你，反正發生的分子搬家（不管是整批還是單顆）已經多到足以永遠改變你的樣子，還有你在這個宇宙裡的位置。

column1: Recompose yourself and let's see if we can't get off this scow more efficiently.
column2: 重新振作一下，這次我們想辦法更有效率地離開這艘破船吧。

column1: You have %2d:%02d till the Arcada self-destructs.
column2: 距離阿寇達號自爆還有 %2d:%02d。

column1: You're not going to be able to feel anything from this distance.
column2: 隔這麼遠，你什麼感覺都不會有的。

column1: `Yodel-Ay-Hee-Hoo!' you call to the distant slopes. There is a slight delay, then a faint voice replies: `For pity's sake, fella - stop torturing that cat!'
column2: 『唷咧－嘿－吼！』你朝遠方山坡大喊了一聲。過了一會兒，一個微弱的聲音傳回來：『拜託行行好，兄弟——別再折磨那隻貓了！』

column1: The tourist brochures you've seen assure you that the air in YoMammy Park is clear, clean and refreshing. Compared to the atmosphere down here a weak solution of sulphuric acid would be pretty refreshing.
column2: 你看過的觀光手冊上信誓旦旦說，呦馬麻公園的空氣清新乾淨、令人神清氣爽。可是跟這裡的空氣比起來，稀釋過的硫酸大概還比較讓人神清氣爽。

column1: I wouldn't advise walking around here with your tongue hanging out.
column2: 奉勸你別在這裡吐著舌頭到處走。

column1: It's true, what they say - the air here is thick enough to feel.
column2: 人家說的沒錯——這裡的空氣濃到你摸得到。

column1: You shout into the sky, dislodging a chunk of Keronian atmosphere that narrowly misses your helmet.
column2: 你朝天空大喊一聲，震下一大塊柯羅娜星的空氣，差一點點就砸中你的頭盔。

column1: Don't lick the air. You're libel to get more than you bargained for.
column2: 別去舔空氣，你可能會得到超乎預期的「驚喜」。

column1: The droid emits a cheerful chirp, but has nothing further to say right now. Fortunately, you bought it as a pilot, not a conversationalist.
column2: 機器人開心地「嗶」了一聲，但現在沒有其他話要說了。還好你買它是要當飛行員，不是要找它聊天的。

column1: Although small, the NAV-201 is surprisingly heavy. You don't think you'll be able to lift it.
column2: NAV-201 雖然小，卻重得出乎意料，你覺得自己應該是抬不動的。

column1: You wouldn't want to damage your droid. You wasted - I mean spent - much hardly-earned cash on it.
column2: 你不會想弄壞你的機器人的。你可是浪費——呃，我是說花——了好多辛苦賺來的錢在它身上。

column1: There's nothing like the smell of a new used droid.
column2: 沒有什麼比得上一台「二手全新」機器人的味道了。

column1: Like many things in your experience, it looks better than it tastes.
column2: 就像你經歷過的許多事情一樣，這東西中看不中吃。

column1: Yikes! It looks like you hit that force field one too many times. Not only did it burn every follicle of hair from your sleek frame, but your aorta, if you could see it, now resembles the end of a red celery stalk.
column2: 哎呀！看來你撞那個力場撞太多次了。它不但把你全身光滑皮膚上的每一根毛都燒光，你的主動脈——如果你看得到的話——現在看起來就像一截切開的紅色芹菜梗。

column1: Ouch! That hurt!
column2: 哎唷！好痛！

column1: You are standing next to the protective barrier encircling Ulence Flats. Due to the fact that you are land-based, you are not able to pass.
column2: 你站在環繞尤倫斯荒原的防護屏障旁邊。因為你是用走的，沒辦法通過這裡。

column1: You can't see that from down here.
column2: 你在下面看不到那個。

column1: You can't see that from up here.
column2: 你在上面看不到那個。

column1: You're darned if you can figure out what most of this stuff is for.
column2: 這堆東西大部分是幹嘛用的，你完全看不出個所以然。

column1: What a perfectly useless-looking piece of decoration!
column2: 這裝飾品看起來根本一點用都沒有！

column1: You are continually astonished by the Sarien decorative scheme.
column2: 沙利安人的裝潢品味，你每次看了都嘖嘖稱奇。

column1: Interesting.
column2: 有意思。

column1: Hmmm. Another one of those thingies.
column2: 嗯……又是那種怪東西。

column1: Just another one of those fascinating bits of alien hardware.
column2: 又是一件讓人嘖嘖稱奇的外星機械。

column1: Boy. These spaceship interior designers must be one strange lot.
column2: 唉唷，這艘船的室內設計師腦袋一定有洞。

column1: You can't talk to that from down here.
column2: 你在這下面，沒辦法跟那東西講話。

column1: You can't talk to that from up here.
column2: 你在這上面，沒辦法跟那東西講話。

column1: This kind of behavior is likely to get you noticed by the Sariens.
column2: 你這樣搞下去，遲早會被沙利安人盯上。

column1: It doesn't talk back.
column2: 它不會回話。

column1: If you keep talking to inanimate objects, you're bound to attract attention.
column2: 你一直跟沒生命的東西講話，遲早會引人注意。

column1: You begin to get the feeling that talking to things that don't talk back is a serious waste of time.
column2: 你開始覺得，跟不會回話的東西講話，根本是浪費時間。

column1: It looks at you in amazement. What kind animated object would talk to inanimates.
column2: 它一臉驚訝地看著你——哪有活人會跟死東西講話的。

column1: You can't do that from down here.
column2: 你在這下面，做不了那件事。

column1: Never mind that now - you're in a hurry.
column2: 先別管那個了，你正趕時間呢。

column1: You don't have time to stop and touch all this neat stuff - you've got a galaxy to save.
column2: 你沒空停下來把這些新奇玩意兒摸過一遍，你可是要去拯救整個銀河的。

column1: You find you must fight the urge to dust and polish everywhere you go.
column2: 你發現自己走到哪都要拚命忍住想撢灰塵、擦亮的衝動。

column1: You don't want to leave your fingerprints all over the ship, do you?
column2: 你該不會想把指紋印得整艘船都是吧？

column1: You can't imagine what you'd do with it.
column2: 你實在想不出拿它能幹嘛。

column1: Try as you might, you can affect no change.
column2: 任憑你怎麼試，都改變不了什麼。

column1: You can't smell that from down here.
column2: 你在這下面，聞不到那個味道。

column1: You can't smell that from up here.
column2: 你在這上面，聞不到那個味道。

column1: The whole ship smells like Sariens.
column2: 整艘船都是沙利安人的味道。

column1: You can't smell anything beyond the general smell of Sariens, which is unpleasant. These guys definitely need a change in diet.
column2: 你聞不到別的，只聞得到沙利安人那股難聞的體味。這些傢伙的飲食真的該改一改了。

column1: An offensive smell permeates the entire ship.
column2: 一股嗆鼻的臭味瀰漫了整艘船。

column1: The Sariens smell so horrible it's hard to smell anything else.
column2: 沙利安人臭到讓你聞不出其他味道。

column1: You get no clues from the smell.
column2: 這味道給不了你任何線索。

column1: You can't taste that from down here.
column2: 你在這下面，嚐不到那東西。

column1: You can't taste that from up here.
column2: 你在這上面，嚐不到那東西。

column1: Sarien cooties are everywhere.
column2: 沙利安人的髒東西到處都是。

column1: You really don't want to put your mouth on that.
column2: 你真的不會想拿嘴巴去碰那個。

column1: You can't imagine that's going to taste good.
column2: 你實在不覺得那東西會好吃。

column1: If it smells like Sariens, how good do you suppose it's going to taste?
column2: 既然聞起來像沙利安人，你覺得它吃起來會好到哪去？

column1: Don't put that in your mouth - you don't know where it's been!
column2: 別把那玩意兒放進嘴裡——你根本不知道它經歷過什麼！

column1: You can't use that here.
column2: 這裡用不了那個。

column1: You don't really want to show an Arcada data cartridge to the guys who blew the ship to smithereens.
column2: 你該不會想把阿寇達號的資料匣，拿給把那艘船炸成碎片的傢伙看吧。

column1: He seems satisfied that you're a Sarien, all right.
column2: 他看起來完全相信你就是沙利安人。

column1: Are you crazy! You haven't got time to talk to this guy. He's too busy doing his talking with his gun.
column2: 你瘋了嗎！你沒空跟這傢伙聊天啦，他現在只想用槍跟你「對話」。

column1: You're not close enough to talk to the guard.
column2: 你離守衛不夠近，沒辦法跟他說話。

column1: It's just another one of those ugly Sarien guards.
column2: 又是一個醜不啦嘰的沙利安守衛。

column1: You can't do that from here.
column2: 你在這裡做不了那件事。

column1: You'd better hurry up, Roger! You've got 20 seconds before you're turned into such tiny particles that they couldn't find you with an ion microscope.
column2: 羅傑，你最好快點！再過 20 秒，你就會被炸成連離子顯微鏡都找不到的碎粒。

column1: A nice slug of water would sure hit the spot right about now.
column2: 現在要是能灌一大口水，那真是太爽了。

column1: The heat of this place can sure dehydrate a person. You'd better get something to drink pretty darn soon.
column2: 這鬼地方的高溫真的會把人烤乾，你最好趕快找點東西喝。

column1: The bones, though utterly dehydrated, still bear too much mass for the puny likes of you to displace.
column2: 這堆骨頭雖然乾到不行，但份量還是太重，憑你這種小身板搬不動。

column1: While it might make one heck of a great soup bone, it bears no other appeal to your palate.
column2: 這骨頭拿去熬湯也許是一絕，但除此之外對你的味蕾沒有半點吸引力。

column1: Your words hitch a ride on the Keronian breeze never to be heard again.
column2: 你的話搭上柯羅娜的微風，就這麼一去不回，再也沒人聽見。

column1: These bones have had the smell baked right out of them by centuries of relentless, Keronian sun. Any soft tissue was long ago ingested by the local parasites.
column2: 這堆骨頭被柯羅娜毒辣的太陽曬了好幾世紀，早就被烤得一點味道都沒有。軟組織老早就被當地的寄生蟲啃光了。

column1: You already have your allocation of adhesive herbs.
column2: 你手上的黏性藥草份額已經拿夠了。

column1: You take a whiff of the plant and find it to be a regrettable experience. However, it does have an aroma reminiscent of a smell-a-vision movie production of 'Our Friend The Polymoss Shrub - Nature's Bondo'. You vaguely remember something about it having odd adhesive properties
column2: 你聞了聞這株植物，只能說是一次讓人後悔的經驗。不過它的氣味倒讓你想起一部嗅覺電影，片名是《我們的好朋友：多黏苔灌木——大自然的填縫膏》。你隱約記得這東西好像有種古怪的黏著特性

column1: Do that and you'll never utter another stupid syllable in your life. On second thought...
column2: 這麼做的話，你這輩子再也說不出一句蠢話了。仔細想想……

column1: You take a whiff of the plant and find it to be a regrettable experience. However, it does have an aroma reminiscent of a smell-a-vision movie production of 'Our Friend The Polymoss Shrub - Nature's Bondo'. You vaguely remember something about its having some incredible adhesive properties as well.
column2: 你聞了聞這株植物，只能說是一次讓人後悔的經驗。不過它的氣味倒讓你想起一部嗅覺電影，片名是《我們的好朋友：多黏苔灌木——大自然的填縫膏》。你隱約記得這東西似乎也有種驚人的黏著特性。

column1: You snag a small cluster of leaves from the gooey plant.
column2: 你從那株黏答答的植物上，摘下一小叢葉子。

column1: That stuff sticks worse than fortnight-old undergarments. It's a good thing your gloves are tefloid-coated.
column2: 這玩意兒黏起來，比穿了兩星期沒換的內衣還誇張。還好你的手套有特氟膠塗層。

column1: Holy antiperspirant, dehydroman! The searing heat and dryness of this environment sucks the vital fluids from your body. Your mind begins to drift uncontrollably.
column2: 我的老天，止汗劑啊，脫水人！這裡毒辣的高溫和乾燥，正把你體內的水分一滴滴榨乾，你的意識開始不受控制地渙散。

column1: Mommy! Is that you? Mommy, how come all the other guys in class get new mops and I don't?
column2: 「媽咪！是妳嗎？媽咪，為什麼班上其他人都有新拖把，只有我沒有？」

column1: Mercifully (for all of us), you die before the hallucinations get too hokey. It won't be long before you look like a scaled-down version of the skeletal structure occupying several hectares nearby.
column2: 算你走運（其實是我們走運），你在幻覺變得太瞎之前就死了。用不了多久，你就會變成附近那具佔地好幾公頃的骸骨的縮小版。

column1: Within a few hours, your gaunt corpse will have dried to a crisp, your powdered remains evenly distributed across the parched terrain by a searing gust.
column2: 幾個小時內，你乾瘦的屍體就會被曬得又乾又脆，一陣熱風會把你的粉末殘骸，均勻地灑滿這片焦乾的大地。

column1: Mmmmm...That dehydrated water really hit the spot! That should keep you going a bit longer.
column2: 嗯……那瓶濃縮水還真是解渴！這樣應該能讓你再撐一陣子。

column1: Out of the corner of your eye, you spot an object hurtling from the greenish atmosphere toward the parched surface you currently occupy.
column2: 你眼角餘光瞄到一個物體，從泛綠的大氣層直直朝你所在的焦乾地面墜落。

column1: Rats! If the eyes don't deceive, that's a Sarien Spider Droid. They must have detected the escape pod leaving the Arcada. The Spider Droid must have been sent along to settle any unfinished business.
column2: 糟了！如果眼睛沒騙你，那是一台沙利安蜘蛛機器人。他們肯定是偵測到逃生艙離開了阿寇達號，才派這台蜘蛛機器人來「善後」。

column1: After the jarring impact, small panels open through which legs sprout. You recall reading in an old issue of Space Piston magazine that this droid was designed to seek out organic life forms and self-destruct when close proximity to the target has been achieved.
column2: 落地的衝擊過後，幾片小艙蓋打開，伸出了好幾隻腳。你想起曾在舊一期的《太空活塞》雜誌上讀過，這種機器人是設計來搜索有機生命體，一旦接近目標就會自爆。

column1: How convenient! You've been blown into handy, bite-sized chunks. I guess that Space Piston article wasn't fiction. There's nothing quite like stretching out and enjoying the wide-open spaces.
column2: 真是太「方便」了！你被炸成了一口一口好入口的碎塊。看來《太空活塞》那篇報導不是唬爛的。沒有什麼比得上四肢伸展、盡情享受這片「開闊天地」了。

column1: You greet the droid with a pleasant "Hello."
column2: 你親切地跟機器人打了聲招呼：「哈囉。」

column1: Say, I've got this annoying itch on the back of my sphere. Do you think you could scratch it for me? I'd be forever grateful. it responds.
column2: 「說啊，我球體背面有個地方癢死了，你能幫我抓一下嗎？我會感激不盡的。」它這麼回答。

column1: If you've got a taste for chrome, step on up and give it a try.
