column2: 這是傑瑞僅存的遺骸，他是船上少數幾個還能忍受你陪伴的技術宅之一。你的權限太低，沒辦法去他執勤的地方找他——阿寇達號下層那間裝潢體面的氣密艙。

column1: alert sign
column2: 警報標示

column1: Gee! The sign seems to be flashing. Could it be a warning of some kind? Who knows? You're always slower than normal after a nap.
column2: 喔！這個標示好像在閃。該不會是什麼警告吧？誰知道呢？你睡完午覺後腦筋總是比平常更遲鈍。

column1: These appear to be doors to an elevator.
column2: 這看起來是電梯的門。

column1: More hallway extends through the Arcada. There is an elevator door nearby.
column2: 阿寇達號的走廊還在往前延伸，附近有一道電梯門。

column1: David
column2: 大衛

column1: A cursory glance indicates that Dave, a lab technician, is dead. Normally you wouldn't be able to tell, except that his intestines are hanging out of the scorched opening where his abdominal wall used to be. You remember that he was forced to serve in the Xenon National Guard (but he wasn't bitter).
column2: 隨便看一眼就知道，實驗室技師戴夫死了。照理說你根本看不出來，只不過他的腹壁已經燒穿一個大洞，腸子整條垂在外面。你記得他當年被強徵去服氙星國民兵役（不過他倒沒半點怨言）。

column1: Blanche
column2: 布蘭琪

column1: This is one of the head research scientists, Blanche. You wanted to get to know her a little better. However, seeing her ruptured chest wall reveals more about her than you were hoping to learn.
column2: 這是首席研究科學家之一，布蘭琪。你本來想多認識她一點，不過看到她那被扯裂的胸腔，知道的可比你原先想了解的還多。

column1: An arrow in the elevator light assembly points up.
column2: 電梯燈號組裡的箭頭指向上方。

column1: alert light
column2: 警示燈

column1: In case you're trying to play this as a text adventure, the sign says 'RED ALERT' and it's flashing.
column2: 以防你想把這當文字冒險遊戲玩：告訴你，這個標示寫著「紅色警報」，而且正在閃爍。

column1: This is an elevator to one of the other levels of the Arcada.
column2: 這是通往阿寇達號其他樓層的電梯。

column1: A fairly spazzed-out droid is on the loose in your immediate proprioceptic area.
column2: 有一台抓狂到不行的機器人，正在你附近這片「本體感覺範圍」內橫衝直撞。

column1: This is the door to the top secret Star Generator Lab. It's been forcibly ventilated!
column2: 這是最高機密星辰產生器實驗室的門——已經被硬生生鑿出幾個「通風孔」了！

column1: This is the Star Generator Development Laboratory. Due to your incredibly low security clearance, you have never had access to this room. What a mess! Wreckage clutters the middle of the floor. A pair of lab workers have been blasted from the roster of the living. You're glad somebody else has to clean this up!
column2: 這裡是星辰產生器研發實驗室。就憑你低到不行的權限，照理說根本進不了這房間。這裡亂七八糟！殘骸堆滿了地板中央，兩名實驗室人員已經從「活人名冊」上除名了。還好善後不用你來收拾，真是謝天謝地！

column1: Randy
column2: 藍迪

column1: The lifeless body of Randy, one of the lab technicians, lies sprawled at your feet. Those laser blasts are nasty. Why, you can't distinguish one exposed organ from another.
column2: 實驗室技師藍迪的屍體攤在你腳邊，早沒了氣息。雷射轟出來的傷口真的很噁心，那些外露的器官你根本分不出哪個是哪個。

column1: Yet another crewman's motionless body reduces the shine of the floor wax. Hugh doesn't look too neat and clean with his lungs hanging out like that.
column2: 又一具船員的屍體躺在地上，把打過蠟的地板弄得不再光亮。休的肺整個掛在外面，看起來一點都不乾淨俐落。

column1: You find a small but heavy device affixed to the base of the Star Generator platform. It appears to be magnetic. That must be how the aliens upset the force field protecting the unit!
column2: 你在星辰產生器平台底座上發現一個小巧卻很沉的裝置，看起來帶磁性。外星人一定就是靠這玩意兒搞亂了保護裝置的力場！

column1: upper support
column2: 上方支架

column1: This is the upper support for the Star Generator when it is affixed to the pedestal.
column2: 這是星辰產生器固定在底座上時用的上方支架。

column1: The base of the Star Generator research pedestal has apparently been trashed by the vandals who stole the Generator.
column2: 星辰產生器研究底座顯然被偷走裝置的那群傢伙砸得亂七八糟。

column1: Now you know why you didn't have clearance for this place. You don't understand what most of this crap does. This thing looks like a giant speaker for the cosmos.
column2: 現在你終於知道自己當初為什麼進不了這地方——這堆東西大部分你根本看不懂在幹嘛。這玩意兒看起來像一個對著宇宙放送的巨型喇叭。

column1: This thing looks like it came off the front end of an old Studebaker (or maybe the Batmobile). Anyway, it appears non-functional at this time. It was probably damaged in the heist.
column2: 這東西看起來像是從老式Studebaker汽車前端拆下來的（或者說像蝙蝠車）。反正它現在看起來是壞的，大概是那次搶劫時弄壞的。

column1: The glass globe atop the console is inactive at this time. The mess of wiring inside reminds you of how your hair looks after a nap.
column2: 控制台上方那顆玻璃球目前沒有作用。裡頭亂糟糟的電線，讓你想起自己睡醒後的頭髮。

column1: You are standing on the research platform where the Star Generator is... was mounted for testing.
column2: 你正站在測試用的研究平台上，星辰產生器本來是……應該說曾經是安裝在這裡做測試的。

column1: This is a star chart. It was used for locating candidates to test the Star Generator on once the bulk of the development process was completed.
column2: 這是一張星圖，用來在研發大致完成後，找出可以拿星辰產生器來測試的候選星球。

column1: This is a section of one of the lower levels of Arcada.
column2: 這裡是阿寇達號下層的一部分。

column1: This elevator must go up.
column2: 這台電梯只能往上。

column1: This is one way to change your altitude.
column2: 這是換樓層高度的一種方法。

column1: This monitor gives a readout about the ship's status. Only the lab scientist really knows... er... knew exactly what it monitored.
column2: 這台螢幕會顯示船艦狀態的讀數。只有那位實驗室科學家真的知道……呃，曾經知道……它到底在監測什麼。

column1: A pair of viewing ports protrude from the materials testing device.
column2: 材料測試裝置上突出兩個觀察窗。

column1: Pipes whose purpose is known only to the architect wrap around the upper back of the room.
column2: 房間後方上緣繞著幾根管線，用途大概只有設計師自己知道。

column1: A designer conduit system runs through here. It carries the ventilation ducting as well as different type of wiring.
column2: 這裡有一套講究設計感的管線系統，裡面裝著通風管道和好幾種不同的電線。

column1: thing in foreground
column2: 前方的東西

column1: It appears to be some sort of wiring harness. You never cared much for electrical hardware.
column2: 這看起來是某種線束。你向來對電器零件沒什麼興趣。

column1: round thing
column2: 圓形的東西

column1: Who knows what this is.
column2: 天曉得這是什麼東西。

column1: mouse thing
column2: 滑鼠裝置

column1: This interesting device was used to test materials early in the project.
column2: 這個有趣的裝置在專案早期是用來測試材料的。

column1: This place looks like a monument to Soviet computer hardware miniaturization. At one time, it served as a development facility for the Star Generator. But that was in the early phase of the project.
column2: 這地方看起來像蘇聯電腦硬體微縮技術的紀念碑。這裡曾是星辰產生器的研發設施，不過那是計畫早期的事了。

column1: A relatively nearby star blazes.
column2: 附近有顆恆星正閃耀著光芒。

column1: On the screen is some green dude you've never seen the likes of. He seems to be talking, but the audio is out in this area of the ship.
column2: 螢幕上有個從沒見過的綠色傢伙。他看起來在講話，但船艦這一區的音效系統壞了，聽不到聲音。

column1: These guys look scary. But then, don't most other beings packing weapons?
column2: 這些傢伙看起來挺嚇人的。不過話說回來，扛著武器的傢伙誰不嚇人？

column1: The architects must have been low on oxygen when they came up with the design scheme for this compartment. It's a giant tribute to an ancient, but still functional, control device.
column2: 設計這個艙室的建築師，想出這套配置圖時腦袋裡的氧氣一定不太夠。整個空間根本是在向一款古老、卻仍然堪用的控制裝置致敬。

column1: Here, we have a nice chunk of floor space dedicated to a cursor control device named after an annoying rodent. What were they thinking?
column2: 這裡挪出好大一塊地板空間，就為了擺一個以討厭的囓齒動物命名的游標控制裝置——他們到底在想什麼？

column1: The view screens offer a glimpse of the surroundings from outboard cameras. They came in handy during the testing phase of the Star Generator.
column2: 這幾面顯示螢幕能透過船外攝影機看到周遭環境，在星辰產生器的測試階段派上不少用場。

column1: Big, phony wiring from the giant control devices attempts to complete the decorative effect.
column2: 從那些巨大控制裝置延伸出來的粗大假電線，想把整個裝飾效果湊齊。

column1: This keyboard was used in the development of the Star Generator. It has since been placed here to be out of the way. It has no function.
column2: 這個鍵盤當初是用來研發星辰產生器的，後來就被丟在這裡眼不見為淨，現在完全沒有作用。

column1: You're at the east end of one of the development labs. Another elevator is available here.
column2: 你在其中一間研發實驗室的東側，這裡也有一座電梯。

column1: This is yet another in a long line of elevators in this game.. er.. ship.
column2: 這又是這款遊戲……呃，是這艘船上，一長串電梯裡的其中一台。

column1: This light indicates that the elevator goes down and, when lit, its presence at this floor.
column2: 這盞燈表示電梯往下走；燈亮的時候，代表電梯目前就停在這一層。

column1: bay door
column2: 艙門

column1: open exposing the vast reaches of space
column2: 開啟後露出浩瀚無垠的太空

column1: button pad
column2: 按鈕面板

column1: This is the button pad for the bay doors below. The controls are located up here to minimize the chance of someone doing something stupid, such as pressing 'OPEN' while in the pod bay when wearing no pressure suit. YOU should be glad.
column2: 這是控制樓下艙門的按鈕面板。控制鈕特地裝在這裡，就是為了降低有人幹出蠢事的機率——比方說沒穿加壓服卻站在小艇艙裡按下「開啟」。你該慶幸這個設計。

column1: The button is depressed. Aren't we all?
column2: 這顆按鈕已經按下去了——看起來挺消沉的。話說回來，誰不是呢？

column1: You always meant to ask one of the technicians what this thing is. However, you procrastinated a bit too long in this case. It's either an ocean-in-a-bottle or a model of your stomach as the deadline draws near.
column2: 你一直想找個技師問問這到底是什麼東西，可惜這次拖得太久了。看起來不是裝在瓶子裡的一片海洋，就是死線逼近時你胃裡翻攪的模樣。

column1: This is a keycard slot. Your bottom-of-the-foodchain-type clearance has always prevented you from attaining a keycard for this area, thus precluding your access to it without an escort. Good luck finding one now!
column2: 這是磁卡插槽。你那種食物鏈最底層的權限，一直讓你拿不到這一區的磁卡，所以沒人陪同就進不去。現在祝你好運，自己去找一張吧！

column1: This button opens the bay doors below.
column2: 這顆按鈕可以打開樓下的艙門。

column1: This button closes the bay doors below.
column2: 這顆按鈕可以關閉樓下的艙門。

column1: This is a remote monitoring panel for some of the ship's systems. Attempts to understand their purpose always made your brain hurt, but you do know that glowing red isn't good. Especially since some of the stuff is connected to the reactor cooling system.
column2: 這是船上部分系統的遠端監控面板。你每次想搞懂這些東西的用途，腦袋就會痛，不過你知道亮紅燈絕對不是好事，尤其這些東西有些還接著反應爐冷卻系統。

column1: These buttons are locked in position. It's probably just as well. You might live longer due to having no clue as to their purpose.
column2: 這些按鈕都被鎖死了，這樣或許也好——你搞不清楚它們的用途，說不定還能因此多活幾年。

column1: This looks like something out of a Boris Karloid movie.
column2: 這東西的模樣，活像是從某部鮑里斯·卡洛夫演的老恐怖片裡搬出來的道具。

column1: This is the steel stand for the odd globe.
column2: 這是那顆怪玻璃球的鋼製底座。

column1: More pipes run around the upper perimeter of this area.
column2: 這一區的上緣還繞著更多管線。

column1: This is the airlock of the Arcada.
column2: 這裡是阿寇達號的氣密艙。

column1: space suit
column2: 太空裝

column1: A space suit hangs in the closet. It won't be used by anyone else on the ship anymore.
column2: 衣櫃裡掛著一套太空裝，船上再也不會有別人穿它了。

column1: It's a fish bowl - no, it's a space suit helmet!.
column2: 這是個魚缸——不對，是太空裝的頭盔！

column1: elevator light.
column2: 電梯燈號。

column1: This elevator indicator points up.
column2: 這個電梯指示燈指向上方。

column1: big door.
column2: 大門。

column1: These large red doors serve as the airlock entrance which empties out to the pod bay.
column2: 這幾扇紅色大門是氣密艙的入口，通往逃生艇艙房。

column1: A small drawer is located just beneath a button.
column2: 按鈕下方就是一個小抽屜。

column1: closet door
column2: 衣櫃門

column1: The image on the closet door looks familiar, but you can't quite place it.
column2: 衣櫃門上的圖案看起來眼熟，但你一時想不起來是什麼。

column1: Flashing lights adorn this strange yet familiar-looking console.
column2: 這個既陌生又眼熟的控制台上，點綴著閃爍的燈光。

column1: It doesn't do anything but it sure looks cool.
column2: 它沒什麼實際功能，不過看起來真的很酷。

column1: This is another elevator door. This one goes up.
column2: 這是另一扇電梯門，這台是往上的。

column1: The control panel has many confusing gauges on it. The only one you can read says "CAUTION: LAUNCH BAY DECOMPRESSED!"
column2: 控制面板上有一堆看不懂的儀表，你唯一看得懂的一個寫著：「警告：發射艙已洩壓！」

column1: There is a button above the rectangular object below.
column2: 下方那個長方形物體上面有一顆按鈕。

column1: This button might have some function involving the adjacent doors.
column2: 這顆按鈕大概跟旁邊的門有點關係。

column1: You notice a drawer and a button.
column2: 你注意到一個抽屜和一顆按鈕。

column1: This is the cavernous Vehicle Bay. An escape pod rests on launch rails at the end of the platform. Bay doors at the end of the rails allow access to the emptiness beyond.
column2: 這裡是空盪盪的載具艙。一具逃生艙停在平台盡頭的發射軌道上，軌道另一端的艙門通往外面的虛空。

column1: bay doors
column2: 艙門

column1: The massive bay doors are tightly sealed.
column2: 這幾扇巨大的艙門封得死死的。

column1: open wide leaving nothing but millions of kilometers of empty space between you and the very stars themselves
column2: 大大敞開，你和滿天星斗之間只剩下數百萬公里的太空

column1: tightly sealed
column2: 封得死死的

column1: pod door
column2: 逃生艇艙門

column1: This is one of the Arcada's escape pods. You vaguely remember receiving some orientation on these when you joined the crew. Unfortunately, you were deep into research on sleeping with your eyes open and, hence, don't remember much.
column2: 這是阿寇達號的逃生艇之一。你隱約記得剛上船時有人跟你講解過怎麼用，不過那時你正忙著鑽研「張著眼睛睡覺」這門學問，所以沒記住多少。

column1: These powerful Pyron Weezpump drives propel the pod.
column2: 這艘逃生艇靠的是強大的「派龍氣喘幫浦」推進系統。

column1: Even though we all know that the empty atmosphere of space would not permit this twinkling effect, you have to admit it looks nice.
column2: 雖然大家都知道太空的真空環境不可能出現星星閃爍這種效果，但你也不得不承認，看起來還挺美的。

column1: Through the cabin window you can see an array of displays and controls inside the pod.
column2: 透過艙門的窗子，你可以看到逃生艇裡一整排顯示器和控制裝置。

column1: Beyond the yawning doors lies the serenity of deep space.
column2: 敞開的艙門外，是一片深邃太空的寧靜。

column1: There's that butt-ugly green guy again. Of all the systems destroyed thus far, you wish the teleview would have been one of them.
column2: 又是那個醜到爆的綠色傢伙。到目前為止被摧毀的系統裡，你真希望這台通訊螢幕也在其中。

column1: A giant, silver, pill-shaped pod sits poised to fire, much like a bullet in the chamber of an ancient pistol.
column2: 一艘巨大的銀色膠囊狀逃生艇整裝待發，就像一顆填進老式手槍彈膛裡的子彈。

column1: The inside of the Arcada's escape pod is not exactly packed with luxurious appointments. However, when it comes to saving one's posterior, the pod's as good as a Rolls.
column2: 阿寇達號逃生艙的內裝說不上豪華，不過講到保住小命這件事，這艙可一點都不輸勞斯萊斯。

column1: This lever causes forward propulsion of the pod when powered-up.
column2: 這根操縱桿在啟動電源後，可以讓逃生艇向前推進。

column1: Roger
column2: 羅傑

column1: There doesn't seem to be enough room.
column2: 空間看起來不太夠。

column1: seat belt
column2: 安全帶

column1: The seatbelt is dummy-tested, which ought to suit you just fine.
column2: 這條安全帶是用假人測試過的，這對你來說應該剛好合適。

column1: Dials
column2: 儀表

column1: Dials galore populate the instrument console of the pod cabin.
column2: 逃生艇艙裡的儀表板上，滿滿都是各式各樣的儀表。

column1: This is the pod's instrument console. Dials, gauges, and a couple of controls fill out the board.
column2: 這是逃生艇的儀表板，上面擺滿了儀表、量表，還有幾個控制鈕。

column1: Chair
column2: 椅子

column1: This is the lucky escapee's seat.
column2: 這是幸運逃脫者的座位。

column1: Window
column2: 窗戶

column1: This is a button pad.
column2: 這是一塊按鈕面板。

column1: deltaur arms
column2: 代爾它的機械臂

column1: don't need this
column2: 用不到這個。

column1: survival kit
column2: 求生包

column1: The survival kit contains the basics for deep space survival.
column2: 這個求生包裡，裝著深空求生的基本配備。

column1: don't need one.
column2: 不需要。

column1: This is radar for the Autonav system.
column2: 這是自動導航系統的雷達。

column1: This is your arm.
column2: 這是你的手臂。

column1: This is your head. This is your head in a fishbowl.
column2: 這是你的頭。這顆頭正泡在魚缸裡呢。

column1: Stars glow from afar.
column2: 遠方的星星閃著微光。

column1: Arcada
column2: 阿寇達號

column1: It's your former ship, the Arcada.
column2: 那是你以前待的船——阿寇達號。

column1: Deltaur
column2: 代爾它號

column1: escape pod
column2: 逃生艙

column2: 這根拉桿在逃生艙通電且身處太空時，會讓艙體向前推進。

column1: Dials galore populate the instrument console of the pod cabin. Too bad none of them work anymore.
column2: 艙內的儀表板上擺滿了各種儀錶，可惜一個能用的都沒有。

column1: Too bad none of them work anymore.
column2: 可惜一個能用的都沒有。

column1: It might have been dampened slightly by that landing.
column2: 經過那次硬著陸，它似乎稍微受到了點影響。

column1: On this button pad are the AUTONAV, POWER, and DON'T TOUCH buttons.
column2: 這片按鈕面板上有「自動導航」、「電源」，還有一個「別碰」鈕。

column2: 柯羅娜星

column1: should be hands-off
column2: 看來最好別去碰。

column1: Mountains generously dappled with spires of unknown formational origin loom at your visual terminus.
column2: 極目所及的地平線上，矗立著一片山脈，上頭布滿了來歷不明的尖塔狀岩層。

column2: 簡易雷達。

column2: 星星1

column2: 星星2

column2: 不需要

column1: The spent drives of the pod vent fumes after the long escape from the Arcada.
column2: 逃生艙的引擎已經耗盡，脫離阿寇達號的長途飛行後，還冒著陣陣廢氣。

column1: This is the escape pod's hatch.
column2: 這是逃生艙的艙門。

column1: Its service life has expired as a result of the rugged touch-down.
column2: 因為那次粗暴的著陸，它的使用壽命已經到頭了。

column1: In the distance stand the skeletal remains of of a massive beast of some type, the likes of which you never saw on Xenon. You hope it's a one of a kind relic.
column2: 遠方矗立著某種巨獸的骸骨，種類詭異到你在氙星上從沒見過。你但願這只是絕無僅有的孤例。

column1: You are at the northwest boundary of a massive skeletal structure. Sand stretches out in all other directions.
column2: 你正站在一具巨大骸骨結構的西北端。除此之外，四面八方都是黃沙。

column1: This is the north-central boundary of a massive skeletal structure surrounded by arid terra not-so-firma.
column2: 這裡是那具巨大骸骨結構的正北端，四周是一片乾燥、卻稱不上「腳踏實地」的荒土。

column1: This is the northeast corner of the boneyard. Bones and sand dominate the scenery. At the east end of the vertebral path are two extremely pointed spurs of broken rib.
column2: 這裡是骨場的東北角，滿地都是骨頭與沙子。脊椎步道的東端有兩根斷裂的肋骨，尖得嚇人。

column1: shiny thingy
column2: 亮晶晶的小東西

column1: It looks interesting. Although hard to tell from where you are standing, it may be a sign. If you got closer, maybe you could read it.
column2: 看起來挺有意思的。雖然你現在站的位置看不清楚，但那可能是塊告示牌。走近一點，說不定就能看懂上面寫什麼了。

column1: Were you a proctologist, you might know what these oddly shaped bones are called. To you, though, they're just bones.
column2: 如果你是肛腸科醫生，或許還認得出這堆造型奇怪的骨頭叫什麼名字。可惜對你來說，那就只是一堆骨頭。

column1: exit hole
column2: 出口洞

column1: This appears to be the thoracic area of the spinal column of this meatless beast. Other than an obviously defective vertebra, you've got more sand and crud.
column2: 這裡似乎是這具沒了肉的野獸脊椎的胸椎部位。除了一節明顯有問題的脊椎骨，就只剩沙子跟髒東西。

column1: bone bridge
column2: 骨橋

column1: This genetically defective vertebra looks like it would be intolerant to much load bearing.
column2: 這節先天發育不良的脊椎骨，看起來承受不了多少重量。

column1: What started out at one time as mere hairline fractures are now clearly cracks in the imperfect vertebral module.
column2: 原本只是幾道細微裂痕，如今在這節有缺陷的脊椎骨上，已經清清楚楚裂開了。

column1: strange plant pod
column2: 詭異的植物莢果

column1: A section of vertebra, near where the head used to be attached, extends north and south. To the east is the ominous-looking skull.
column2: 一段脊椎骨從原本接著頭部的地方往南北延伸，東邊是那顆看起來很不祥的頭骨。

column1: No doubt about it. Those are some serious teeth. It could've used a little dental work - maybe some braces even. It's just a good thing you never had the opportunity to be on the business end of these things when it was still a living being.
column2: 這絕對是貨真價實的利牙。當初真該去洗個牙、矯正一下──說不定還得戴牙套。還好在牠還活著的時候，你從沒機會親身見識這幾顆牙的厲害。

column1: This must be the skull previously attached to the rest of the mammoth bones partially assembled here.
column2: 這顆頭骨想必原本就接在這堆巨大骸骨上頭。

column1: This looks like it might have been a minimally developed, manipulative appendage for the fallen and fossilized beast.
column2: 看起來，這可能是這頭化石巨獸身上一支發育不良、用來抓取東西的附肢。

column1: This is just south of the gigundasaurus remains. Ligament jerky-deep in the joints is all that holds some of these incredibly huge skeletal components together.
column2: 這裡就在超巨龍遺骸的南邊。關節裡那些乾得跟肉乾一樣的韌帶，是撐住這些超巨大骨骼零件的唯一東西。

column1: The sand of Kerona has a reddish-orange color to it. Were you a geologist instead of a janitor, you might find this fact interesting.
column2: 柯羅娜星的沙子帶著一股橙紅色。如果你是地質學家而不是清潔工，或許會覺得這挺有意思的。

column1: The cervical portion of the spinal column takes a dive into the sand right about here.
column2: 脊椎的頸椎部位，就在這附近一頭栽進沙子裡。

column1: neck bone
column2: 頸骨

column1: Cervical vertebrae taper off and appear to vanish gradually into the sand.
column2: 頸椎逐漸變細，彷彿慢慢沒入沙中。

column1: These foreclaws were once razor-sharp, but the forces of the elements have reduced them to over-sized blunt toe nails. It's a good thing you didn't come here in an earlier time. These things would have torn you a new one.
column2: 這些前爪曾經鋒利如刀，如今被風吹日曬磨成了一副過大又鈍的腳趾甲。還好你沒有早點跑來這裡，不然這幾隻爪子早把你撕成碎片了。

column1: Orat is huge and ugly. Of course, your opinion may differ depending on what part of the universe you come from. You also get the impression that he might be quite mean.
column2: 歐拉特體型巨大又醜陋。當然啦，這也要看你是宇宙哪個角落來的，看法可能不一樣。而且你隱約覺得，這傢伙脾氣應該也不怎麼好。

column1: part of the orat
column2: 歐拉特的碎塊

column1: This gleaming chunk of Orat's anatomy is the only visible proof that Orat ever existed. After that explosion, it's amazing there's that much left.
column2: 這塊閃閃發亮的歐拉特殘骸，是牠曾經存在過的唯一證據。經過那場爆炸，還能留下這麼多，已經算奇蹟了。

column1: The orbs in this gigantic skull offer the only passageways for light into this gloomy place.
column2: 這顆巨大頭骨上的眼窩，是光線唯一能照進這片陰暗處的通道。

column1: far wall
column2: 遠端牆壁

column1: near wall
column2: 近側牆壁

column1: pile of skulls
column2: 一堆頭骨

column1: A pile of skulls lie here sucked clean by Orat, or was a result of them writing too many adventure games.
column2: 這裡堆著一堆頭骨，被歐拉特啃得乾乾淨淨；也可能只是因為他們寫的冒險遊戲寫太多了。

column1: big rock
column2: 大石頭

column1: That rock is almost as big as you.
column2: 那顆石頭幾乎跟你一樣大。

column1: small rock
column2: 小石頭

column1: That rock is too small to hide behind but too large to lift.
column2: 這顆石頭太小了，躲不了；但又太大了，搬不動。

column1: cave floor
column2: 洞穴地面

column1: The cave floor is littered with the usual stuff a cave would be littered with. Some sand, some rock, %s
column2: 這座洞穴的地面上，散落著洞穴裡常見的那些東西——一些沙子、一些石頭，%s

column1: and that's about it. Oh, Yeah. There's also an Orat part.
column2: 大概就這樣了。喔對了，還有一塊歐拉特的殘塊。

column1: none of it useful, though.
column2: 不過這些都沒什麼用。

column1: This is one end of what appears to be a large cavern. The only way to go is to the left.
column2: 這裡是一個大洞穴的一端，唯一能走的路是往左。

column1: chunk of sticky stuff
column2: 一團黏稠物

column1: stalagmite chunk
column2: 石筍碎塊

column1: The stalagmite itself has no smell. However, something adhering to the stalagmite does seem to generate a maggot-gagging aroma.
column2: 石筍本身沒什麼味道。不過黏在上頭的東西，倒是散發出一股能把蛆薰吐的臭味。

column1: Hhhaaaachhhh!!! Now why did you have to go and lick the end of that thing! That was terrible! Didn't you get a clue from the nose message?
column2: 哈啾啊啊啊！！！你幹嘛非要去舔那東西的尖端啊！超噁的！剛剛聞味道的提示還不夠明顯嗎？

column1: Skillfully maneuvering your tongue along the stalagmite removes the surface-coating of grit and, in turn, transforms your tastebuds into the organic equivalent of double-aught sandpaper.
column2: 你的舌頭靈巧地舔過石筍表面，颳掉了一層砂礫，順便把你的味蕾直接磨成了活生生的粗砂紙。

column1: shattered rock formation
column2: 碎裂的岩層

column1: It looks like your standard, run-of-the-mill pneumatic transport. This particular model only goes down, however. And it's not a pleasant ride.
column2: 看起來就是一般常見的氣動輸送艙。不過這一款只能往下，而且坐起來一點都不舒服。

column1: pneumatic transport
column2: 氣動輸送艙

column1: It looks like your standard run-of-the-mill pneumatic transport. This particular model only descends, however. And it's not a pleasant ride.
column2: 看起來就是一般常見的氣動輸送艙。不過這一款只會往下降，而且坐起來很不舒服。

column1: some stalagmites
column2: 幾根石筍

column1: Stalactites
column2: 鐘乳石

column1: loose gravel
column2: 鬆動的碎石

column1: This is another large chamber in the underground complex. Paths run along the top and bottom ledges.
column2: 這裡是地底建築群裡的另一個大廳，上下兩層岩架都有路可以走。

column1: sticky plant thing
column2: 黏黏的植物

column1: A piece of sticky plant is stuck to the floor.
column2: 一塊黏糊糊的植物碎片黏在地上。

column1: grate monster 1
column2: 章魚怪1

column1: grate monster 2
column2: 章魚怪2

column1: tentacle 1
column2: 觸鬚1

column1: Hey, this puppy has some keen-looking tentacles.
column2: 嘿，這傢伙的觸鬚看起來還真不是蓋的。

column1: tentacle 2
column2: 觸鬚2

column1: creature eyestalk
column2: 怪物的眼柄

column1: It's got the cutest little grey eye you've ever seen.
column2: 牠長著一顆你這輩子見過最可愛的灰色小眼睛。

column1: upper ledge
column2: 上方岩架

column1: front of grate area
column2: 柵欄區前方

column1: grate on floor
column2: 地上的柵欄

column1: a spacesuit helmet
column2: 一頂太空裝頭盔

column1: acid pool
column2: 酸液池

column2: 酸液池

column1: a small drop of green liquid
column2: 一小滴綠色液體

column1: You are in left-most room of this cavern. Standing sentinel at the juncture of the lower and upper pathways are two odd-looking units obviously placed there on purpose. %s.
column2: 你在這個洞穴最左邊的房間裡。在上下通道交會處，站著兩具造型古怪的裝置，看起來就是刻意擺在那裡站哨的。%s。

column1: They are no longer in operation thanks to you.
column2: 多虧你，這些裝置已經不再運作了。

column1: Something is being emitted by the devices.
column2: 這些裝置正在發出某種東西。

column1: laser thing1
column2: 雷射裝置1

column1: There are two metal units here which %s emitting beams of energy.
column2: 這裡有兩個金屬裝置，%s在發射能量光束。

column1: are no longer
column2: 已經不再

column1: appear to be
column2: 似乎正在

column2: 雷射裝置2

column1: This place is most interesting, indeed. A mixture of both old and new technologies makes you wonder about its origin. Or at least about its tech support. On one side of the chamber is a primitive steam generator. Its pistons, pounding rhythmically, turn steam into useful energy. On the other side is what appears to be a computer console.
column2: 這地方還真有意思。新舊科技混雜在一起，讓你不禁懷疑起它的來歷——或者至少懷疑它的技術支援是誰在做。房間一側是一台原始的蒸汽發電機，活塞規律地敲打，把蒸汽轉換成能用的能源；另一側則是一台看起來像電腦主機的東西。

column1: There's an upper level, with a balcony and a dark doorway. You can't see much beyond that.
column2: 上頭還有一層樓，設有陽台和一道暗門，再往裡面就看不清楚了。

column1: computer console
column2: 電腦控制台

column1: A computer console, a bit archaic by the standards of the Arcada, occupies the upper right corner of the room. You notice that it has a cartridge reader, much like the one you remember seeing on the Arcada's computer (except that this one hasn't been blown to smithereens).
column2: 房間右上角擺著一台電腦控制台，以阿寇達號的標準來看略顯老舊。你注意到它裝了一個資料匣讀取器，跟你記憶中阿寇達號電腦上那個很像——只不過這一台沒有被炸得粉碎。

column1: This must be the chair you sit in to operate the computer.
column2: 這應該是操作電腦時坐的椅子。

column1: There seems to be a portal through which the skimmer may exit and enter. It must lead to the surface.
column2: 這裡似乎有個沙漠飛車進出用的通道，應該是通往地面的。

column1: computer pipes
column2: 電腦管線

column1: From the looks of these pipes, even the computer is powered by steam!
column2: 看這些管線的樣子，就連電腦都是靠蒸汽發動的！

column1: What appear to be skylights made from gigantic oysters filter the intense Keronian sunlight down to these lower levels.
column2: 看起來像是用巨大牡蠣殼做成的天窗，把柯羅娜星刺眼的陽光濾下來，照進這下層空間。

column1: skimmer platform
column2: 沙漠飛車平台

column1: The platform under the skimmer looks like it was put together from old steam generator parts.
column2: 沙漠飛車底下的平台，看起來是用舊蒸汽發電機的零件拼湊出來的。

column1: The steam generator is a fascinating device in constant motion. It looks like it was assembled following a field trip to the junkyard, but everything appears to be in working order.
column2: 這台蒸汽發電機挺有意思，一直在運轉。看起來像是逛完垃圾場之後隨手組出來的，不過一切似乎都還能正常運作。

column1: steam vents
column2: 蒸汽排放口

column1: Every few seconds, steam escapes from the vents to let off excess pressure.
column2: 每隔幾秒，蒸汽就會從排放口噴出，把多餘的壓力洩掉。

column1: big pipes
column2: 大管線

column1: Large metal cylinders form supports for the upper level.
column2: 幾根巨大的金屬圓柱撐著上層樓板。

column1: small pipes
column2: 小管線

column1: These pipes are probably part of a larger network that carries steam to power various Keronian devices.
column2: 這些管線大概是整個管路網的一部分，負責把蒸汽輸送到柯羅娜星各種裝置去。

column1: small pipes with dials
column2: 帶儀表的小管線

column1: These gauges appear to monitor the pressure in the pipes. You think about the thousands of pounds of boiling hot steam in the system, and hope the gauges work.
column2: 這些儀表看起來是在監控管線裡的壓力。想到整套系統裡跑著幾千磅的滾燙蒸汽，你只能祈禱這些儀表沒故障。

column1: The floor in this place is made of polished slate. It is impeccably clean. With all this steam, the Keronians undoubtedly use it to steam clean just about everything.
column2: 這裡的地板是拋光石板鋪的，乾淨得無可挑剔。有這麼多蒸汽，柯羅娜人肯定什麼東西都拿蒸汽清潔一遍。

column1: data cartridge
column2: 資料匣

column1: blue skimmer
column2: 藍色沙漠飛車

column1: As described, it is a sand skimmer and it looks like it has skimmed quite a bit of sand in its time. On it is a panel which has a small readout, currently dark, and a keyhole with a key in it.
column2: 正如其名，這是一台沙漠飛車，看起來已經在沙地上飛馳過不少歲月了。上面有個面板，裝了一個小螢幕（目前是暗的），還有一個插著鑰匙的鑰匙孔。

column1: The ladder appears to have been put here to make it easier to board the skimmer.
column2: 這架梯子看起來是特地放在這裡，方便你爬上沙漠飛車的。

column1: flickering lightbulb
column2: 閃爍的燈泡

column1: These glass tubes are really quite intriguing - you've never seen anything remotely like them. Must be some radical new technology.
column2: 這些玻璃管還真是有意思——你從沒見過類似的東西。一定是什麼很前衛的新技術。

column1: Keronian worker
column2: 柯羅娜工人

column1: These people of Kerona sure are an odd-looking lot. You can't pin it down, but you are sure something is different about them.
column2: 柯羅娜星上的這些人長得還真奇怪。你也說不上哪裡怪，但就是覺得他們哪裡不太一樣。

column1: hover platform.
column2: 懸浮平台。

column1: The Keronian is hovering a meter or so off the floor on what appears to be a Kamen Kruiser, something like the one you used to buzz the family dog with as a young child.
column2: 這個柯羅娜人懸浮在離地約一公尺高的地方，騎的似乎是一台「假面巡航機」，跟你小時候用來嚇自家狗的那種東西有點像。

column1: The shaft must be part of the steam generator.
column2: 這根軸心應該是蒸汽發電機的一部分。

column1: computer screen
column2: 電腦螢幕

column1: steam vent
column2: 蒸汽排放口

column1: Keronian leader.
column2: 柯羅娜領袖。

column1: The old Keronian guy looks friendly enough, but his color makes you wonder if he's getting enough oxygen.
column2: 這位柯羅娜老人看起來挺和善的，不過他的臉色讓你懷疑他氧氣夠不夠。

column1: Some steam is escaping from the generator. That explains why this place is so humid.
column2: 發電機正冒出一些蒸汽，難怪這地方這麼潮濕。

column1: steam escaping from the pipes.
column2: 從管線裡冒出的蒸汽。

column1: Please, don't be alarmed. We intend no harm. We are a peaceful race. We are cautious, however. Others don't share our way of life. Welcome to Kerona.
column2: 「別緊張，我們沒有惡意。我們是愛好和平的種族，只是比較謹慎——不是每個種族都跟我們一樣。歡迎來到柯羅娜星。」

column1: You are standing in the power generation facility of our underground settlement. All power here is produced by steam. That is unimportant to you, however. We have promised you transportation.
column2: 「你現在站的地方，是我們地下聚落的發電設施。這裡所有的電力都靠蒸汽產生，不過這對你來說不重要。我們答應過要給你交通工具。」

column1: It is a Skimmer. It hovers approximately 1/2 meter above the traveling surface. This is very important because of Grell.
column2: 「那是一台沙漠飛車，會懸浮在地表上方大約半公尺處。這點很重要，因為格瑞爾的關係。」

column1: Grell and his like dwell in caves below the sand. If you stand on the surface too long, you chance becoming a rare moist meal for him.
column2: 「格瑞爾跟他的同類住在沙地底下的洞穴裡。你要是在地表站太久，很可能就會變成他難得一見的『多汁大餐』。」

column1: The skimmer is programmed to take you to a settlement on the other side of Kerona called Ulence Flats. You can make further travel arrangements there.
column2: 「這台沙漠飛車已經設定好，會載你到柯羅娜星另一頭一個叫尤倫斯荒原的聚落。你可以到那裡再安排後續的行程。」

column1: I am sorry this is all we can offer. I hope your trip is a safe one. Board the skimmer when you are ready to depart. Good luck, strange one.
column2: 「很抱歉我們能提供的就只有這些。祝你一路平安，準備好了就上飛車出發吧。祝你好運，異鄉人。」

column1: Play
column2: 開始

column1: This gauge tells the amount of damage done to the skimmer.
column2: 這個儀表顯示沙漠飛車受損的程度。

column1: exhaust fumes
column2: 廢氣

column1: ship's hatch
column2: 太空船艙門

column2: 這是逃生艙的艙門。因為設計特殊，門上留了一份備用電力，剛好夠再開一次——不過現在已經完全報銷了。

column1: piece of glass
column2: 玻璃碎片

column1: A chunk of the highly reflective windscreen rests on the sand at the front of the pod. It, along with your teeth, was jarred loose as a result of the the landing's impact.
column2: 一塊反光度極高的擋風玻璃碎片，散落在逃生艙前方的沙地上。降落時的衝擊力道，把它跟你的牙齒一起震了下來。

column1: emergency survival kit
column2: 緊急求生包

column1: pod's hull
column2: 逃生艙外殼

column1: The hull of the pod has an exquisite sheen. Too bad it is destined to remain a monument to your visit.
column2: 逃生艙的外殼有種精緻的光澤，可惜它注定要變成你這趟造訪的紀念碑。

column1: This is the entry way to the pod.
column2: 這是通往逃生艙的入口。

column1: ridge's edge
column2: 沙脊邊緣

column1: Your highly-honed preservation instincts tell you that going near the edge would be disasterous.
column2: 你那身經百戰的求生本能告訴你，靠近邊緣絕對沒好下場。

column1: pod's windshield
column2: 逃生艙擋風玻璃

column1: pod's engines
column2: 逃生艙引擎

column1: The engines seem to have performed their jobs well. They will now stand silent for eternity.
column2: 這些引擎似乎盡忠職守地完成了任務，接下來就要永遠沉寂下去了。

column1: The rocks lying on the ground here are made of crumbling sandstone.
column2: 地上散落的這些石頭，是一碰就碎的砂岩。

column1: This ridge of sand helped stop the pod.
column2: 這道沙脊幫忙擋住了逃生艙。

column1: In the distance rises a unique formation of mountains. They look to be hundreds of kilometers away.
column2: 遠方矗立著一片造型奇特的山脈，看起來離這裡有好幾百公里遠。

column1: Guess what? More sand! Do you have any idea where you're headed?
column2: 你猜怎麼著？還是沙子！你知道自己要往哪走嗎？

column1: You are on Tiny's Used Spaceship lot. There are only a few interesting ships to choose from.
column2: 你站在小不點二手太空船行的場地上，這裡沒剩幾艘像樣的船可以挑。

column1: OK! Let's go take a look at those beauties!
column2: 好！走，去瞧瞧那些寶貝！

column1: There is a sign here which indicates that this is Tiny's Used Spaceship Lot.
column2: 這裡有塊招牌，寫著這是「小不點的二手太空船賣場」。

column1: You can't.
column2: 你辦不到。

column1: There is a sign here which indicates that this is Tiny's Used Space Ship Lot.
column2: 這裡有塊招牌，寫著這是「小不點的二手太空船賣場」。

column1: There is a small, sturdy office here which unauthorized personnel are not allowed in.
column2: 這裡有間小巧堅固的辦公室，未經授權不得進入。

column1: sale flags
column2: 促銷旗幟

column1: There are some decorative banners which would seem to indicate that making a purchase at Tiny's can be a festive occasion.
column2: 這裡掛著一些裝飾用的旗幟，看起來在暗示，在小不點這裡買東西可以是件喜氣洋洋的事。

column1: pink ship
column2: 粉紅色太空船

column1: Who would paint their space ship pink? Anyway, it looks as if Tiny's using this old beast as a source for parts. It definitely won't fly.
column2: 誰會把自己的太空船漆成粉紅色啊？不管怎樣，看樣子小不點是把這艘老古董當零件庫在用，這艘船絕對飛不起來了。

column1: green ship
column2: 綠色太空船

column1: This ship is a real classic - a WalWood WarpBlaster ZX with the original paint job. You've only seen these on old postcards. Too bad it belongs to one of the bar patrons and isn't for sale.
column2: 這艘船可是貨真價實的經典——一台原廠塗裝的「沃伍德曲速衝擊者 ZX」。你以前只在老明信片上見過這種船。可惜這艘是酒吧某位常客的，不賣。

column1: distant ships
column2: 遠方的太空船

column1: You see two ships in the northern part of Tiny's used spacecraft lot.
column2: 你看到小不點的二手太空船場北邊，停著兩艘船。

column1: force field sensor
column2: 力場感應器

column1: The settlement of Ulence Flats is surrounded by these force field generators. They repel such undesirables such as the grell which thrive below the sands. It will allow only airborne vehicles in or out.
column2: 尤倫斯荒原這個聚落，四周都是這種力場發電機圍著。它們會把格瑞爾這種在沙地底下大量繁殖的討厭東西擋在外面，只放飛行載具進出。

column1: Impossible to miss is the incredibly rotund owner, Tiny. The jaw jockey is most certainly an unusual-looking being. He looks very much like a fish who has swallowed its fishbowl.
column2: 想不注意到都難——那位胖到不可思議的老闆，小不點。這位「嘴上功夫王」絕對是個長相奇特的傢伙，看起來活像一條把自己的魚缸整個吞下去的魚。

column1: I've got a coupl'a other fine ships just to the north of here. Whad'ya say, sport. Shall we go give 'em a gander?
column2: 「我北邊那還有幾艘不錯的船喔。怎麼樣，老兄，要不要過去瞄一眼？」

column1: I'd like to take your money, pal. But, even I wouldn't sell you the same ship twice.
column2: 我是很想賺你的錢啦，老兄。不過就算是我，也不會把同一艘船賣你兩次。

column1: So, what are ya trying to pull? If you don't have the cash you can hit the road. Go on, get out of here. You're wasting my time!
column2: 「你到底想搞什麼把戲？沒錢就滾一邊去。走啊，離開這裡。你在浪費我的時間！」

column1: Thanks, pal. I don't know how long I've wanted one of these.
column2: 謝啦，老兄。我想要這玩意兒想很久了。

column1: All riiiight! Is this that new Leisure Suit Larry movie?
column2: 太棒啦！這是那部新的「幻想空間」電影嗎？

column1: That's real cute. Now can we discuss buying a spaceship? I'm only here to serve you. Talk to me.
column2: 有夠可愛的。現在可以來談談買太空船了嗎？我在這裡就是要伺候你。說吧。

column1: Hey! I'm not responsible. That ship was in A-1 shape when I sold it to you!! I swear it!!! Hey, wait a minute. That's not from any of MY ships. What are you tryin' to pull here?
column2: 喂！這不能怪我。我賣你的時候那艘船狀況好得很！我發誓！！！等等，這根本不是我賣的船上的東西。你到底想搞什麼鬼？

column1: Sorry, bud. I only deal in space ships, not sand skimmers.
column2: 抱歉啦，老兄。我只做太空船生意，沙漠飛車不收。

column1: Sorry, bud. I only deal in space ships, not itsy-bitsy jetpacks.
column2: 抱歉啦，老兄。我只做太空船生意，小小一個噴射背包我不收。

column1: Lovely gadget - lovely. So are we gonna make a deal here?. Talk to me.
column2: 這小裝置真不錯——真不錯。那我們要不要來談個交易？說吧。

column1: Sorry, pal, but I only take cash.
column2: 抱歉了，老兄，我只收現金。

column1: There is a hole here. I'm sure you recall its origin. At the bottom is the fine craft you rode to glory in. There is no reason to explore the hole any further.
column2: 這裡有個坑洞，你應該記得它是怎麼來的。坑底躺著那艘帶你風光落地的座駕。沒必要再往這坑裡深究了。

column1: You are standing near one of Tiny's used spacecraft. Upon close inspection they appear to have quite a few kilolightyears on them.
column2: 你站在小不點的一艘二手太空船旁邊。仔細一看，這艘船的里程數看起來已經跑了不少千光年了。

column1: Sorry, you can only fly it when you buy it.  Oh, by the way, there are no refunds either.  Company Policy.
column2: 「抱歉，買了才能開。喔對了，也不接受退費，公司規定。」

column1: ship lid
column2: 太空船艙蓋

column1: That's the lid that covers and protects you during flight (provided this thing does fly).
column2: 那是飛行時用來遮蔽保護你的艙蓋（如果這玩意兒真飛得起來的話）。

column1: ship tail
column2: 太空船尾

column1: This ship seems to have fins around its upper section. Quite a strange setup, but at least it's cheap.
column2: 這艘船的上半部好像裝了一圈尾翼，設計挺奇怪的，不過至少便宜。

column1: It's the ladder you used to climb aboard your mole ship.
column2: 這是你用來爬上你那艘鼴鼠太空船的梯子。

column1: Ulence Flats is a typical example of some of the frontier settlements that sprang up in the early days of Outer Zone exploration. Unfortunately, this attracted many unsavory quick-buckazoid types. Caution is advised.
column2: 尤倫斯荒原就是外圍星域探勘初期，那種邊疆聚落的典型代表。可惜這裡也吸引了不少想撈太空幣快錢的宵小之徒，行動請多加小心。

column1: You've got a deal!
column2: 成交！

column1: It's a deal!
column2: 成交！

column1: Great!
column2: 「太好了！」

column1: alien wolf-creature
column2: 外星狼形生物

column1: rocket sign
column2: 火箭招牌

column1: sand skimmer
column2: 沙漠飛車

column1: The settlement of Ulence Flats is surrounded by these force field generators. They repel undesirables, such as the Grell, which thrive below the sands. It will allow only airborne vehicles in or out.
column2: 尤倫斯荒原這個聚落，四周都是這種力場發電機圍著。它們會把格瑞爾這種在沙地底下大量繁殖的討厭東西擋在外面，只放飛行載具進出。

column1: shuttle craft
column2: 太空梭

column1: This appears to be a long-range shuttle, perhaps from a large starship. It looks vaguely familiar somehow.
column2: 這看起來是一艘長程太空梭，可能來自某艘大型星艦。不知怎麼地，你覺得有點眼熟。

column1: pickle ship
column2: 酸黃瓜太空船

column1: This ship is a real classic - a WalWood WarpBlaster ZX with the original paint job. You've only seen these on old postcards.
column2: 這艘船可是貨真價實的經典——一台原廠塗裝的「沃伍德曲速衝擊者 ZX」。你以前只在老明信片上見過這種船。

column1: tall rocket ship
column2: 高聳的火箭船

column1: This one's a genuine antique from the twenty-fourth-and-a-half century.
column2: 這艘可是二十四點五世紀的真品古董。

column1: There is a rounded structure here with a door on one side. It is typical of some of the prefab structures constructed in frontier areas years ago.
column2: 這裡有棟圓形建築，一側開著門，是那種多年前在邊疆地區常見的預鑄式建築。

column1: Rocket Bar's sign
column2: 火箭酒吧招牌

column1: This is the back of the bar at the southeast corner of Ulence Flats.
column2: 這裡是尤倫斯荒原東南角酒吧的後面。

column1: Come on over here, pal. Wait'll ya see this!
column2: 「過來這邊看看，老兄。等你看到這個就知道了！」

column1: Hold it right there, pal! This is a stick-up! I'll just relieve you of your cash, thank you very much.
column2: 「站住別動，老兄！這是搶劫！你的錢，我就不客氣收下囉，謝啦。」

column1: C'mon, c'mon, I ain't got all day.
column2: 「快點快點，我可沒空耗一整天。」

column1: Well, you've got to be leaving now. Go straight back the way you came in. Deviate from that path and you're Grell kibble!
column2: 「好了，你該滾了。原路給我直直走回去，敢亂繞路，你就等著變格瑞爾的飼料吧！」

column1: And if ya try followin' me, you'll get a nasty taste of my blaster. Got it? Good.
column2: 「你敢跟過來，就讓你嚐嚐我雷射槍的滋味，噁心到爆。聽懂了嗎？很好。」

column1: waste disposal port
column2: 廢棄物處理口

column1: This waste disposal port looks as though it's used quite often.
column2: 這個廢棄物處理口看起來常常在用。

column1: robot arm
column2: 機器手臂

column1: A robot arm reaches out to dump another load of dust into an already large pile. That must be one very dirty bar.
column2: 一隻機器手臂伸出來，把另一批灰塵倒進本來就一大堆的塵堆裡。這間酒吧想必髒到不行。

column1: The force field's sensors detect any moving, ground-based animals to prevent them from entering - or leaving - Ulence Flats.
column2: 這片力場的感應器會偵測任何在地面移動的動物，阻止牠們進出尤倫斯荒原。

column1: pile of dust
column2: 一堆灰塵

column1: There is a strange pile of very fine white powder here. It has a strange, burnt smell to it.
column2: 這裡有一小堆很細的白色粉末，帶著一股怪怪的焦味。

column1: pickup building
column2: 取貨大樓

column1: It's a Droids-B-Us store.
column2: 這是一間「機器人量販店」。

column1: way to the Droids-B-Us store
column2: 往「機器人量販店」的路

column1: That's the way to the Droids-B-Us store.
column2: 那是通往「機器人量販店」的路。

column1: Droids-B-Us store
column2: 機器人量販店

column1: In the distance you see the familiar shape of a Droids-B-Us store.
column2: 遠遠地，你看到「機器人量販店」那熟悉的外觀。

column1: bar building
column2: 酒吧建築

column1: The back of the bar looks about as dingy as the front did.
column2: 酒吧後面看起來跟前面一樣破舊骯髒。

column1: It appears to be in Sarienese. Your Sarienese is a little rusty, but you decide it must say "Xenon Bites!"
column2: 看起來是用沙利安文寫的。你的沙利安文有點生疏，但你猜這應該是寫著「氙星遜斃了！」

column1: A bearded band is cranking out some of the more popular tunes in the quadrant
column2: 一支大鬍子樂團正賣力演奏著這個星域裡幾首比較紅的曲子

column1: These are a couple of nongalactic-looking humanoids cranking out some unfamiliar-sounding tunes. They seem interested solely in the music they are performing.
column2: 這是兩個看起來不像本銀河系生物的類人型，正賣力演奏著一些聽都沒聽過的曲子。他們似乎只在乎自己演奏的音樂。

column1: On stage, a strangely attired woman performs her act (if that's what you want to call it). You haven't had a girlfriend for a long time (more like forever), but even that's not enough to make here attractive.
column2: 舞台上，一個穿著怪異的女人正在表演她的「節目」（如果這也算表演的話）。你已經很久沒交過女朋友了（其實是從來沒交過），但即使如此，也沒辦法讓她看起來有吸引力。

column1: So, what's your beef, junior?
column2: 「說吧，小子，你有什麼不滿？」

column1: Gimme anudder un, ya jerr-erk!
column2: 再給偶一杯啦，你這個混蛋！

column1: Here ya go.
column2: 「拿去。」

column1: So stop botherin' me already.
column2: 「所以別再煩我了啦。」

column1: It's the widget you got from the Star Generator's pedestal. Don't you remember?
column2: 這是你從星辰產生器底座上拿到的那個強力磁鐵，你不記得了嗎？

column1: kzitten's arm
column2: 克茲坦的手臂

column1: This character kinda reminds you of a cute, fluffy little kitten you had when you were a kid - except that he weighs about 400 kilos and has foot-long, razor-sharp claws and a bad attitude.
column2: 這傢伙讓你想起小時候養過的那隻毛茸茸的可愛小貓咪──只不過牠現在重達四百公斤，還長了一呎長的鋒利爪子，脾氣也差到爆。

column1: slug guy
column2: 鼻涕蟲仔

column1: This guy appears to have blown in from Santa Cruz.
column2: 這傢伙看起來像是從聖塔克魯茲飄過來的。

column1: You must be getting dizzy - you're seeing triple.
column2: 你該是頭暈了吧──怎麼東西全都變成三個了？

column1: This character looks like an economy-size version of your Uncle Buck's toupee.
column2: 這傢伙看起來就像巴克叔叔那頂假髮的加大特惠版。

column1: A fine example of his species - whatever THAT is.
column2: 他們這種族的代表範例──不過天曉得那到底是什麼種族就是了。

column1: chip and dale
column2: 奇奇與蒂蒂

column1: Cute little purple guys, eh! They sure can put away the brew.
column2: 可愛的紫色小傢伙，對吧！牠們喝啤酒的本事倒是一流。

column1: The sweeper is a small motorized device which scans the floor for debris and removes it within moments of detection. There is nothing special about it, otherwise.
column2: 這台清掃機是一個小型電動裝置，會掃描地板上的雜物，一偵測到就立刻清除。除此之外，沒什麼特別的。

column1: beer mug
column2: 啤酒杯

column1: The beer mug is in the shape of a rocket.
column2: 這個啤酒杯做成火箭的形狀。

column1: The beer mug is just a normal beer mug.
column2: 這只是個普通的啤酒杯。

column1: light cannon
column2: 光砲

column1: This appears to be a 6 megawatt Kurtzman Kannon of the type used to signal the end of particularly bad acts on the old LaserGong show.
column2: 這看起來是一台六百萬瓦的科茲曼雷射砲，就是舊時「雷射鑼聲秀」節目裡，專門用來把爛透了的表演轟下台的那種東西。

column1: This is the bar top.
column2: 這是吧台。

column1: slot machine
column2: 吃角子吃角子老虎

column1: It appears to be an electronic slot machine.
column2: 看起來是一台電子吃角子吃角子老虎。

column1: It's a "Slots-O-Death" slot machine. They play for keeps around here.
column2: 這是一台名叫「奪命吃角子老虎」的機台。在這裡玩，賭的可是真傢伙——輸了就真的要人命。

column1: pretty picture
column2: 圖案

column1: These are the slot machine's pretty pictures. Put some money in the slot, push the button, and watch them go 'round and 'round.
column2: 這些是吃角子吃角子老虎上的圖案。投點錢進去，按下按鈕，看著它們轉啊轉。

column1: buckazoid slot
column2: 太空幣投幣口

column1: This is where you deposit buckazoids. You may deposit up to three buckazoids for each spin.
column2: 你可以在這裡投入太空幣，每次轉動最多可以投三枚。

column1: Push this button to start the wheels spinning.
column2: 按下這個按鈕就能讓輪盤開始轉動。

column1: information window
column2: 說明視窗

column1: This little window tells you how to win, how much you can win, and other useful information.
column2: 這個小視窗會告訴你怎麼贏、能贏多少，還有其他有用的資訊。

column1: exit button
column2: 離開按鈕

column1: This button takes you back to the bar.
column2: 按下這個按鈕會帶你回到酒吧。

column1: You are standing in the back part of Tiny's used space-craft lot.
column2: 你站在小不點二手太空船行的後半部。

column1: Talk to me, chief.
column2: 「跟我說吧，老大。」

column1: Tiny is a large, green-scale-covered jaw jockey with the personality of a true salesman. Not a prime combination of traits, I must say.
column2: 「小不點」是個渾身覆滿綠色鱗片的大塊頭，一張嘴上下能講個不停，個性活脫脫就是個推銷員。老實說，這組合真的不怎麼樣。

column1: Lovely gadget - lovely. So are we gonna make a deal here? Talk to me.
column2: 這小裝置真漂亮，真漂亮。那我們要不要來談個生意？說吧。

column1: That's a smell jet ack, all right, but for exploring space, you need a real ship. Can we talk business.
column2: 那噴射背包是不錯啦，但要探索太空，你需要的是一艘真正的太空船。我們來談生意吧？

column1: Sorry, bud, but I only deal in space ships, not sand skimmers.
column2: 抱歉啦，老兄，我只做太空船生意，沙漠飛車我可不賣。

column1: Sorry, bud, but I only deal in space ships, not itsy-bitsy jetpacks.
column2: 抱歉啦，老兄，我只做太空船生意，小小一顆的噴射背包我可不賣。

column1: As you rise high above the sands of Ulence, you look down and see someone waving good-bye. This really is a friendly place after-all!
column2: 當你高高飛過尤倫斯的沙地時，低頭看見有人朝你揮手道別。這裡說到底還真是個友善的地方！

column1: That's not possible from up here.
column2: 在這麼高的地方，那是辦不到的。

column1: It's just a regular old ladder.
column2: 這只是一把普通的舊梯子。

column1: saucer ship
column2: 飛碟船

column1: It's awfully small, and also much older than you.
column2: 它小得可憐，年紀也比你老上許多。

column1: saucer's bubble
column2: 飛碟的艙罩

column1: That's the lid that covers and protects you during flight. Provided this thing does fly.
column2: 那是飛行時用來蓋住並保護你的艙蓋。前提是這玩意兒真的飛得起來。

column1: This is the pickup area for Droids-B-Us.
column2: 這裡是機器人量販店的提貨區。

column1: Here's your incredibly complex robot, sir.  I sprained my thermodiodinal-tricycler carrying it out here for you.  I hope you're satisfied.
column2: 「先生，這是您那台複雜到不可思議的機器人。我把它搬到這裡的時候，還扭傷了我的熱二極三輪關節，希望您滿意。」

column1: And I hope you're smarter than you look, or you'll never be able to put it together.  How depressing.
column2: 「也希望您比外表看起來聰明一點，不然您永遠也組裝不起來。真是令人沮喪。」

column1: Guess this was a bit beyond your capabilities. Speaking of bits, that's about all that remains of you. Hope you can regroup those molecules and get back to the game.
column2: 看來這任務對你來說有點強人所難。說到「有點」，你現在大概也只剩那麼一點點了。希望你能把那些分子重新拼回去，回來繼續遊戲。

column1: Oh my. Another shredded customer. I suppose someone will be upset about this. Why do I bother.
column2: 「唉呀，又一位被碎成渣的顧客。我猜總會有人為這件事不高興吧。我到底何必呢。」

column1: You seem to have had trouble maintaining your composure (not to mention your molecular structure). Get yourself together. Unfortunately, you're the universe's only hope.
column2: 你似乎沒能保持鎮定（更別提你的分子結構也一併散了）。振作點，把自己拼回去吧。很不幸，你可是全宇宙唯一的希望。

column1: Hello, sir.  Your new robot will be here in a moment.
column2: 「哈囉，先生。您的新機器人馬上就送到。」

column1: Well, there he is, sir, programmed to follow you around like a wimpering little puppy dog. How humiliating.
column2: 「他來囉，先生，被設定成像隻愛哀哀叫的小狗一樣跟著您到處走。真是丟臉。」

column1: warehouse robot
column2: 倉庫機器人

column1: This robot is a very old model.  Somehow, he looks tired and depressed.
column2: 這台機器人是很老舊的型號，不知怎地，看起來又累又沮喪。

column1: It's easy for you to be chearful, isn't it? YOU don't have deteriorating flaberthrusters.
column2: 你當然可以講得輕鬆，是吧？你又沒有正在退化的浮力推進器。

column1: What do you want now? I was just about finished with my internal diagnostics check. Now I'm going to have to recalibrate my photo-electric scanner membranes and begin all over again.
column2: 你現在又想幹嘛？我內部診斷檢查才剛做完，現在又得重新校正我的光電掃描膜，整個從頭來過。

column1: Carbon-based life-forms can be sooo trying sometimes. If you haven't purchased a robot, I have nothing for you. Now, go away!
column2: 碳基生物有時候真的有夠令人受不了。如果你沒買機器人，我這裡沒你的事。現在，走開！

column1: (Sigh!) How depressing. Let's begin again from the start and proceed veeerrrryyyy sssslllooowwwllly. I do NOT want to be disturbed. You ARE disturbing me. GO AWAY! Thank you so much.
column2: （嘆氣！）真令人沮喪。我們從頭開始，慢——慢——地重新來過。我不想被打擾，你正在打擾我。走開！非常謝謝。

column1: I'm STILL ignoring you!
column2: 我依然在無視你！

column1: I'm ignoring you.
column2: 我正在無視你。

column1: Do NOT touch me! Carbon-based life-forms are notoriously filthy creatures. Everyone knows that they veritably ooze with metal-tarnishing agents.
column2: 不准碰我！碳基生物出了名的骯髒。大家都知道，你們身上簡直滲得出讓金屬失去光澤的髒東西。

column1: I am programmed to defend myself against all attacks. Even against such a laughable attempt at destruction as this. It would be a shame to expend the energy required to kill you, don't you agree? Yes, I thought you would.
column2: 我被設定成會抵禦一切攻擊，就算是像這種可笑到不行的破壞嘗試也一樣。花力氣殺了你實在太浪費了，你說是吧？嗯，我就知道你會這麼想。

column1: Although I am amused at your feeble attempt to modify my magnetic field, I must warn you that I can, and most definitely will, defend myself if need be. Now, please put that thing away. Thank you so much.
column2: 雖然你那微弱的嘗試想干擾我的磁場讓我覺得挺有趣，但我得警告你，必要的話我絕對會自衛。現在，請把那玩意兒收起來。非常謝謝。

column1: Sorry, sir. I'm not allowed to accept tips.
column2: 抱歉，先生。我不能收小費。

column1: It appears to be some sort of data cartridge, sir, but I'm afraid I'm not equipped with the necessary port to access the information it contains.
column2: 先生，這看起來是某種資料匣，但恐怕我沒有裝設能讀取裡面資料的接口。

column1: You won't need your translation device, sir. I'm fluent in more than three million modes of spoken communication.
column2: 先生，您用不著翻譯機。我精通超過三百萬種口語溝通模式。

column1: No thank you, sir - I never touch the stuff.
column2: 不用了，謝謝，先生──我從不碰那種東西。

column1: I've seen a jet pack much like this one reduced to slag after one brief flight. It wasn't a pretty sight.
column2: 我見過一個跟這個很像的噴射背包，才飛沒多久就熔成一坨廢鐵。那畫面可不好看。

column1: Many of our local businesses issue these coupons for discounts through the Ulence Flats Chamber of Commerce. It's done wonders for business around here.
column2: 這裡不少店家都會透過尤倫斯荒原商會發放這種折價券。這招對這一帶的生意可有效得很。

column1: Many of our local businesses issue thses coupons for discounts through the Ulence Flats Chamber of Commerce. It's done wonders for business around here.
column2: 這裡不少店家都會透過尤倫斯荒原商會發放這種折價券。這招對這一帶的生意可有效得很。

column1: SUX robot
column2: SUX機器人

column1: What a fine robot you've purchased!
column2: 您買到的這台機器人真不錯！

column1: Great. Three boxes of robot parts, sporting large signs which read: "Caution: This product contains explosive parts. Not intended for children under three."
column2: 太好了。三箱機器人零件，上頭都貼著大大的警告標語：「注意：本產品內含爆炸性零件，未滿三歲兒童不宜。」

column1: Droids-B-Us warehouse and pickup area
column2: 機器人量販店倉庫暨取貨區

column1: This portion of the building is the warehouse where customers come to pick up their purchases.
column2: 這棟建築的這一區是倉庫，顧客會來這裡取走買到的東西。

column1: That's the Droids-B-Us storefront. Droids-B-Us is known throughout this end of the galaxy for the best deals on new and used psionic and cybernetic systems for home, school, office, and spaceship.
column2: 那是「機器人量販店」的店面。機器人量販店在銀河系這一端可是出了名的，專賣居家、學校、辦公室與太空船用的全新與二手念力∕機械系統，價格保證划算。

column1: sign above the door
column2: 門上方的招牌

column1: The badly weathered sign says "Droids-B-Us Pickup".
column2: 這塊風吹日曬得破破爛爛的招牌寫著「機器人量販店·取貨處」。

column1: Gerry G
column2: 傑瑞G

column1: This cheerful fellow is Gerry Giraffazoid, logo, spokesbeing, and C.E.O. of Droids-B-Us, Inc.
column2: 這個笑咪咪的傢伙是傑瑞·長頸鹿佐德，「機器人量販店」股份有限公司的商標吉祥物、代言生物兼執行長。

column1: You are outside the Droids-B-Us store.
column2: 你在機器人量販店門口。

column1: The settlement of Ulence Flats is surrounded by these force field generators. They repel undesirables, such as the grell, which thrive below the sands. It will allow only airborne vehicles in or out.
column2: 尤倫斯荒原這個聚落四周，就是被這些力場產生器包圍著。它們會擋掉不受歡迎的傢伙，像是在沙地底下大量繁殖的格瑞爾，只放飛行載具進出。

column1: This robot is a security droid. He can scan an area in infra-red, ultra-violet, and infra-ultra-chartreuse.
column2: 這台機器人是保全機器人，可以用紅外線、紫外線，還有「紅外紫外之間的查特酒綠光」掃描區域。

column1: It's a robot that seems to be saying, "Buy me. Take me home."
column2: 這台機器人彷彿在說：「買下我，帶我回家吧。」

column1: neon hand
column2: 霓虹手

column1: The neon hand waves "Hello" to you.
column2: 那隻霓虹手朝你揮了揮，說「哈囉」。

column1: It's just part of the animated sign.
column2: 那只是動畫招牌的一部分而已。

column1: That is the Droids-B-Us warehouse and pickup area.
column2: 那是「機器人量販店」的倉庫兼取貨區。

column1: This is the Droids-B-Us storefront.  They sell droids for all purposes.
column2: 這是「機器人量販店」的店面，什麼用途的機器人他們都賣。

column1: Droids-B-Us sign
column2: 機器人量販店招牌

column1: The big sign over the door says "Droids-B-Us".
column2: 門上的大招牌寫著「機器人量販店」。

column1: small posted sign
column2: 張貼的小告示

column1: The sign says "ALL SALES FINAL!" in 1,438 languages.
column2: 告示牌用 1,438 種語言寫著「概不退換！」

column1: You can see only bits and pieces of droids through the small window.  But it looks safe enough in there.
column2: 你只能透過小窗戶看到一些機器人的零碎片段，不過裡面看起來還算安全。

column1: Please observe our robot preview screen. If you have any questions, don't hesitate to ask.
column2: 請參閱我們的機器人展示螢幕，若有任何疑問，歡迎隨時詢問。

column1: Oh, we're back, are we? Well, perhaps we can manage to take home a droid this time, eh?
column2: 喔，又是你啊？這次說不定能順利帶一台機器人回家囉？

column1: However, I can see that we would be more... ah... interested in our line of economy-priced, used robots, wouldn't we?
column2: 不過我看啊……嗯……你應該比較想看我們那些便宜又划算的二手機器人系列吧？

column1: We have a wide variety of work-saving, life- enhancing, shiny-new, factory-fresh, technological wonders of modern engineering wizardry!
column2: 我們這裡應有盡有：省時省力、提升生活品質、閃亮全新、剛出廠的最新科技結晶，通通都是現代工程的奇蹟！

column1: Greetings, sir! Allow me to show you our fine line of robots, otherwise known as "droids".
column2: 您好，先生！讓我為您介紹我們家優質的機器人系列。

column1: Thank you, sir.
column2: 謝謝您，先生。

column1: You may pick up your purchase at our convenient Droids-B-Us pickup area, located just out the door and to your right.
column2: 您可以到機器人量販店的取貨區領取您買的東西，就在門外右手邊，非常方便。

column1: You could fill out one of our credit applications, although I seriously doubt that you would qualify.
column2: 您可以填一份分期付款申請表，不過我很懷疑您符不符合資格。

column1: I believe that the FloorMart store on Petulence is having a sale on pencil sharpeners that you might just be able to afford!
column2: 我看「佩圖倫斯星」上的地板量販店正在特賣削鉛筆機，那個價格您應該還買得起！

column1: Why can't I ever get a customer with more money than brains? Well... in your case, you might just qualify at that.
column2: 為什麼我從來遇不到那種錢比腦袋還多的客人？嗯……不過您的情況，搞不好還真的符合資格。

column1: Look, why don't you go break your piggy bank open and come back with a little more cash? Now, if you'll excuse me, you really must be going.
column2: 這樣吧，您回去把撲滿打破，多帶點現金再來吧？好啦，容我送客，您真的該走了。

column1: Pardon me for saying so, sir, but we don't appear to have enough money for our purchase, now, do we?
column2: 恕我直言，先生，我們的錢好像不太夠買東西吧，是不是啊？

column1: The salesbug appears to be a Chdnarian, a race renowned for their predatory sales techniques. You decide to count your fingers once you've completed your transaction.
column2: 這隻銷售蟲似乎是奇德納人，這個種族以掠奪式推銷手法聞名。你決定等交易完成後，先數一數自己的手指頭再說。

column1: If you were to insist, I could let you have it for a mere 512 buckazoids (407 with a coupon).
column2: 如果您堅持的話，我可以只跟您收 512 枚太空幣就割愛（有折價券的話 407 枚）。

column1: However, I have only one left, and I put it to work in the warehouse.
column2: 不過我只剩最後一台了，而且已經派去倉庫工作了。

column1: This is an all-purpose household model. It cooks, sews, does windows and brews a little moonshine on the side.
column2: 這是一款多功能家用機型，會煮飯、會縫紉、會擦窗戶，閒暇之餘還會私釀一點小酒。

column1: Don't bother haggling. This one's worth 55 buckazoids for the parts alone. That would be 46 buckazoids with a coupon.
column2: 別跟我殺價了，光是零件就值 55 枚太空幣，有折價券的話是 46 枚。

column1: That race killed themselves off, however, and spare parts are nearly impossible to find.
column2: 不過那個種族已經自相殘殺滅絕了，備用零件幾乎找不到。

column1: It was produced exclusively for Droids-B-Us by a small planet who used these mechanical warriors to fight their battles.
column2: 這台是某個小星球專為機器人量販店製造的，他們原本是拿這些機械戰士去打仗用的。

column1: Ah! This model is one of my personal favorites.
column2: 啊！這個機型是我個人的心頭好。

column1: And, if you've got kids, you'll appreciate its low, low price of 698 buckazoids (559 with a coupon).
column2: 如果您有小孩，一定會喜歡它超低的價格：698 枚太空幣（有折價券只要 559 枚）。

column1: If you can live with the paranoia, though, it makes a great baby-sitter.
column2: 只要您受得了牠疑神疑鬼的個性，牠其實是個很棒的保母。

column1: Whenever it gets excited, it waves its arms around wildly and yells "DANGER! DANGER!"
column2: 牠只要一激動，就會瘋狂揮舞手臂，大喊「危險！危險！」

column1: However, the manufacturer had to discontinue it due to a psychological disorder.
column2: 不過廠商後來因為牠有心理疾病，被迫把牠停產了。

column1: This model was originally designed as a family companion on those long space vacations.
column2: 這款機型原本是設計來當漫長太空假期的家庭夥伴。

column1: I'd love to sell you one, but every last one I had was snapped up by a movie director from New Japan IV - sorry.
column2: 我是很想賣您一台啦，可惜全被一個來自新日本四號的電影導演搶購一空了——抱歉。

column1: Although a handsome machine, this robot has a habit of killing people without any real reason.
column2: 雖然外型很帥氣，不過這台機器人有個毛病，就是會毫無理由殺人。

column1: Ah, yes, a truly beautiful piece of machinery. This design rates five stars.
column2: 啊，沒錯，這真是一件漂亮的機械藝術品，這款設計可以打五顆星。

column1: Yes, this dandy, compact unit goes for a mere 29 buckazoids (23 with coupon). You can't go wrong when it's SUX!
column2: 沒錯，這台小巧精緻的機型只要 29 枚太空幣（有折價券 23 枚），選 SUX 準沒錯！

column1: ...but of course you wouldn't want to hear about that.
column2: ……不過您大概不會想聽這個啦。

column1: I just happen to have one of these in stock. It's been completely re-conditioned since its regrettable accident that took the lives of...
column2: 我手邊剛好有一台現貨，它經過完整整修，畢竟之前發生過一場不幸的意外，奪走了……

column1: The brand name says it all. SUX is a major manufacturer of refrigerators, dishwashers, and, some day, even time machines!
column2: 光看品牌名稱就知道了。SUX 是冰箱、洗碗機的大廠，說不定哪天連時光機都做得出來！

column1: We've got a set of three, and you can have them all for just 999 buckazoids (799 with a coupon).
column2: 我們有一套三台，全部只要 999 枚太空幣就通通帶走（有折價券 799 枚）。

column1: Yessir, they may look like kleenex boxes, but they're built to run a loooong time. And quiet? You bet!
column2: 沒錯，先生，它們外型看起來像面紙盒，但可是造來耐操耐用的，而且超~安靜，你放心！

column1: These little robots are perfect for gardening chores. And they don't mind at all if they're away on space missions for centuries.
column2: 這些小機器人很適合拿來做園藝雜務，就算要去執行長達幾世紀的太空任務，牠們也完全不介意。

column1: However, we're fresh out of them right now. Nobody seems to survive long enough to trade them in.
column2: 不過我們現在正好缺貨，好像沒有人能活得夠久拿它們回來換新的。

column1: They're just a wee bit too ambitious is all. And who of us isn't? It's quite an endearing quality, actually.
column2: 牠們只是野心稍微大了一點而已，話說回來，誰不是呢？其實這還挺討人喜歡的。

column1: Um... This model has had a bad rep, unearned if you ask me.
column2: 呃……這款機型名聲不太好，不過要我說，那名聲根本不該有。

column1: I could let you have him for just 875 buckazoids (700 with a coupon).
column2: 我可以只跟您收 875 枚太空幣就讓給您（有折價券 700 枚）。

column1: Of course, they're all in hibernation this time of the century.
column2: 當然啦，這個世紀的這個時候，牠們都在冬眠。

column2: 「因為你的英勇，氙星，乃至於整個銀河系，都免於落入邪惡（而且醜陋）的沙利安人統治之下。」

column1: Now, if you'd only been smart enough to bring along the data cartridge containing the construction specifications, we'd be able build a new Star Generator, thereby saving Xenon from the horrors of a rapidly cooling planet. Oh, well. You are just a janitor.
column2: 「唉，早知道你腦筋夠靈光，把裝有建造規格的資料匣一起帶回來就好了，我們就能打造一台新的星辰產生器，讓氙星免於行星急速冷卻的浩劫。算了，你也不過是個清潔工嘛。」

column1: It is my honor to present you with the coveted Golden Mop, a symbol of pride and accomplishment to members of your esteemed profession.
column2: 「我很榮幸能將這個人人夢寐以求的金拖把頒發給你，這是你這個崇高職業引以為傲的成就象徵。」

column1: Henceforth and for all time you will be known as Hero of Xenon.
column2: 「從此刻起，直到永遠，你將被尊稱為氙星英雄。」

column1: There are a couple of non-galactic looking humanoids cranking out some unfamiliar sounding tunes. They seem interested solely in the music they are performing.
column2: 有兩個看起來一點都不像外星人的傢伙，正賣力演奏著讓人聽不慣的曲子。他們似乎只在乎自己演奏的音樂，其他一概不管。

column1: On stage, a strangely attired woman performs her act (if that's what you want to call it). You haven't had a girlfriend for a long time (more like forever), but even that's not enough to make her attractive.
column2: 舞台上有個打扮怪異的女人正在表演（如果那也算表演的話）。你已經很久沒交過女朋友了（老實說，根本是永遠沒有過），但就算這樣，還是沒辦法讓她看起來有吸引力。

column1: On stage are two heavily-bearded gents and a relatively clean-shaven drummer. They're one of the hottest bands in the quadrant.
column2: 舞台上有兩個大鬍子先生和一個算是有刮鬍子的鼓手。他們可是這個星區裡數一數二紅的樂團。

column1: The escape pod is destined to remain a monument to your visit.
column2: 這艘逃生艙注定要成為你造訪此地的紀念碑。

column1: This is an elevator shaft. Elevators are known to have traveled these parts, mostly up and down.
column2: 這是電梯井。這一帶原本就有電梯行駛，大多是上上下下的。

column1: This is an elevator shaft.
column2: 這是電梯井。

column1: In the distance is the galaxy-famous Skihairy mountain range. Nestled in its southernmost slopes is the renowned YoMammy National Park, usually hip-deep in tourists this time of year. Oh, well - maybe next trip.
column2: 遠方是銀河知名的滑毛山脈，最南端山腳下就是赫赫有名的呦馬麻國家公園——這個時節通常擠滿觀光客。唉，算了，下次再來吧。

column1: What a sky this planet has! You've never seen its like outside a toxic waste dump.
column2: 這星球的天空也太扯了吧！除了有毒廢棄物掩埋場，你還沒見過這種顏色的天空。

column1: big moon
column2: 大月亮

column1: Kerona has two moons. This one's the bigger of two.
column2: 柯羅娜星有兩顆衛星，這顆是比較大的那顆。

column1: small moon
column2: 小月亮

column1: Kerona has two moons. This one's the smaller of two.

column1: Kerona's relatively flat desert stretches out into the distance.

column1: your pilot droid
column2: 你的駕駛機器人

column1: Your new pilot droid appears to be a bit dinged up, but functional. You hope that he knows more about piloting a spaceship than you do.
column2: 你的新駕駛機器人看起來坑坑疤疤的，不過還能動。你只能祈禱它開太空船比你在行。

column1: You're in another area of the Deltaur.
column2: 你在代爾它號的另一個區域。

column1: It's one of the Sarien gaurds.
column2: 這是一名沙利安守衛。

column1: sarien officer
column2: 沙利安軍官

column1: It's the amount of time remaining before you're pushin' up daisies, Roger!!!!
column2: 羅傑，這就是你翹辮子之前，還剩下的時間喔！！！！

column1: It's a Sarien officer.
column2: 這是一名沙利安軍官。

column1: Like everything around here, the pipes are extremely colorful. It makes you wonder if the Sariens got a good deal on paint.
column2: 跟這裡其他東西一樣，這些管線的顏色鮮豔到誇張。讓你不禁懷疑，沙利安人是不是撿到便宜油漆才這樣亂刷一通。

column1: Yep. More pipes.
column2: 沒錯，還是管線。

column1: An elevator shaft runs up through the ceiling and down through the floor.
column2: 電梯井貫穿天花板往上，也貫穿地板往下。

column2: 通道管

column1: The lovely crisp green of the Keronian atmosphere reminds you that you'll need to do some laundry when (or if) you get back home.
column2: 柯羅娜星大氣層那清爽宜人的綠色，讓你想起等你回家（如果還回得去的話），該去洗衣服了。

column1: Loitering about the horizon is the second and closest moon of Kerona. It is much less hospitable than the sphere you presently roam.
column2: 地平線附近徘徊的，是柯羅娜星第二顆、也是最近的一顆衛星。那裡可比你現在待的這顆星球還不宜人多了。

column1: distant desert
column2: 遠方的沙漠

column1: Spread before you is a seemingly endless expanse of sand.
column2: 眼前展開的，是一片看似無邊無際的沙地。

column1: The sand of Kerona has a reddish-orange color. Were you a geologist instead of a janitor, you might find this fact interesting.
column2: 柯羅娜星的沙子帶著橘紅色。如果你是地質學家而不是清潔工，說不定會覺得這件事很有意思。

column1: small dune
column2: 小沙丘

column1: Nomads of the desert, dunes are spread about in nearly every direction.
column2: 沙丘就像沙漠裡的遊牧民族，幾乎每個方向都看得到。

column1: A wide selection of skeletal accessories awaits your perusal. Vertebrae, ribs, and who knows what else rest upon the Keronian soil. The average height of this structure looks to be at least 7 meters. Good thing you didn't meet this thing in its heyday.
column2: 各式各樣的骨骸配件任你欣賞：脊椎骨、肋骨，還有一堆你也認不出來的東西，就這樣躺在柯羅娜星的土地上。這副骨架估計至少有 7 公尺高。還好你沒在牠全盛時期遇到牠。

column1: sandy base
column2: 沙地底座

column1: Upon a very narrow width of Keronian soil, able to resist erosion through the eons, rests the skeletal remains of this mammoth has-been.
column2: 在柯羅娜星一小塊歷經億萬年侵蝕依然屹立的土地上，躺著這個昔日巨獸的骨骸。

column1: Oddly enough, a plant grows in isolated spots in this inhospitable environment.
column2: 說也奇怪，這麼惡劣的環境裡，居然還有植物零星生長。

column1: Oddly enough, a rather bright plant grows in this otherwise flora-free area.
column2: 說也奇怪，這片幾乎寸草不生的地方，居然長了一株顏色鮮豔的植物。

column1: spider droid
column2: 蜘蛛機器人

column1: The spider is quite relentless in its pursuit of organic beings. Your quandry is that, to the best of your knowledge, you are the only one in the area fitting that description.
column2: 這隻蜘蛛機器人追殺有機生物毫不留情。你的麻煩在於，就你所知，這附近符合這個條件的，大概只有你自己。

column1: Although you've always had an appreciation for the gases of the universe, this one proved a bit overwhelming. It really was a great idea, though. However, you should have chosen a victim not so close to yourself. Better choice next time.
column2: 雖然你向來欣賞宇宙間各種氣體，但這次的分量顯然有點超出負荷。這其實是個好主意，只可惜你選的「目標」離自己太近了點。下次選遠一點吧。

column1: BLAMMO! Those pulseray pistols sure are effective little weapons. Even after it kills you, your meat continues to cook to nice golden brown. Try not to get shot in the future. Even if your life isn't worth much, think about the rest of the universe.
column2: 碰！脈衝雷射手槍還真是好用的小武器。就算你死透了，你的肉還是繼續被烤成漂亮的金黃色。以後盡量別再被打中了——就算你的命不值錢，也替宇宙其他人想想吧。
